chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.0.zh: 后面不能接意志、请求、命令：「帰ったとたん、電話してください」是错的，要接这类内容得用「たら」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.0.en: No intention, request or command may follow: 帰ったとたん、電話してください is wrong. Use たら for that.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.0.zh: 刚觉得刺眼，就“阿嚏”一声打出了喷嚏。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.0.en: When I felt the eyes pierced, "Sneezing" sneezed.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.0.zh: 下课铃刚响，学生们就走出了教室。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.0.en: When the bell rang, the students walked out of the classroom.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.0.zh: 他一钻进被窝就睡着了。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.0.en: He fell asleep as soon as he got into the nest.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.zh: 「～だす」往外冒或突然开始，「～込む」往里进或做到彻底。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.en: だす sends something outward or starts it abruptly; 込む sends it inward or drives it to the limit.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.zh: Vます（去ます）＋だす／込む：飛びだす、降りだす、吸い込む、走り込む
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.en: Vます (drop ます) + だす / 込む: 飛びだす、降りだす、吸い込む、走り込む

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.zh: 「雨が降りだした」（突然开始）、「プールに飛び込んだ」（往里跳）、「走り込んでいる」（练到量）。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.en: 雨が降りだした (suddenly began), プールに飛び込んだ (jumped in), 走り込んでいる (trained hard).

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.zh: 同一个「だす」有「冒出」和「开始」两解，靠动词和上下文判断；「走り込む」也不是「跑进去」，是充分训练。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.en: The same だす can mean "out" or "begin", decided by the verb and context. And 走り込む is not "run in" but training to the limit.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.zh: 刚觉得刺眼，喷嚏就打了出来。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.en: I just felt a sting and sneezed out.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.zh: 刚上电车，他就从包里拿出了平板电脑。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.en: Just got on the tram, and he took the tablet out of the bag.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.zh: 因为太热，就跳进了游泳池。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.en: Because it's too hot to jump into the pool.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.zh: 马拉松选手为比赛每天练习，进行充分的跑步训练。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.en: Marathon players practiced daily for the competition and conducted adequate running training.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.zh: 三个意思共用一个形式：一起做、同时做、随着变化。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.en: One form carries three jobs: doing together, doing simultaneously, changing in step.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.zh: N＋とともに（一起）；Vる＋とともに（同时）；N／Vる＋とともに（伴随）
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.en: N + とともに (together); Vる + とともに (at the same time); N / Vる + とともに (in step with)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.zh: 「仲間とともに」（一起）、「調べるとともに復旧を進める」（同时）、「人口が増えるとともに」（随着）。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.en: 仲間とともに (together), 調べるとともに復旧を進める (at once), 人口が増えるとともに (in step with).

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.zh: 读的时候先看前面是名词还是动词：名词多半是「一起／随着」，动词多半是「同时」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.en: Check what precedes: a noun usually means "together / along with", a verb usually means "at the same time".

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.zh: 试图把进入鼻子的异物连同鼻涕一起排到外面。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.en: Trying to line the alien into the nose with the snot.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.zh: 与志愿者伙伴一起，让镇上的活动取得了成功。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.en: Working with volunteer partners to make town activities successful.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.zh: 发生了电车事故。公司一边调查事故原因，一边推进恢复运行的工作。
随着人口增加，垃圾问题也出现了。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.en: As the population grows, the problem of garbage also emerges.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.zh: 随着经济复苏，买房的人越来越多。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.en: As the economy recovers, more and more people buy houses.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.zh: 「で・から・まで・と・へ」加「の」，把短语变成能修饰名词的形式。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.en: で, から, まで, と and へ take の to become a phrase that can modify a noun.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.zh: で／から／まで／と／へ＋の＋N（「に」多改成「への」）
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.en: で / から / まで / と / へ + の + N (に usually becomes への)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.zh: 「目からの信号」「両親との暮らし」「タイへの卒業旅行」「学校での生活」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.en: 目からの信号, 両親との暮らし, タイへの卒業旅行, 学校での生活.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.zh: 不是所有助词都能加「の」：「がの」「をの」不存在，「にの」也不说，要换成「への」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.en: Not every particle takes の: がの and をの do not exist, and にの is avoided in favour of への.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.zh: 来自眼睛的“刺眼”信号传到大脑。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.en: The signal of the eye is passed on to the brain.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.zh: 怀念与父母一起生活的日子。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.en: Remember the day you live with your parents.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.zh: 期待去泰国的毕业旅行。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.en: I'm looking forward to my graduation trip to Thailand.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.4.zh: 事情走到一半、还没完的那个阶段：在……途中。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.4.en: The unfinished middle stretch of something: partway through.
Vる + 途中（で／に）; N + の + 途中

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.4.zh: 「帰宅の途中」「信号が脳に伝わる途中で」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.4.en: 帰宅の途中, 信号が脳に伝わる途中で.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.4.zh: 前面用辞书形，不用た形：「帰った途中」是错的。想强调「这期间发生了别的事」，加「で」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.4.en: The verb stays in dictionary form: 帰った途中 is wrong. Add で to say something else happened along the way.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.4.zh: 来自眼睛的信号传向大脑的过程中，不知为什么鼻子发痒，打出了喷嚏。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.4.en: The signal from the eye was passed on to the brain, and for some reason the nose itches and sneezes.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.4.zh: 回家途中，在图书馆借了书。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.4.en: On his way home, he borrowed books at the library.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.zh: 拟声词模仿声音，拟态词描写感觉和状态：日语靠它们把感觉说具体。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.en: Sound words imitate noise; mimetic words describe a feeling or state. They are how Japanese makes sensation concrete.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.zh: 拟声：はくしょん、ワンワン；拟态：むずむず＋する／ぺこぺこ＋だ
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.en: sound: はくしょん、ワンワン; mimetic: むずむず + する / ぺこぺこ + だ

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.zh: 身体感觉多用「～する」（むずむずする、どきどきする），状态多用「～だ」（ぺこぺこだ、くたくただ）。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.en: Bodily sensations take する (むずむずする、どきどきする); states take だ (ぺこぺこだ、くたくただ).

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.zh: 接「する」还是「だ」不能随便换：「おなかがぺこぺこする」不自然。意思也随语境变，别只记一个中文对译。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.en: する and だ are not interchangeable: おなかがぺこぺこする is unnatural. The meaning shifts with context, so one Chinese gloss is never enough.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.zh: 刚觉得刺眼，就“阿嚏”一声打出了喷嚏。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.en: When I felt the eyes pierced, "Sneezing" sneezed.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.zh: 邻居家的狗“汪汪”地叫，很吵。
鼻子痒痒的，打出了喷嚏。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.en: The nose itches and sneezes out.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.zh: 从早上开始什么都没吃，肚子饿扁了。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.en: I haven't eaten anything since morning. I'm starving.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.zh: 先把感受抛出来（令人……的是），再说是什么事引起的。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.en: Lead with the reaction, then say what caused it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.zh: Vた／い形＋ことに；な形＋な＋ことに
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.en: Vた / い-adj + ことに; な-adj + な + ことに

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.zh: 「面白いことに」「残念なことに」「困ったことに」，多用于书面和正式叙述。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.en: 面白いことに, 残念なことに, 困ったことに: mostly written and formal narration.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.zh: 前面必须是表感情的词，别拿普通形容词硬套；な形容词要加「な」（残念なことに）。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.en: Only words of feeling fit before it; な-adjectives keep な: 残念なことに.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.zh: 有趣的是，有一种说法是父母与子女打喷嚏的声音非常相似。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.en: Interestingly, there is a statement that the sound of parents sneezing with their children is very similar.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.zh: 令人困扰的是，不太清楚这个镇上垃圾的丢弃方法。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.en: It's disturbing that there's no clear way to dump the trash in this town.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.zh: 遗憾的是，运动会因台风取消了。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.en: Unfortunately, the Games were cancelled by typhoons.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.5.e.en: You can see the town from the roof.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.6.e.en: I'm waiting inside the ticket gates.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.7.e.en: I go to Osaka by plane.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.8.e.en: My nose is blocked from a cold.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.11..en: To go in; to be crowded.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.13..zh: 去学校的路上遇到了朋友。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.13..en: I met a friend on the way to school.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.14..en: I visit a shrine at New Year.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.18..en: Spring is the season for flower viewing.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.19..zh: 一到春天花粉症就很难受。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.19..en: Hay fever is hard in spring.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.24..en: That is what people generally say.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.26..zh: 很有兴趣的、耐人寻味的

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.kanji.28..en: I saw an elephant at the zoo.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.0.zh: 刚打开门，猫马上意外地冲出去，用「Vたとたん」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.0.en: The cat unexpectedly rushes out immediately after the door opens. Use Vたとたん.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.zh: 表达“刚躺下就睡着了”，哪一句接续正确？
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.en: Choose the correct connection meaning “I fell asleep as soon as I lay down.”

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.zh: とたん前接动词た形：横になったとたん。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.1.en: とたん follows the verb's ta-form: 横になったとたん.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.en: What does だす express in this sentence?

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.zh: 复合动词「降りだす」中的だす表示开始，常带突然发生的感觉。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.2.en: だす in the compound verb 降りだす marks the start of an action, often with a sense of suddenness.
Take rain out of a bag.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.en: Choose the expression meaning “breathe in air.”

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.zh: 吸い込む表示向内吸入。吸いだす是抽吸出来，吐きだす是吐出，吹きだす是吹出或喷出，方向和动作不同。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.3.en: 吸い込む indicates inhalation. 吸いだす is snorting out, 吐きだす is vomiting, 吹きだす is blowing out or ejecting, different direction and movement.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.4.en: Express “complete the work together with my companions.”

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.4.zh: とともに表示与同伴一起。に代わって表示替代，にとって表示评价立场，を通じて表示经由，均不等于一起完成。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.4.en: とともに indicates that it is with its peers. に代わって indicates substitution, にとって indicates an evaluation position, and を通じて indicates that it was passed and not done together.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.en: What does とともに express in this sentence?

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.zh: 前后都是逐渐变化，とともに表示伴随变化，相当于随着。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.en: The changes have been gradual, and the とともに indicates that they are associated with the changes and are equivalent to the changes.
Go out together with one's age.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.zh: 没有比年龄更重要的事。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.en: Nothing is more important than age.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.zh: 随着一方变化，另一方也发生变化。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.en: As one thing changes, another changes too.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.zh: 刚到某个年龄就突然发生一次意外。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.5.en: An accident suddenly happens upon reaching a certain age.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.zh: 把「友達と旅行する」改为“与朋友的旅行”：友達（　　　）旅行。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.en: Change 友達と旅行する to the noun phrase meaning a trip with friends: 友達（　　　）旅行.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.zh: 原句用と标记共同旅行的伙伴，修饰旅行时变为との。への表示方向，からの表示来源，での表示地点或场合。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.en: The original sentence uses と to mark a partner travelling together and modifies it to との. への indicates the direction, からの indicates the source, での indicates the location or venue.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.zh: 「动词辞书形＋途中で」表示在某个过程或路途中发生另一件事。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.en: "verb description form + 途中で" means another thing that happens in a process or on the way.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.zh: 从早上起没吃东西，肚子饿扁了
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.en: You have eaten nothing since morning and are very hungry.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.zh: ぺこぺこ形容肚子饿。にこにこ是微笑，はらはら是担心，ひりひり是火辣辣地疼。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.en: ぺこぺこ describes hunger. にこにこ is a smile, はらはら is a concern, ひりひり is a hot pain.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.zh: な形容词＋な＋ことに，先表达感受再说明事情：残念なことに。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.4.grammar.6.en: Na-adjective＋な＋ことに expresses a feeling before describing the situation: 残念なことに.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.0.no.zh: 街 表街区：住宅街、商店街、オフィス街。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.0.no.en: 街 marks a district of one kind: 住宅街, 商店街, オフィス街.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.2.no.zh: 摩天楼说 超高層ビル。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.2.no.en: A skyscraper is 超高層ビル.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.3.no.zh: 成片建的公共住宅群；一栋叫 棟。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.3.no.en: A group of public housing blocks built together; one block is 棟.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.4.no.zh: 也指事情做到一半：計画の半ばで。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.4.no.en: It also means halfway through something: 計画の半ばで.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.5.no.zh: 书面，稍微：幾分楽になった。比 少し 正式。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.5.no.en: Written style, slightly: 幾分楽になった. More formal than 少し.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.6.no.zh: 也说 楽しい時を過ごす。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.6.no.en: 楽しい時を過ごす is also common.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.7.no.en: The act of going once around.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.8.no.zh: 指隐约感到的动静、征兆。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.8.no.en: A faint sign or stirring you sense.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.10.n.zh: 不许从这儿穿过去；通り抜ける 是穿过去的动词。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.10.n.en: You may not cut through here; the verb is 通り抜ける.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.11.n.zh: 写在地上的禁止驶入，也指那个路障本身。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.11.n.en: No entry painted on the ground, and also the barrier itself.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.12.n.zh: 大小：大小さまざま、物の大小を問わない。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.12.n.en: Size: 大小さまざま, and 物の大小を問わない (whatever the size).

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.13.n.en: The transitive partner is 漂わせる.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.14.m.en: fill the air with; let drift

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.14.n.en: The intransitive partner is 漂う.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.15.m.en: along the pond; beside the pond

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.15.n.zh: 沿い 表沿着：川沿い、線路沿い。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.15.n.en: 沿い means along: 川沿い, 線路沿い.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.16.n.zh: 窄小的路：公園の小道。比 道 更细。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.16.n.en: A narrow path: 公園の小道. Finer than 道.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.17.n.zh: 球场替补席也用 ベンチ。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.17.n.en: The bench on a sports field is also ベンチ.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.18.n.en: It is not read らくよう.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.19.n.zh: 说不清理由的感觉：何だかさびしい。比 なんとなく 更口语。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.19.n.en: A feeling you cannot pin down: 何だかさびしい. More colloquial than なんとなく.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.20.n.en: Here it means sunlight, not a date.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.21.n.zh: 読書の秋 是常用说法。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.21.n.en: 読書の秋 is a common phrase.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.23.n.en: Stealing a break from a busy stretch.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.24.n.zh: 多形容天气、海面、人的性情。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.24.n.en: Mostly for weather, the sea and people's temperaments.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.25.n.en: The active form is 包む.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.27.n.zh: 大家：皆さん、皆で行く；口语常说 みんな。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.27.n.en: Everyone: 皆さん, 皆で行く. Speech often says みんな.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.28.n.en: The opposite is 減少する.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.30.n.en: 価値 plus 観, a way of seeing worth.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.31.n.en: Cities, industries and relationships growing forward.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.32.n.zh: 与 焼酎、ビール 并列：日本酒を飲む。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.32.n.en: It sits alongside 焼酎 and ビール: 日本酒を飲む.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.33.n.zh: 比自己早入行、早入学的人。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.33.n.en: Someone who started school or work before you.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.34.n.zh: 也指得意洋洋：得意になる。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.34.n.en: It also means getting smug: 得意になる.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.35.n.zh: 游戏用的软件；硬件是 ハード。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.35.n.en: Software for games; the hardware is ハード.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.36.n.zh: 比 支援 口语；体制说 サポート体制。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.36.n.en: More colloquial than 支援; the support system is サポート体制.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.37.n.en: An organisation formed by a group of people.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.38.n.zh: 也说 ターゲット層，指目标人群。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.38.n.en: ターゲット層 names the target group.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.39.n.zh: 比 勉強 更偏知识获得；补习班是 学習塾。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.39.n.en: More about acquiring knowledge than 勉強; a cram school is 学習塾.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.41.n.zh: 也说 寄付を募る，指募捐。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.41.n.en: 寄付を募る means to collect donations.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.43.m.en: to finish; to make an end of

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.44.n.zh: 种田的人家：農家に生まれる。也说 農家の人。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.44.n.en: A farming household: 農家に生まれる. 農家の人 also works.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.45.n.zh: 化 表转成某种状态：都市化、高齢化、国際化。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.45.n.en: 化 turns a noun into a state: 都市化, 高齢化, 国際化.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.46.n.en: The transitive partner is 進める.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.47.n.zh: 比 景色 更偏整体。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.47.n.en: More about the whole scene than 景色.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.48.n.zh: 生活＋環境 的复合词。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.48.n.en: A compound of 生活 and 環境.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.49.n.en: The opposite is 中小企業.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.50.m.en: advance (into a new market, industry, etc.); expansion (into)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.50.n.zh: 比 参加 更主动扩张。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.50.n.en: More aggressive expansion than 参加.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.51.n.en: It also means the two directions, east and west.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.52.n.en: The transitive partner is 広げる.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.53.n.zh: 铁路系统：鉄道で行く。单条线叫 路線。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.53.n.en: The rail system: 鉄道で行く. A single line is 路線.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.54.n.zh: 一条线叫 路線，整个系统叫 鉄道。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.54.n.en: One line is 路線; the whole system is 鉄道.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.55.n.zh: 四个方向合起来说；日语列方位时从 北 开始。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.55.n.en: The four directions together; Japanese lists them starting from 北.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.56.n.zh: 中学生＋高校生 的缩略；大学生说 大学生。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.56.n.en: A contraction of 中学生 and 高校生; university students are 大学生.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.57.n.zh: 接近全部：ほぼ完成した。比 だいたい 更接近百分之百。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.57.n.en: Nearly all: ほぼ完成した. Closer to one hundred percent than だいたい.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.58.n.zh: 部 表区域：中央部、北部、周辺部。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.58.n.en: 部 marks a zone: 中央部, 北部, 周辺部.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.59.n.zh: 书面；口语说 にある。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.59.n.en: Written style; speech says にある.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.60.n.zh: 也说 面積が狭い、面積が小さい。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.60.n.en: 面積が狭い and 面積が小さい mean a small area.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.61.m.en: central part; heart (of a city, etc.)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.61.n.zh: 与 周辺部 相对。

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.62.n.zh: 天皇居住的宫殿，在东京千代田；旧称 江戸城。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.62.n.en: The emperor's residence in Chiyoda, Tokyo; formerly 江戸城.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.63.n.zh: 跡 表遗址：城跡；皇居就建在它上面。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.63.n.en: 跡 marks a site: 城跡. The Imperial Palace stands on it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.64.n.zh: 普通公寓是 マンション。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.64.n.en: An ordinary flat is マンション.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.65.n.zh: 东京地名里极多，如 乃木坂。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.65.n.en: Tokyo place names are full of them, such as 乃木坂.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.66.n.zh: 公园里还有 すべり台、砂場。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.66.n.en: Parks also have すべり台 and 砂場.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.67.n.en: The noun form is 設置.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.69.n.zh: 过去某时，书面：かつては海だった。口语说 昔。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.69.n.en: At one time in the past, written: かつては海だった. Speech says 昔.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.70.n.zh: 书面、正式：現在の状況。口语说 今。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.70.n.en: Written and formal: 現在の状況. Speech says 今.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.71.n.zh: ユニセックス＝不分男女；服装、香水都用这个词。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.71.n.en: ユニセックス means unisex; it is used for clothes and perfume alike.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.73.n.en: It means the ornament worn in the hole.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.74.n.zh: 在前项之上再加一层：安い。しかもおいしい。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.74.n.en: It adds a layer on top of the first point: 安い。しかもおいしい。

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.75.n.zh: 后接否定表完全不：全くわからない；单独说 全く 表示无语。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.75.n.en: With a negative it means not at all: 全くわからない. Said alone, 全く expresses exasperation.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.76.m.en: in a row; in a long line

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.76.n.en: A mimetic word for a long, orderly row.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.77.n.zh: 入场式的旗手拿的就是它。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.77.n.en: It is what the flag bearer carries at the opening ceremony.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.78.n.en: It also means glorious: 輝かしい.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.79.n.zh: オリンピック 的简称；五环标志也说 五輪。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.79.n.en: A short form of オリンピック; the five rings are also 五輪.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.80.n.en: A compound of 閉会 and 式.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.81.n.en: The head of the delegation is 団長.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.83.m.en: to serve as; to act as

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.83.n.en: To hold a role or a post.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.84.n.en: It is a common opening in letters.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.85.n.zh: 一天比一天：日増しに寒くなる。书面。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.85.n.en: Day by day: 日増しに寒くなる. Written style.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.86.m.en: to change color (of leaves in autumn); to turn red

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.86.n.en: The transitive partner is 色づける.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.88.n.zh: 季节一到商店就循环播放。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.88.n.en: Shops loop them once the season comes.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.90.n.zh: 最近这些年：近年増えている。书面。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.90.n.en: In recent years: 近年増えている. Written style.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.91.m.en: performance (as opposed to practice); going before an audience or on-air

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.91.n.zh: 也说 本番に強い，指越到正场越稳。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.91.n.en: 本番に強い means performing better when it counts.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.92.n.zh: 期待已久的事就要来：いよいよ明日だ。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.92.n.en: Something long awaited is about to happen: いよいよ明日だ.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.93.m.en: full bloom (esp. of cherry blossom); full blossom

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.94.n.zh: 海和山并列成词：海山を望む。也见于地名。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.94.n.en: Sea and mountains together: 海山を望む. It also appears in place names.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.95.n.zh: 比 会いたい 更带情怀。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.95.n.en: More nostalgic than 会いたい.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.97.n.zh: 程度猛烈：雨が激しい、激しい運動。反义 穏やか，两者常成对。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.97.n.en: Violent in degree: 雨が激しい, 激しい運動. The opposite is 穏やか, and the two are often taught together.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.98.n.zh: 反复叮嘱：くれぐれもお体に気をつけて。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.98.n.en: Said when urging someone again and again: くれぐれもお体に気をつけて.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.100..zh: 比 傾く 更静态。

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.101..en: The side that faces you directly.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.102..en: It covers the other side of a street and of a table.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.103..en: foot (of a mountain or hill); bottom

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.105..en: Used for the orientation of buildings and land.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.106..en: to touch; to come in contact with

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.106..zh: 也指待人：丁寧に接する。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.106..en: It also means how you treat people: 丁寧に接する.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.107..zh: 多条线路集中的总站；单个站牌是 バス停。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.107..en: A terminal where many routes gather; a single stop is バス停.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.108..zh: 小高的丘：丘の上。比 山 低。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.108..en: A low hill: 丘の上. Lower than 山.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.109..zh: 指一串连起来的岛：日本列島、千島列島。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.109..en: A chain of islands: 日本列島, 千島列島.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.110..zh: 也说 太平洋側；日本气候分 太平洋側 与 日本海側。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.110..en: 太平洋側 is also common; Japan's climate is split into 太平洋側 and 日本海側.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.111..zh: 多用于规模大的东西；日常说 作る。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.111..en: Mostly for large things; everyday speech uses 作る.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.113..en: Here it means arriving, not visiting.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.94.n.en: Here it means arriving, not visiting.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.114..zh: 被动 包まれる 常说。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.114..en: The passive 包まれる is common.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.115..zh: コース 表路线：散歩コース、ゴルフコース。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.115..en: コース marks a route: 散歩コース, ゴルフコース.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.117..zh: 建筑、街道等呈现的样貌或气氛。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.word.117..en: The look or atmosphere a building or street presents.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 过了九月中旬，早晚凉了一些，变得好过多了。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: Past the middle of September the mornings and evenings have cooled a little, and it has become easier to live.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「〜を過ぎ」表示越过某个时间点；「涼しくなって」的「〜くなる」是形容词的变化形，接「過ごしやすくなりました」形成连续变化。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: を過ぎ marks passing a point in time; 涼しくなって and 過ごしやすくなりました chain two くなる changes with て.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 我住的公寓附近有个叫三井公园的公园。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: Near the apartment where I live there is a park called Mii Park.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「私の住む」是名词修饰节，用动词普通形直接修饰「アパート」；「〜という公園」给名字加注。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: 私の住む is a relative clause in plain form before アパート; という attaches the name.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 从公寓走着绕公园一圈再回来，大约45分钟。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: Walking from the apartment around the park and back takes about forty-five minutes.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「〜てくると」的「と」表示“一……就（是）……”，把结果直接引出（45分钟），句末省略了「かかります」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: と leads straight to the result (45 minutes); かかります is left out at the end.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 正好是合适的散步路线，所以休息日的早晨我常去。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: It is just the right walking course, so I often go on holiday mornings.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 那座三井公园也渐渐显出秋意了。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: That park, too, is beginning to show signs of autumn.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「〜つつある」＝“正在逐渐……”，书面语，表示变化正在进行；「見せつつある」＝“开始显出”。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: つつある is the written progressive of change; 見せつつある is “is beginning to show”.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 我来介绍一下这个公园。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: Let me introduce the park.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 第一张照片是从公园入口拍的。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: The first photo was taken from the park entrance.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「〜たものだ」把过去的事作为回忆叙述；「撮ったものです」说明这张照片是“拍下来的”，指照片的来源。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: たものだ presents the past as recollection; 撮ったものです explains where the photo came from.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 这个公园禁止自行车穿行，所以入口处设了挡自行车的栏杆。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: Bicycles may not pass through the park, so barriers are set up at the entrance.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「禁止なので」用「ので」给出客观原因；「作られています」是被动＋「ている」，表示“被设置着”的状态。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: 禁止なので gives the objective reason with ので; 作られています is passive plus ている, a resulting state.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 公园是围绕一大一小两个池塘建造的。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: The park is built around two ponds, one large and one small.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「〜を中心に」＝“以……为中心”；被动「造られています」把建造者隐去，突出布局本身。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: を中心に means “centred on”; the passive 造られています hides the builder.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 这张照片是较小的那个池塘。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: This photo shows the smaller pond.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「〜ほう」在两者中取一方——“较小的那个”。前一句提到大小两个池，这里用「ほう」回指。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: ほう picks one of two — “the smaller one”.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 这个小池比大池更接近自然，透着宁静的景致。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: This pond is closer to nature than the large one and has a quiet air about it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「AのほうがBより…」是比较句的标准框架，用「ほう」明确比较的一方；「漂わせています」是他动词的「ている」形，表示状态呈现。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: AのほうがBより… is the standard comparison; 漂わせています is a transitive ている describing a state.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 沿池边的小路走一点就有长椅。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: A little way along the path by the pond there is a bench.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「〜たところに」＝“在……的地方”，把动作的结果当作位置；「池沿いの小道を少し行った」修饰「ところ」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: たところに means “at the place where…”; 池沿いの小道を少し行った modifies ところ.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 满是落叶，总觉得很有秋天的样子吧。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: It is covered with fallen leaves, a scene that somehow feels like autumn.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「〜でしょう」在这里不是推测，而是向读者确认、寻求同感——“很有秋天的感觉吧”。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: でしょう here seeks the reader's agreement rather than predicting.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 常看到有人坐在这张长椅上，一边晒着秋日的阳光一边读书。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: I often see people sitting on this bench reading in the autumn sun.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「〜ながら」表示两个动作同时进行——“一边……一边……”；「見かけます」是“常看到”的固定说法。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: ながら marks simultaneous actions; 見かけます means “to come across”.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 最后一张照片是孩子们开心玩耍的样子。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: The last photo shows children playing happily.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「遊んでいるものです」用「〜ものだ」说明照片拍的是什么内容，与第6句的「撮ったものです」同一用法。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: 遊んでいるものです uses 〜ものだ to tell what the photo shows, the same pattern as 撮ったものです.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 来公园歇口气的人很多，所以这里笼罩着平和的气氛。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: Many people come here to take a breather, so the park is wrapped in a gentle mood.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「包まれています」是被动＋「ている」，表示“被……包围着”的状态；「息抜きに訪れる」的「に」表示目的。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: 包まれています is passive plus ている; に in 息抜きに訪れる marks purpose.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 住处附近有这样的公园，是一件幸福的事。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: It is a happy thing to have a park like this near where you live.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.zh: 「〜のは…ことです」把整件事名词化后作主题，是评价句的常用框架。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.article.0.en: 〜のは…ことです nominalizes the whole situation as the topic of an evaluation.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.zh: 变化正朝一个方向走，还没走完：正在逐渐……。书面语，带点「大势所趋」的味道。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.en: A change is under way and not finished: gradually becoming. It is written Japanese, and it sounds like a trend.
Vます (drop ます) + つつある

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.zh: 多跟表变化的动词：変わる、増える、減る、なる、明らかになる。「秋の気配を見せつつある」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.en: It pairs with verbs of change: 変わる、増える、減る、なる、明らかになる. Also 秋の気配を見せつつある.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.zh: 只能配「朝某方向变化」的动词，接「食べる」「行く」这类具体动作就怪。口语里更常说「～てきている」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.en: Only verbs of directed change fit; concrete actions like 食べる or 行く do not. Speech prefers ～てきている.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.zh: 三井公园也正逐渐显露秋天的气息。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.en: Sani Park is also emerging as the autumn season unfolds.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.zh: 事故的原因正在逐渐明朗。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.en: The causes of the accident are becoming clear.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.zh: 人们对工作的价值观正在发生变化。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.en: The value of people working is changing.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.zh: 拿一个东西当圆心，其他都围着它展开：以……为中心。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.en: One thing sits at the centre and everything else arranges itself around it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.zh: N＋を中心に（也作 を中心として／を中心にして）
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.en: N + を中心に (also を中心として / を中心にして)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.zh: 「池を中心に造られた公園」「東京を中心に経済が発展している」「若い女性を中心に注目されている」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.en: 池を中心に造られた公園, 東京を中心に経済が発展している, 若い女性を中心に注目されている.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.zh: 别和「をはじめ」混：那个是「以……为首」的列举，这个是空间或人群的圆心。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.en: Not the same as をはじめ, which heads a list. This one is a literal or figurative centre.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.zh: 公园围绕一大一小两个池塘建造。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.en: The park is built around a large, small two ponds.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.zh: 日本以东京为中心发展经济。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.en: Japan has an economy centred on Tokyo.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.zh: 日本酒正受到以年轻女性为主的人群的关注。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.en: The Japanese wine is receiving attention from a predominantly young female population.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.zh: 顺着走、做完某个移动动作之后到达的那个地点：走过一段路的地方。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.en: The spot you reach after moving: the place a little further along.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.zh: Vた＋ところに（存在的地点）／Vた＋ところで（动作发生的地点）
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.en: Vた + ところに (where something is) / Vた + ところで (where something happens)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.zh: 「まっすぐ行ったところにトイレがある」「次の信号を渡ったところで止めてください」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.en: まっすぐ行ったところにトイレがある; 次の信号を渡ったところで止めてください.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.zh: 这里的「ところ」是地点，不是时间。表示「刚刚做完」的「たところだ」是另一回事。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.en: Here ところ means place, not time. The たところだ that means "just finished" is a different animal.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.zh: 沿池边小路走一小段，就有长椅。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.en: There are benches for a small walk along the edge of the pool.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.zh: 直走过去的地方有洗手间。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.en: There's a bathroom where you go straight over.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.zh: 请在过了下一个信号灯的地方停车。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.en: Please stop at the next light.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.zh: 自己能决定做不做的，是意志动词；存在、自然现象、能力、感知这类控制不了的，是非意志动词。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.en: Volitional verbs are the ones you choose to do. Existence, weather, ability and perception are outside your control.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.zh: 意志：行く・作る・相談する；非意志：ある・分かる・できる・見える・降る・吹く
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.en: volitional: 行く・作る・相談する; non-volitional: ある・分かる・できる・見える・降る・吹く

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.zh: 判断能不能接「～たい」「～ましょう」「～てください」时，先看动词属于哪一类。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.en: Before attaching ～たい, ～ましょう or ～てください, check which class the verb belongs to.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.zh: 可能形「行ける」属于非意志：「能去」不是想做就能做。别因为原动词是意志动词就当成意志动词。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.en: The potential 行ける is non-volitional: being able to go is not the same as choosing to. Don't inherit the class from the base verb.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.zh: 休息日的早晨，我经常去公园。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.en: In the morning of the rest day, I often go to the park.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.zh: 将来想创办自己的公司。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.en: I want to start my own company.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.zh: 打算明天向前辈请教工作方面的事。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.en: It is intended to teach the past about work tomorrow.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.zh: 沿小路走一小段的地方有长椅。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.en: There's benches for a little walk along the trail.
You can see the sea from here.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.zh: 从昨晚起一直刮着大风。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.en: The wind has been blowing since last night.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.zh: 「很像……的样子」：把某类东西的典型特征点出来。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.en: It names the typical traits of a category: thoroughly so-and-so.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.zh: N＋らしい／らしさ（名词）／らしく（修饰动词）
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.en: N + らしい / らしさ (noun) / らしく (before a verb)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.zh: 「秋らしい景色」「学生なら学生らしく」「子供らしさを大切にする」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.en: 秋らしい景色, 学生なら学生らしく, 子供らしさを大切にする.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.zh: 这是「典型性」的らしい，不是传闻的らしい。传闻那个前面接整句（雨が降るらしい），这个前面只接名词。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.en: This is the "typical" らしい, not the hearsay one. Hearsay takes a full clause (雨が降るらしい); this takes a bare noun.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.zh: 到处是落叶，总觉得很有秋天的景致吧。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.en: There's leaves everywhere. It's always a good fall.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.zh: 既然是学生，就要像个学生那样学习。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.en: If you're a student, you have to learn like a student.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.zh: 这所幼儿园很重视孩子的童真。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.en: The kindergarten values the child as a child.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.zh: 从外表看出来的神情：显得……、看上去……。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.en: The look on someone's face or in their manner: visibly so.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.zh: い形去い／な形去だ＋げ；修饰名词用「げな」，修饰动词用「げに」
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.en: い-adj drop い / な-adj drop だ + げ; げな before nouns, げに before verbs

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.zh: 楽しげ、悲しげ、寂しげ、恥ずかしげ、得意げ。「子供たちが楽しげに遊んでいる」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.en: 楽しげ、悲しげ、寂しげ、恥ずかしげ、得意げ. Also 子供たちが楽しげに遊んでいる.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.zh: 只描述别人外在的神情，不用于长辈上级，也不用于自己：说「私が悲しげ」很怪。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.en: It describes someone else's outward look. Not for superiors, and not for yourself: 私が悲しげ sounds wrong.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.zh: 他带着得意的神情展示了最新的游戏软件。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.en: He showed up-to-date game software with a great look.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.1.m.en: To pass; to spend time; fault.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.2.e.en: I get up at six in the morning.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.4.e.en: It gets cooler in the evening.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.6.e.en: I take a walk every morning.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.7.e.en: It is a ten-minute walk to the station.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.9.e.en: I am waiting at the station exit.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.10..en: May I take a photo here?

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.11..en: You cannot pass through this street.
To pull out; to pass through.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.15..en: Please be quiet in the library.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.17..en: Please go straight along this road.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.18..en: I take a shower in the morning.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.19..en: I take a break between tasks.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.21..en: To wrap a present in paper.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.kanji.22..en: I live happily with my family.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.zh: ます形「減ります」からますを取って「減りつつある」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.0.en: ます形「減ります」からますを取って「減りつつある」。

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.zh: 「つつある」表示变化正在逐渐进行，并非已经完成。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.1.en: つつある indicates that changes are being made gradually and not already completed.
The cause is gradually becoming clear.
The cause will remain unclear in the future.
The cause has been fully identified.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.zh: 以车站为中心发展，用を中心に。にとって表示评价立场，に代わって表示替代，に加えて表示追加。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.2.en: Central to the station, を中心に. にとって indicates an evaluation position, に代わって replaces and に加えて adds.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.zh: 存在句「店があります」用に标示地点。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.3.en: Use に to mark the location in the existence sentence 店があります.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.zh: 拍照是动作，在动作发生地点后用で。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.4.en: Photographing is an action, using で after the action has occurred.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.zh: 「相談する」是可以由本人决定是否进行的行为。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.en: "相談する" is an act that can be decided by the person.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.zh: 「行ける」是可能形式，表示能否去，不是去这一意志行为本身。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.en: " 行ける " is a Potential form, meaning that it is possible to go, not to the act of will itself.
らしく modifies the verb 勉強する.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.zh: 「らしさ」是名词形式，表示孩子应有的特点或童真。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.en: "らしさ" is a form of noun that represents the child 's desired characteristics or childhood.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.zh: 「～げ」按な形容词使用，修饰名词「顔」用「得意げな」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.5.grammar.5.en: ～げ behaves like a na-adjective. Use 得意げな to modify 顔.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.0.me.en: setsubun; last day of winter in the traditional Japanese calendar (usu. February 3 or 4) on which a bean scattering ceremony is held

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.0.no.zh: 立春前一天；有撒豆驱鬼、朝吉方吃卷寿司的习俗。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.0.no.en: The day before the first day of spring, with customs of scattering beans and eating a roll facing the lucky direction.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.1.no.zh: 日本习惯女性送巧克力，分 義理チョコ 和 本命チョコ。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.1.no.en: In Japan women usually give the chocolate, split into 義理チョコ and 本命チョコ.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.2.no.zh: 接时间、数量表大约：3時前後、100人前後；比 ごろ 可用于数量。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.2.no.en: After a time or number it means around: 3時前後, 100人前後. Unlike ごろ, it also works with counts.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.3.me.zh: 盛夏的丑日（日本有吃鳗鱼的习俗）
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.3.me.en: the midsummer Day of the Ox (traditionally a day to eat eel)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.3.no.zh: 夏季土用里的丑日，日本有吃鳗鱼的习俗；每年日期不同。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.3.no.en: The ox day within the midsummer 土用 period, when Japan eats eel; the date shifts each year.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.4.no.zh: 粗卷，惠方卷就是它；细卷叫 細巻き。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.4.no.en: The thick roll, which 恵方巻き is made from; a thin roll is 細巻き.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.5.no.zh: 正月吃的冷菜拼盒，每样都有寓意；お 是固定说法。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.5.no.en: The cold assortment of dishes eaten at New Year, each with a meaning; the お is fixed.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.6.me.en: grilled eel glazed with a sweet soy-based sauce

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.6.no.zh: 剖开蘸酱烤的鳗鱼；かば焼き 也用于其他鱼。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.6.no.en: Eel split open, dipped in sauce and grilled; かば焼き is used for other fish too.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.7.no.zh: 单说 平均 更笼统。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.7.no.en: 平均 on its own is vaguer.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.8.no.zh: 数 在这里是几的意思。

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.9.me.en: to jump up; to spring up

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.9.no.en: It implies a sudden, large jump.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.10.m.en: eel (esp. the Japanese eel, Anguilla japonica)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.10.n.zh: 夏天吃它补体力；土用の丑の日 是惯例。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.10.n.en: Eaten in summer for stamina; 土用の丑の日 is the custom.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.11.n.zh: 指 1603 到 1868 的武家时代；东京旧名 江戸 由此而来。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.11.n.en: The warrior era from 1603 to 1868; Tokyo's old name 江戸 comes from it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.12.m.en: suffering from summer heat; summer heat fatigue

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.12.n.zh: 热得没胃口、没力气；也写作 夏負け。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.12.n.en: Losing appetite and energy in the heat; also written 夏負け.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.13.n.zh: 也说 夏ばて防止，作复合名词。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.13.n.en: 夏ばて防止 is the compound noun form.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.14.n.zh: 广告里那句文案；比 キャッチコピー 更偏宣传。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.14.n.en: The line of copy in an ad; more about promotion than キャッチコピー.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.15.n.zh: 比 時期 有明确起止。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.15.n.en: Unlike 時期, it has clear start and end points.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.16.n.zh: 指新事物普及后稳定下来。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.16.n.en: A new thing spreading and then settling in place.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.17.n.zh: 本课指起源、由来；也指原来的状态。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.17.n.en: Here it means the origin or source; it also means the former state.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.18.n.zh: 当年的吉方每年不同；吃卷寿司时朝它不说话。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.18.n.en: The lucky direction changes each year; you face it in silence while eating the roll.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.19.n.zh: 比 方角 更笼统。

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.20.m.en: to turn toward; to look (up, down, etc.)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.20.n.en: It also means being suited to something: 商売に向く.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.21.n.zh: 行业里的大公司：大手企業、大手スーパー；反义 中小。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.21.n.en: A big player in an industry: 大手企業, 大手スーパー. The opposite is 中小.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.22.n.zh: コンビニ＋チェーン；一家店说 コンビニ。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.22.n.en: コンビニ plus チェーン; one shop is just コンビニ.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.23.m.en: to bring in; to take in

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.23.n.zh: 也指把习惯、问题带进来。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.23.n.en: It also means bringing in habits or problems.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.24.n.en: The intransitive partner is 広まる.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.25.n.zh: 买卖行业：商業が盛ん。形容词形是 商業的。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.25.n.en: The buying and selling trade: 商業が盛ん. The adjective form is 商業的.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.26.n.zh: 接在名词后表主张：商業主義、平和主義。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.26.n.en: After a noun it means a doctrine: 商業主義, 平和主義.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.27.m.en: to give (as a gift); to present

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.27.n.zh: 比 あげる 正式，带仪式感。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.27.n.en: More formal and ceremonial than あげる.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.28.n.zh: 黄油；也说 バターソース。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.28.n.en: Butter; バターソース is butter sauce.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.29.m.en: be insufficient; be in short supply

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.29.n.zh: 名词形 不足；睡眠不足 是常用复合词。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.29.n.en: The noun is 不足; 睡眠不足 is a common compound.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.30.n.zh: 鱼类、食品类等的类：魚類、食料品類。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.30.n.en: The class of things: 魚類, 食料品類.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.31.n.zh: 比 確認する 多了改动。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.31.n.en: Unlike 確認する, it implies changes.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.32.m.en: yakiniku; Japanese dish of grilled meat similar to Korean barbecue

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.32.n.zh: 多指韩式烤牛肉猪肉；烤鸡肉串是 焼き鳥。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.32.n.en: Usually Korean-style grilled beef and pork; grilled chicken skewers are 焼き鳥.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.34.m.en: to be reborn; to be reincarnated

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.34.n.en: It also refers to the next life.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.35.n.zh: 打工是 バイト，不算 就職。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.35.n.en: Part-time work is バイト, not 就職.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.36.n.zh: 养殖产量是 養殖量。

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.37.n.zh: ます形＋続ける 表持续。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.37.n.en: The stem plus 続ける marks continuation.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.38.n.en: The clearest way to show shares.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.39.m.en: to account for; to make up

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.39.n.en: How large a share, which position.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.40.n.zh: 看变化趋势；柱状图是 棒グラフ。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.40.n.en: Shows the trend over time; a bar chart is 棒グラフ.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.41.n.en: A compound of 自給 and 率.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.42.n.zh: 像鳗鱼一样往上窜，只用于上涨：値段がうなぎ上り。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.42.n.en: Shooting up like an eel; only for rises: 値段がうなぎ上り.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.43.n.zh: 伸びる 的名词；增长率说 伸び率。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.43.n.en: The noun from 伸びる; the growth rate is 伸び率.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.44.m.en: to be conspicuous; to stand out

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.44.n.zh: 他动词 目立たせる。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.44.n.en: The transitive partner is 目立たせる.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.45.n.en: On a graph it is a flat line.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.46.n.zh: 比大小；折线图是 折れ線グラフ。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.46.n.en: For comparing sizes; a line chart is 折れ線グラフ.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.47.m.en: production output; number of goods manufactured

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.47.n.zh: 与 消費量 相对。

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.48.n.zh: 说 最大手 是行业第一。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.48.n.en: 最大手 means the leader in an industry.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.49.n.zh: 列举排第二：Aが最大で、次いでB。书面。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.49.n.en: Names the runner-up: Aが最大で、次いでB. Written style.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.50.m.en: country of origin; country of manufacture

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.50.n.zh: 生产＋国：生産国第一位；消费国是 消費国。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.50.n.en: 生産 plus 国: 生産国第一位. A consuming country is 消費国.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.51.n.zh: 期 表阶段：成長期、安定期、過渡期。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.51.n.en: 期 marks a phase: 成長期, 安定期, 過渡期.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.52.n.zh: 也说 習慣化を目指す。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.52.n.en: 習慣化を目指す is also common.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.53.n.zh: 受影响说 影響を受ける。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.53.n.en: Being influenced is 影響を受ける.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.54.n.en: It also means prices holding steady.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.55.n.zh: 扎实、不马虎：しっかり食べる、しっかり覚える。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.55.n.en: Firmly, without cutting corners: しっかり食べる, しっかり覚える.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.56.m.en: tactile paving (for the blind); bumpy tiling

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.56.n.zh: 站台上那条黄色凸起；点字＋ブロック 的复合词。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.56.n.en: The yellow ridged strip on platforms; a compound of 点字 and ブロック.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.57.n.zh: 书面、构词用：食文化、食卓；日常说 食べ物。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.57.n.en: Written and used in compounds: 食文化, 食卓. Speech says 食べ物.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.58.m.zh: 人与人之间的纽带；情感联系

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.59.m.en: sense of the seasons; feeling of seasonality

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.59.n.zh: 也说 季節感を大切にする。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.59.n.en: 季節感を大切にする also works.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.60.m.en: season (for fruit, seafood, etc.); best time of the year (for)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.60.n.zh: 也指任何事的最佳时期。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.60.n.en: It also means the best time for anything.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.61.n.zh: 做菜用的材料：旬の食材。成品叫 食品。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.61.n.en: Ingredients for cooking: 旬の食材. A finished product is 食品.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.62.n.zh: 比 食べる 更重感受。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.62.n.en: More about the experience than 食べる.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.63.n.zh: 也说 関係している。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.63.n.en: 関係している also works.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.64.n.zh: 只制冷；冷暖两用是 エアコン。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.64.n.en: Cooling only; a unit that does both is エアコン.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.65.n.zh: 现场直播说 生中継。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.65.n.en: A live broadcast is 生中継.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.66.n.en: It also means the net in sports.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.67.n.zh: 消毒用的酒精也说 アルコール。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.67.n.en: The alcohol in disinfectant is also アルコール.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.68.n.zh: 住院的是 入院患者。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.68.n.en: Someone in hospital is an 入院患者.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.69.n.zh: 詐欺＋事件 的复合词。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.69.n.en: A compound of 詐欺 and 事件.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.70.n.zh: 被动 だまされる 常说；汉字写 騙す。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.70.n.en: The passive だまされる is common; written 騙す in kanji.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.71.n.zh: 比 好き 重，带责任感。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.71.n.en: Heavier than 好き and implies commitment.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.72.m.en: washing one's hands; water (or basin, etc.) for washing one's hands

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.72.n.zh: 也指不用洗衣机的手洗。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.72.n.en: It also means washing by hand.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.73.n.zh: 常与 手洗い 连说。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.73.n.en: It usually comes with 手洗い.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.74.m.zh: 食用期限；应在此日期前食用
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.74.m.en: expiry date (esp. on food); expiration date

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.74.n.en: The safety deadline by which it must be eaten.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.75.n.zh: 食品浪费说 食品ロス。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.75.n.en: Food waste is 食品ロス.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.76.n.zh: 摂取＋カロリー 的复合词。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.76.n.en: A compound of 摂取 and カロリー.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.78.n.en: The sex field on a form.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.79.n.zh: 热量单位，写作 kcal；口语常说 キロカロリー。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.79.n.en: A unit of energy written kcal; speech often says キロカロリー.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.80.n.zh: 給食＝供餐：学校給食、給食の時間。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.80.n.en: 給食 is a served meal: 学校給食, 給食の時間.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.81.n.zh: 没加热的：生卵、生魚。读 なま。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.81.n.en: Not cooked: 生卵, 生魚. It is read なま.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.82.n.zh: 包装上写 加熱用、加熱済み。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.82.n.en: Packaging says 加熱用 or 加熱済み.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.83.n.zh: 全国＋一 表第一：生産量が全国一。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.83.n.en: 全国 plus 一 for first place: 生産量が全国一.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.84.n.zh: 也说 一年を通して，指一整年都。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.84.n.en: 一年を通して means throughout the whole year.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.85.n.zh: 別 表按什么分：月別、国別、クラス別。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.85.n.en: 別 marks the basis of a breakdown: 月別, 国別, クラス別.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.86.n.en: It also means one-way: 一方通行.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.87.n.zh: 酸味：すっぱい梅干し。写作 酸っぱい。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.87.n.en: Sourness: すっぱい梅干し. Written 酸っぱい.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.88.n.en: A clean taste that leaves no greasy coating.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.89.n.zh: 油多、吃着腻；比 脂っこい 更常用。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.89.n.en: Oily and heavy; more common than 脂っこい.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.90.n.zh: 介于 外食 和 内食 之间。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.90.n.en: It sits between 外食 and 内食.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.91.n.zh: 某个限度、某种程度：一定の効果、一定の期間。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.91.n.en: A certain limit or degree: 一定の効果, 一定の期間.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.92.m.en: to be decided; to be settled

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.92.n.en: The transitive partner is 決める.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.95.n.zh: 一整年都：1年中ある。也写作 一年中。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.95.n.en: All year round: 1年中ある. Also written 一年中.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.99.m.zh: 惠方卷；朝吉利方向吃的寿司卷
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.99.m.en: ehomaki (sushi roll eaten facing a lucky direction)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.99.n.zh: 节分朝吉方整根吃掉、期间不说话；关西起源，现全国都有。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.99.n.en: Eaten whole at Setsubun facing the lucky direction, in silence; it began in Kansai and is now nationwide.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.104..en: in one go; all at once

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.104..zh: 一口气、一下子：一気に飲む、一気に進む。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.word.104..en: In one go, all at once: 一気に飲む, 一気に進む.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 在日本，一年四季都能买到烤鳗鱼。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: In Japan you can buy grilled eel all year round.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 然而在“土用丑日”（7月20日前后），其销售额会飙升到年平均的二十几倍。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: But on the day of the ox in midsummer (around July 20) sales jump to more than twenty times the yearly average.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 「20数倍にも」的「も」强调数量之大；「のだ」用来解释为什么特意提到这个日子，带说明语气。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: も stresses the surprising size of the number; のだ explains the point of mentioning the day.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 对许多人来说，土用丑日大概就是“不吃鳗鱼就过不下去的日子”。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: For many people the day of the ox is “the day you cannot help eating eel.”

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 「〜ずにはいられない」＝“不由得、忍不住……”，表示无法抑制的冲动；这里加引号，是作为一句流行语引用。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: ずにはいられない means “can't help doing”; the quotes present it as a catchphrase.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 土用丑日吃鳗鱼的习惯，似乎源自江户时代“防苦夏吃鳗鱼好”这句广告语。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: The custom of eating eel on that day seems to have come from an Edo-period advertising line: “Eel is good for preventing summer fatigue.”

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 「〜らしい」表示根据传闻或迹象的推测——“似乎”。句末用「生まれたらしい」，说明来源本身并不确定。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: らしい marks an inference from hearsay — here 生まれたらしい leaves the origin uncertain.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 如果真是这样，那这句广告的效果已经持续了两百多年。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: If true, that ad has kept working for more than two hundred years.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 「〜としたら」＝“假如……的话”，提出假设；「〜ことになる」表示“（逻辑上）就成了……”，不是自己决定。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: としたら sets a hypothetical; ことになる states the logical consequence.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 短期内销量集中的商品，除鳗鱼之外还有“情人节巧克力”“圣诞蛋糕”等，而近来逐渐固定下来的是“节分的粗卷寿司”。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: Other products with sales concentrated in a short period include Valentine's chocolate and Christmas cake, and the newest to take hold is the thick rolled sushi of Setsubun.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 「定着しつつある」＝“正在逐渐固定下来”，与第5课同一用法；前面「〜などがあるが」的「が」把话题转向新的例子。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: 定着しつつある is “is gradually taking hold”, the same つつある as lesson 5; が turns the topic to a new example.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 这原本是关西“吃惠方卷”的习惯。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: This was originally a Kansai custom of eating ehomaki.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 据说“节分那天朝着惠方［吉利的方向］，一口气吃完粗卷寿司，那一年就会有好运”。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: It is said that if you face the auspicious direction on Setsubun and eat a whole thick roll in one go, good luck will come that year.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 引号内是完整引用，句末「と言われている」表明这是流传的说法；引用内部「〜と、〜が訪れる」的「と」表示条件结果。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: The quoted clause is capped by と言われている; inside, と links condition to result.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 大型便利店连锁把这个关西的习惯带到了关东并推广开来。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: A major convenience store chain brought this Kansai custom to the Kanto region and spread it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 「この関西の習慣を」提到句首作话题，「大手コンビニチェーンが」才是动作主体；「のだ」补充说明这个习惯的由来。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: この関西の習慣を is fronted as topic; 大手コンビニチェーンが is the real agent, and のだ explains the origin.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 由商业主义催生的新饮食习俗，会像“土用丑日的鳗鱼”那样，两百年后依然留存吗？
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: Will eating habits born of commercialism, like eel on the day of the ox, still be around two hundred years from now?

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.zh: 「〜だろうか」以疑问收尾，把判断留给读者；「〜のように」举例对照，前接「土用のうしの日のうなぎ」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.article.0.en: だろうか closes with an open question; のように compares with 土用のうしの日のうなぎ.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.0.zh: 口语把书面形压短：じゃない、ちゃった、なきゃ、てる、とく、んだ。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.0.en: Speech compresses the written forms: じゃない, ちゃった, なきゃ, てる, とく, んだ.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.0.zh: ではない→じゃない；てしまった→ちゃった；なければ→なきゃ；ている→てる；ておく→とく；のだ→んだ
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.0.en: ではない→じゃない; てしまった→ちゃった; なければ→なきゃ; ている→てる; ておく→とく; のだ→んだ

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.0.zh: 朋友聊天、家里说话。转折用「だけど・けど・でも」代替「しかし・だが」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.0.en: Chatting with friends, talking at home. For contrast, だけど・けど・でも replace しかし・だが.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.0.zh: 缩略只属于口语。写邮件、报告、对上级说话时别用「食べちゃった」「行かなきゃ」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.0.en: Contractions belong to speech. Keep 食べちゃった and 行かなきゃ out of email, reports, and anything said to a superior.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.0.zh: 不在这一天吃，就没有意义。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.0.en: There's no point not eating on this day.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.zh: 站到某人的立场上做评价：对……来说。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.en: Judge from someone's position: as far as they are concerned.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.zh: N＋にとって（后面接判断或评价）
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.en: N + にとって (followed by a judgement or evaluation)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.zh: 「留学生にとって物価が高いのは問題だ」「あなたにとって一番大切なことは何ですか」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.en: 留学生にとって物価が高いのは問題だ; あなたにとって一番大切なことは何ですか.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.zh: 后面必须是对该立场的评价，不能接动作：「私にとって日本へ行きます」不通。表态度要用「に対して」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.en: What follows must be an evaluation, not an action: 私にとって日本へ行きます fails. For attitudes, use に対して.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.zh: 对许多人来说，土用丑日大概就是“忍不住要吃鳗鱼的日子”。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.en: For many people, the ugly day of earth is probably a “day that cannot help but eat eel”.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.zh: 对留学生来说，日本物价高是个问题。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.en: High prices are a problem for students studying abroad.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.zh: 对你来说最重要的事情是什么？
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.en: What's the most important thing to you?

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.zh: 感情或冲动压不住，非做不可：忍不住……。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.en: A feeling or urge you cannot hold back: you just have to.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.zh: Vない（去ない）＋ずにはいられない；する→せずにはいられない
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.en: Vない (drop ない) + ずにはいられない; する→せずにはいられない

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.zh: 「涙を流さずにはいられなかった」「心配せずにいられない」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.en: 涙を流さずにはいられなかった; 心配せずにいられない.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.zh: 它不是义务，是「控制不住」。表义务要用「なければならない」。口语也说「ないではいられない」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.en: This is not obligation but compulsion; obligation takes なければならない. Speech also allows ないではいられない.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.zh: 到了土用丑日就忍不住要吃鳗鱼。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.en: When the earth is ugly, you can't stop eating eels.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.zh: 听到她悲伤的故事时，忍不住流下了眼泪。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.en: When she heard her sad story, she shed tears.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.zh: 一想到住院的朋友，就忍不住担心。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.en: I can't help but worry when I think of a friend in the hospital.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.zh: 根据听到的、看到的迹象下判断，同时跟那件事保持一点距离：据说、好像。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.en: A judgement built on evidence you heard or saw, held slightly at arm's length: apparently.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.zh: 普通形＋らしい；な形词干／N＋らしい（现在肯定不加だ）
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.en: plain form + らしい; な-adj stem / N + らしい (no だ in the present)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.zh: 「うわさでは、あの２人は結婚するらしい」「事故らしい」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.en: うわさでは、あの２人は結婚するらしい; 事故らしい.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.zh: 和「Nらしい」（很像……的样子）不同，这个前面是整句。也别和「ようだ」混：らしい 更强调有客观依据。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.en: Unlike the "typical" Nらしい, this one takes a whole clause. And unlike ようだ, it stresses that there is outside evidence.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.zh: 据说吃鳗鱼的习惯起源于江户时代的宣传文案。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.en: The habit of eating eels is said to have originated in the Edo era propaganda case.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.zh: 听传闻说，那两个人似乎要结婚了。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.en: Rumor has it that those two people are getting married.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.zh: 那个十字路口聚集了很多人。好像是出了事故。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.en: There was a lot of people at that intersection. It was like an accident.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.zh: 先把一个假设摆出来，再想结果或对策：假如……的话。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.en: Pose a hypothetical first, then work out the consequence or the plan.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.zh: 普通形＋としたら；N／な形现在肯定保留「だ」（本当だとしたら）
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.en: plain form + としたら; N / な-adj keep だ (本当だとしたら)

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.zh: 「本当だとしたら」「生まれ変わるとしたら」「留学するのが無理だとしたら」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.en: 本当だとしたら; 生まれ変わるとしたら; 留学するのが無理だとしたら.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.zh: 名词和な形容词要留「だ」：「本当としたら」少了一层。它比「なら」更书面，更像在推演。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.en: Nouns and な-adjectives keep だ: 本当としたら is missing a layer. It is more written and more deliberative than なら.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.zh: 如果是真的，就意味着效果延续了两百多年。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.en: If it were true, it meant that the effects had lasted for more than 200 years.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.zh: 如果可以重新投胎，你想成为女性还是男性？
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.en: If you can re-enter, do you want to be a woman or a man?

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.zh: 如果今年也无法留学，这一次就必须就业了。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.en: If it is not possible to study this year, it will have to be employed this time.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.zh: 三个「变成」：一个推结果，一个说规定，一个说自己定的习惯。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.en: Three ways of "ending up": one infers a result, one states a rule, one records a personal habit.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.zh: （という）ことになる＝推论结果；ことになっている＝既定规定；ことにしている＝自己的习惯
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.en: (という)ことになる = inferred result; ことになっている = established rule; ことにしている = own habit

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.zh: 「続いていることになる」（推出来）、「１週間取れることになっている」（公司规定）、「ジョギングをすることにしている」（我自己定的）。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.en: 続いていることになる (inferred), １週間取れることになっている (company rule), ジョギングをすることにしている (my own habit).

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.zh: 前两个都不是自己决定的：「ことにしている」才是「我决定这样做」。用错就把规定说成了个人习惯。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.en: The first two are not your decision; only ことにしている means "I chose this". Mix them up and a rule becomes a habit.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.zh: 如果是真的，就意味着效果延续了两百多年。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.en: If it were true, it meant that the effects had lasted for more than 200 years.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.zh: 如果鳗鱼捕捞量继续这样减少，将来土用丑日恐怕就吃不到鳗鱼了。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.en: If the eels catch continues to decline this way, it is feared that they will not be able to be eaten in the future in an ugly day.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.zh: 如果今天之内还没收到他参加聚会的回复，就视为他不参加。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.en: If he has not received a reply from the party within today, he will be deemed not to have participated.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.zh: 我们公司规定可以休一周暑假。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.en: Our company has a week's summer break.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.zh: 为了健康，我坚持傍晚慢跑一小时。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.en: In the interest of health, I insisted on jogging for an hour in the evening.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.6.zh: 说图表用「～％を占める」「～割を占める」，1割就是10%。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.6.en: Chart talk uses ～％を占める or ～割を占める, and 1割 equals 10%.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.6.zh: 「20代の男性では18.3％を占めている」「全体の3割を占める」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.6.en: 20代の男性では18.3％を占めている; 全体の3割を占める.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.6.zh: 「占める」前面是比例，不是人数；要说人数得写成「～人が…％を占める」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.6.en: The thing before 占める is a proportion, not a headcount: for people, write ～人が…％を占める.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.6.zh: 早晨什么都不吃的人，在60多岁男性中占1.6％，而在20多岁男性中占18.3％。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.6.en: In the morning, 1.6 per cent of males in their 60s and 18.3 per cent of men in their 20s eat nothing.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.6.zh: 这家店销售额的一半以上由年轻女顾客贡献。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.6.en: Young female customers account for more than half of this shop's sales.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.6.zh: 据调查，独居老人约占总体的两成。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.6.en: According to the survey, elderly people living alone make up about 20 percent of the total.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.kanji.1.e.en: We grill fish and eat it.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.kanji.5.e.en: I read about the Edo period.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.kanji.7.e.en: I am not good with hot summers.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.kanji.8.e.zh: 为防止事故要多加注意。

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.kanji.12..en: This product is available for a limited time.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.kanji.13..en: People are gathering in front of the station.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.kanji.16..en: I am involved in this issue.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.kanji.17..zh: 今年的吉利方位是南南东。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.kanji.17..en: This year's lucky direction is south-southeast.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.kanji.18..zh: 作为商业城市繁荣起来。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.kanji.18..en: It prospered as a commercial town.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.kanji.20..en: The owner of this shop is kind.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.0.zh: 「でしまった」缩略为「じゃった」：飲んじゃった。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.0.en: The acronym "でしまった" is "じゃった": 飲んじゃった.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.zh: 「ておいて」缩略为「といて」：買っといて。「買っちゃって」对应買ってしまって；「買ってる」对应買っている；「買わなきゃ」表示必须买，均不表示提前买好备用。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.1.en: The acronym "ておいて" is "といて": 買っといて. "買っちゃって" corresponds to 買ってしまって; "買ってる" corresponds to "買っている "; and "買わなきゃ" means that it must be bought, and does not mean that it should be purchased in advance.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.zh: 「にとって」表示从某人的立场来看，后接评价。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.en: "にとって" means that someone's position is then evaluated.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.zh: 「する」接ず的特殊形式是「せず」：心配せずにはいられない。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.2.en: する has the special ず-form せず: 心配せずにはいられない.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.zh: 名词现在肯定形直接接らしい：事故らしい。这里根据迹象判断。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.3.en: Attach らしい directly to an affirmative non-past noun: 事故らしい. This expresses a judgment based on signs.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.zh: 假定“那件事是真的”，用「本当だとしたら」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.4.en: Assume the story is true with 本当だとしたら.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.zh: 根据条件推论结果，使用「ことになる」。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.en: Using the "ことになる " , based on conditional extrapolation.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.zh: 「ことになっている」表示规定或他人决定的事。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.en: "ことになっている" means something specified or decided by others.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.zh: 「ことにしている」表示自己决定并持续实行的习惯。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.6.grammar.5.en: "ことにしている" describes the habits that you decide on and continue to practice.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.1.no.zh: 由 社交＋的 构成，修饰名词时接 な。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.1.no.en: Formed from 社交 plus 的, and takes な before a noun.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.2.no.zh: 反义是 感情的；说 冷静な人 指遇事不乱。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.2.no.en: The opposite is 感情的; 冷静な人 means someone who stays steady under pressure.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.4.no.zh: 反义 不器用；也指会处事、转得快。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.4.no.en: The opposite is 不器用; it also means quick-witted in handling people.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.5.no.zh: 也接 を：歴史を学ぶ、日本語を学ぶ。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.5.no.en: It also takes を: 歴史を学ぶ, 日本語を学ぶ.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.6.no.zh: 口语常说 運動神経がいい／悪い，不指神经本身。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.6.no.en: People say 運動神経がいい or 悪い in speech; it is not about the nerves themselves.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.7.no.zh: 反义 弱い；本课取抗得住这一义，不是力气大。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.7.no.en: The opposite is 弱い; here it means standing up to something, not physical strength.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.8.no.zh: 由 個性＋的 构成，修饰名词接 な。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.8.no.en: Formed from 個性 plus 的, taking な before a noun.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.9.no.zh: 现在多指唱歌跳舞的偶像艺人，也可指心里崇拜的人。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.9.no.en: Now mostly a singing and dancing performer, but it can also mean the person you look up to.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.10.n.zh: 动手画动画的人；作品本身叫 アニメ。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.10.n.en: The person who draws the animation; the work itself is アニメ.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.11.n.zh: 作品叫 漫画，连载说 連載。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.11.n.en: The work is 漫画, and serialisation is 連載.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.12.n.zh: 把拍视频上传当成职业，收入靠广告和赞助。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.12.n.en: Making a career of posting videos, earning from ads and sponsors.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.16.n.zh: 说一个人身上并存两种相反的面貌，多含批评。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.16.n.en: Two opposite faces in one person, usually said with disapproval.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.17.n.zh: 也指组织起来这件事：組織する；形容词形是 組織的。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.17.n.en: It also means organising: 組織する; the adjective form is 組織的.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.18.m.en: become an apprentice; enter a school of training

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.18.n.zh: 也指入门书、入门课：入門書、入門講座。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.18.n.en: It also appears in 入門書 and 入門講座 for beginner books and courses.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.19.m.en: bed and food; eating and sleeping

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.19.n.zh: 几乎只用在固定说法里，日常说 一緒に食べて寝る。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.19.n.en: Almost only in this fixed phrase; in speech people say 一緒に食べて寝る.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.20.n.zh: 书面语，比 一緒に 郑重，多接 寝食、時、喜び。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.20.n.en: Written and more formal than 一緒に, and usually pairs with 寝食, 時 or 喜び.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.21.n.zh: 也说 新人戦、新人賞，指新人的比赛和奖。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.21.n.en: Also 新人戦 and 新人賞, the contest and award for newcomers.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.22.n.zh: 拜师说 弟子入りする，从徒弟这一边说。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.22.n.en: From the disciple's side, entering apprenticeship is 弟子入りする.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.23.m.en: to give (esp. to someone of lower status); to bestow

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.23.n.zh: 被动形 与えられる 常出现在 機会が与えられる 这类句子里。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.23.n.en: The passive 与えられる often shows up in sentences like 機会が与えられる.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.24.n.zh: 相扑部屋和艺能界常说，普通学习用 勉強。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.24.n.en: Common in sumo stables and the traditional arts; ordinary study is 勉強.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.25.n.zh: 也形容光秃秃、什么都没有：裸の山。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.25.n.en: It also describes something bare, as in 裸の山.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.26.n.zh: 常写假名；汉字写作 裸足，读法不变。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.26.n.en: Usually written in kana; in kanji it is 裸足, read the same.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.27.n.zh: 沙滩说 砂浜，沙地说 砂地。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.27.n.en: A sandy beach is 砂浜 and sandy ground is 砂地.

chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.28.n.zh: 家里说 浴室，公共澡堂是 銭湯。
chukyu-o-manabo-chukyu-zenki.7.word.28.n.en: At home people also say 浴室; a public bathhouse is 銭湯.
