try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: to play around

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 带责备语气。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: carries a note of reproach

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 留级
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: to repeat a year

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 大学里因学分不足多读一年。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: repeating a year for missing credits

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 试穿
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: to try on

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 衣服专用；试鞋用「履いてみる」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: for clothes; shoes take 履いてみる

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 推荐
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: to recommend

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 「店員にすすめられた」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: as in 店員にすすめられた

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 浪费
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: to waste

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 钱、时间都能用。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: works for money and time

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 提高、抬高
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: to raise

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 价格、税率。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: prices, tax rates

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 图省事、偷懒
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: to take it easy

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 「楽をしてお金をもうける」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: as in 楽をしてお金をもうける

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 赚钱
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: to make money

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 「お金をもうける」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: as in お金をもうける

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 局外人、外部人员
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: outsider

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.zh: 组织之外的人。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.2.en: anyone outside the organization

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.word.3.en: either giggling or chattering, depending on context

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 只要……就……。把某件事当作唯一的必要条件。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: As long as this one condition holds, the rest follows.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: N＋さえ＋…ば／V-ます＋さえ＋すれば・しなければ／なAで＋さえ＋あれば・なければ／Nで＋さえ＋あれば・なければ
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: N+さえ+…ば / V-ます+さえ+すれば / なAで+さえ+あれば / Nで+さえ+あれば

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 「給料さえよければどんな仕事でもいい」のように、最低条件を提示する。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Names the minimum condition: 給料さえよければどんな仕事でもいい.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 「さえ」还能表示“连……都”的极端例，要看后面有没有「ば」来判断。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: さえ alone can also mean even; check whether ば follows to tell them apart.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 只要您方便，我明天就过去拜访。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: If it suits you, I'll come by tomorrow.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 只要能吃，味道我不挑。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: As long as it's edible, I don't care about the taste.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 真可惜啊，樱。要是没摔倒就是第一名了……
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Too bad, Sakura. If only you hadn't fallen, you'd have come first.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 留学生活虽然辛苦，但我相信只要身体健康什么困难都能挺过去，所以要坚持下去。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Life as an international student is hard, but I'll keep going, believing that good health gets me through any difficulty.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 因为某种理由（连我也不知道），所以想做也做不到，等于「どうしようもない」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: There's no way to do it, whatever you try — the same as どうしようもない.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: V-ます（ますを取る）＋ ようがない
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: V-ます stem + ようがない

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 「私も知らないから教えようがない」のように、不可能の理由を添える。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Adds the reason it's impossible: 私も知らないから教えようがない.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 不是“不想做”，是“想做也没办法”；也别跟「～ないようにする」混。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: It means there's no way, not that you don't want to. Not to be confused with ～ないようにする.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 本来要出差，可大雪导致航班取消，想去也去不了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: I was supposed to go on a business trip, but the flight was cancelled in heavy snow, so there's no way to get there.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 想进武田产业，但他们不招应届生，实在没办法。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: I want to work at Takeda Sangyo, but they don't hire new graduates, so there's nothing I can do.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 花了很多时间、经历各种周折之后的最终结果，多用于不好的结果。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: The end result after a long, tangled effort — usually a bad one.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: V-た ＋ あげく（に）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: V-た + あげく(に)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 「遊びまわったあげくに留年するなんて」のように、折腾半天换来坏结果。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: The shape is 遊びまわったあげくに留年するなんて — all that messing about, and he repeats a year.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 后面不能接意志、命令；与「～末に」相近，但あげく 更强调“折腾半天结果还不好”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Can't be followed by volition or commands. Close to ～末に, but あげく stresses a bad payoff after a fuss.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 刚才那位客人试了半天，结果什么都没买就走了……
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: That customer tried on one thing after another and then left without buying anything.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 犹豫了三个多小时，最后决定买店员一开始推荐的那台电脑。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: After dithering for over three hours, I bought the laptop the clerk had recommended first.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 提醒、劝告“不能做……、不应该做……”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: Warns that something simply shouldn't be done.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: V-る ＋ ものではない／もんじゃない
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: V-る + ものではない (casual: もんじゃない)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 「人の悪口を言うもんじゃありません」のように、道理上不该做。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.en: It's about what's not right to do: 人の悪口を言うもんじゃありません.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.5-2.gramma.zh: 语气是“按理不该”，不是禁止令；对长辈用会失礼。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 后项多是由这个理由产生的行动或判断：愛すればこそ制限する。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: What follows is the action or judgement that reason produces: 愛すればこそ制限する.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 「からこそ」更口语；「ばこそ」偏书面、语气更重。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: からこそ is more conversational; ばこそ is bookish and heavier.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 正因为爱这座山的自然，才严格限制游客数量。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: It's precisely because we love this mountain's nature that we strictly limit visitor numbers.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 正因为待在日本才能做高水平的研究，所以在出成果之前我不想回国。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Only because I'm in Japan can I do advanced research, so I don't want to go home until this work bears fruit.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 可以说这部3D电影正因为有高超的CG技术才做得出来。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: You could say this 3D film exists precisely because of advanced CG technology.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 正因为是好朋友，才能互相指出对方的缺点。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: It's precisely because they're close friends that they can point out each other's faults.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 不能明确说“绝对……”，没底气或不想把话说死时的说法。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: For when you can't say it outright — no confidence, or you'd rather not commit.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: V-ない／いA く／なA で ＋ ないことはない／ないこともない
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: V-ない / いAく / なAで + ないことはない (also ないこともない)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 双重否定，语气留有余地：飲めないことはない＝不是不能喝。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: A double negative that leaves room: 飲めないことはない means it's not that I can't drink.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 与「～ことはない」（没必要）方向相反，注意别混。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: The opposite of ～ことはない (no need to); don't mix them up.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 卡拉OK也不是不去，就是被人叫的时候陪着去一下而已。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: It's not that I never go to karaoke — I go along when I'm invited, that's all.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 打针嘛，不可能完全不疼，不过护士不同疼的程度完全不一样。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: It's an injection, so of course it hurts a little — but how much depends entirely on the nurse.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 做到极限：能……就尽量……。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: To the limit: as much as you can.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: V-できる ＋ だけ（也有 V たい／ほしい／好きな ＋ だけ 的形式）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: V-できる + だけ (also V-たい / ほしい / 好きな + だけ)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 「食べ放題だったので食べられるだけ食べた」のように、上限まで行う。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 与表示限定的「～だけ」区分，这里不是“只有”，而是“尽可能”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Different from limiting だけ — this is as much as possible, not only.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 春节前，小林能带多少特产就带多少，回国了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Before the Spring Festival, Lin went home carrying as many souvenirs as she could.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 请把能用“生”这个汉字的词尽量都写出来。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Write as many words as you can that use the kanji 生.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 难过的时候，想哭多久就哭多久吧。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: When you're sad, cry as much as you want.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 今天刚摘的番茄。想要多少拿多少。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: These tomatoes were picked today. Take as many as you like.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 说明理由或辩解：因为……嘛。もん 主要是女性和儿童用语。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Gives a reason or an excuse — because, that's why. もん is mainly women's and children's speech.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 普通形 ＋ もん
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: plain form + もん (the stem form also works)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 口语，带撒娇或辩解的语感：だって…だもん。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Spoken, with a pouty or defensive ring: だって…だもん.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 正式场合不用；成年男性用会显得孩子气。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 科长说想在明天的会上把这个方案通过，可没那么容易定下来。问题还一大堆呢。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: The section chief wants this proposal approved at tomorrow's meeting, but it won't go through that easily — there are still plenty of problems.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 因为某种理由“不能做”，或“不做不行”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Can't do it — or can't get away without doing it — for a specific reason.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: V-る／V-ない ＋ わけにはいかない

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 与「～わけではない」（并非……）不同，别混。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: 只有……。多见于通知、告示等书面语。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.en: Only — mostly in notices and written announcements.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.6-2.gramma.zh: V-る／N ＋ のみ

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 上午忙得不可开交，连上厕所的工夫都没有。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: verb stem + たて (作る, できる, 焼く, なる and similar)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 焼きたてのパン／できたてのご飯／ペンキぬりたて／覚えたての歌，都强调“刚完成，还热乎/还新”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: 焼きたてのパン, できたてのご飯, ペンキぬりたて, 覚えたての歌 — the point is it has just been done.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 与「～たばかり」不同：たて 强调状态新鲜，且只接有限的几个动词；たばかり 只讲时间近。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Different from ～たばかり: たて stresses the fresh state and attaches to only a few verbs, while たばかり just marks recent time.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 刚煮好的米饭真是好啊，感觉能吃好几碗。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Freshly cooked rice is really something. I feel like I could eat bowl after bowl.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 这个长凳说是刚刷的漆。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: They say this bench has just been painted.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 对身边亲近的人提出批评、抱怨时用，带亲昵的责怪语气。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: For criticising someone close to you — a fond sort of scolding.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: N ＋ ったら（也作 N ＋ ってば）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: N + ったら (also N + ってば)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 把对方的名字或称呼直接接上 ったら，后面接抱怨内容：お父さんったら、また…。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Attach it straight to the name: お父さんったら、また…

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 只能用于平辈、晚辈或家人；对上级用会失礼。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Only for peers, juniors and family; rude to a superior.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 我家狗啊，我穿上浴衣，它把我当成外人叫起来了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Our dog — when I put on a yukata, he mistook me for a stranger and started barking.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 我弟弟呀，把我留着的点心全吃光了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: My little brother went and ate every sweet I'd been saving.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 我妈呀，老是擅自进我房间。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: My mother keeps walking into my room without asking.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 我们社长啊，说要在正门立自己的铜像。真是头疼。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Our president says he's putting a bronze statue of himself at the main entrance. What a headache.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 说明机械、系统或身体机制：一旦做了某事或发生某事，就会自动接下去发生另一件事。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Explains a mechanism: do this, or let that happen, and the next thing follows automatically.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: V-る／V-ない ＋ ようになっている
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: V-る / V-ない + ようになっている

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 泥棒が窓を壊すとブザーが鳴るようになっている／お金を入れると水が出るようになっている，都是“设计成这样的”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: 泥棒が窓を壊すとブザーが鳴るようになっている, お金を入れると水が出るようになっている — it is built to work that way.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 与「～ようにしている」（自己刻意保持的习惯）区分：なっている 是客观机制。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Not ～ようにしている, which is a habit you keep on purpose; なっている is how the thing works.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 灰尘进到鼻子里就会打喷嚏，身体自然把它排出去。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Dust gets in your nose, you sneeze, and the body expels it — that's how it's set up.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 听说最近的回转寿司靠盘子上的感应器，能自动算出吃了多少钱。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Apparently modern conveyor-belt sushi places use a sensor on the plate to tally what you've eaten automatically.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 这家酒店的门一关上就会自动上锁，外出时请务必带上这张房卡。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: The doors here lock themselves when they close, so please be sure to take this key card when you go out.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 世界第一台自动售货机是两千多年前在埃及造的，据说投币就会出水。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: The world's first vending machine was built in Egypt over two thousand years ago, and it was set up to dispense water when you inserted a coin.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 这个打火机把点火部分做硬了，小孩乱玩也打不着火。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: This lighter has a stiff ignition, so a child playing with it can't get a flame.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 想不通的事，知道原因后恍然大悟：难怪……、原来如此。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: The click of understanding once you learn the reason: so that's why.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 普通形 ＋ わけだ；なA な／N な（N である） ＋ わけだ（「～というわけだ」的形式也有）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: plain form + わけだ; な-adjectives and nouns take な (nouns also である) + わけだ (also ～というわけだ)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 開かないわけだ、かぎがかかっているよ／人気があるわけだ、おいしいもの，都是“理由明白了”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: 開かないわけだ、かぎがかかっているよ / 人気があるわけだ、おいしいもの — the reason has just become clear.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 理由不明时用「どういうわけか」（不知为什么）；与「～はずだ」（推测）不同，わけだ 是事后的领会。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: When the reason is unknown you say どういうわけか. Unlike ～はずだ (prediction), わけだ is hindsight.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 这个游戏难怪火。一玩才知道，角色有个性，故事也独特，太棒了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: No wonder this game is popular. I tried it — the characters are distinctive and the story is original. It's excellent.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: A どころか B：不是 A，反而是相反的 B；或 B 比 A 程度更甚。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: A どころか B: not A but the opposite B — or B is even worse than A.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 普通形 ＋ どころか；なA 词干（な）／N ＋ どころか
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: plain form + どころか; な-adjective stems (with or without な) and nouns + どころか

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 雨が降るどころかすごくいい天気になった（相反）／漢字どころかひらがなもわからない（更甚）。A 常是对方说的或自己原先以为的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: 雨が降るどころかすごくいい天気になった (opposite) / 漢字どころかひらがなもわからない (worse). A is often what the other person said or what you first assumed.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 后项要出乎意料，不能是同一方向的程度加强；与「～ばかりか」（不仅……而且）语感不同。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: B must overturn the expectation; it isn't just a stronger version of A. Different from ～ばかりか (not only).

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 高中时别说出国旅行，连国内旅行都没去过。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: In high school I'd never travelled abroad — I hadn't even travelled within Japan.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 一开始别说在网上跟人聊天了，连怎么联网都不知道。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: At first I couldn't chat with anyone online — I didn't even know how to get connected.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 刚来日本时路不熟，别说骑车去超市了，连一个人在家附近走走都做不到。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: When I first came to Japan I didn't know the roads — forget cycling to the supermarket, I couldn't even walk around the neighbourhood alone.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 照现在这个状态下去不会有好的结果——带批评、担心的语气。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Keep going like this and it won't end well — a note of criticism or worry.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: V-る／V-ない ＋ ようでは／ようじゃ
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: V-る / V-ない + ようでは (casual: ようじゃ)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 后面接否定性判断：～ようでは、社会人としてまずい／～ようじゃ、やっていけない。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: What follows is a negative verdict: ～ようでは、社会人としてまずい / ～ようじゃ、やっていけない.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 与「～ようだ」（推测）无关；这里 よう 是“样子、状态”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Nothing to do with ～ようだ (seems); here よう means the state of things.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 完全不注意打扮的话，作为社会人不太行吧？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: If you don't give a thought to how you look, that's a problem for a working adult, isn't it?

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 连截稿日都守不住，是当不了漫画家的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: If you can't meet deadlines, you can't make it as a manga artist.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 老师说，就算到了高级，遇到生词还一个个查字典，阅读是不会变好的。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: My teacher told me that even at an advanced level, if you look up every unknown word one by one, your reading won't improve.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 机器本身的设计，用「～ようになっている」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: How the device is built: ～ようになっている.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 人一来就自动亮灯，是设备机制，用「～ようになっている」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: The lights come on automatically: ～ようになっている.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 知道理由后的领会，用「～わけだ」。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 根据情况推测，用「～はずだ」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: An inference from what was said: ～はずだ.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: “应该做什么”，用「～べきか」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: What one ought to do: ～べきか.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 不是安静，反而很吵，用「～どころか」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Far from quiet, it's noisy: ～どころか.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 别说车了，连房子也不行，用「～どころか」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Forget a car — even a house is out of reach: ～どころか.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 别说五公里，一公里都跑不了，用「～どころか」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Not five kilometres — not even one: ～どころか.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: So big words fail: ～のなんのって.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 对身边人带责怪地称呼，用「～ったら」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.en: Scolding someone close by name: ～ったら.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-1.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。

お嬢様ぶる: to act the young lady
as in 賞を独占する

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.word.3.en: まずい is the opposite of おいしい
as in バレンタインチョコ

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 其实并不是那样，却故意做出那个样子给人看。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Not actually so, but putting on that appearance.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: N／なA 词干／いA 词干 ＋ ぶる（如 上品ぶる・偉ぶる・悪ぶる・いい子ぶる）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: noun, な-adjective or い-adjective stem + ぶる (上品ぶる, 偉ぶる, 悪ぶる, いい子ぶる)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 常与「優等生・悪者・大人・上品・いい子・偉い」等词搭配；ぶる 按一类动词活用：ぶらない／ぶって。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Pairs with words like 優等生, 悪者, 大人, 上品, いい子, 偉い. ぶる conjugates like a godan verb: ぶらない, ぶって.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 带贬义，暗示“装出来的”；不能用于真心的状态。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Always slighting — it implies a pose, never a genuine state.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 以前我在喜欢的女孩面前装坏。其实只是没勇气说喜欢而已。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: I used to act tough in front of a girl I liked. The truth is I just didn't have the courage to tell her.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 那人明明是大企业的社长，却一点架子都没有。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: He runs a major company but doesn't put on airs at all.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 就算在帅哥面前，要我装大小姐也做不到。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Even in front of someone handsome, I could never pull off acting like a young lady.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 某个立场的人普遍有某种倾向——带批评的口气。也用于“偏偏在这种时候”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: People in that position all tend to do this — said critically. Also for a bad-timing twist.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: N ＋ に限って
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: N + に限って

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 金持ちに限ってけちだ／初心者に限って偉そうに言う，都是“这一类人偏偏这样”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: 金持ちに限ってけちだ / 初心者に限って偉そうに言う — this kind of person, of all people.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 另有「～のとき運悪く」用法：急いでいるときに限ってバスが来ない。与「～に限る」（最好）无关。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: A second use is bad timing: 急いでいるときに限ってバスが来ない. Nothing to do with ～に限る (the best).

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 偏偏是不懂的人爱摆架子说大话。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: It's always the ones who know nothing who talk big.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 偏偏是有钱人小气，不愿掏钱。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: It's the rich who are stingy and hate parting with money.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 山田说偏偏是开好车的人住便宜公寓，真的吗？
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Yamada said the people driving expensive cars are the ones living in cheap flats. I wonder if that's true.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 偏偏在没钱的日子，朋友来叫喝酒。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Of all days, on the broke ones my friends invite me out for a drink.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 偏偏赶时间的时候公交不来。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: The bus never comes when you're in a hurry.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 明明有重要的考试，偏偏今天睡过头了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: I had an important exam, and of all days I overslept today.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 说话人的判断：应该……、最好……。多用于给建议。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: The speaker's judgement — you should, it's best to. Mostly advice.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: V-る／V-ない ＋ ことだ
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: V-る / V-ない + ことだ

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 强くなりたかったら、自分の長所を伸ばすことです／風邪を防ぐには換気をすることです。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: 強くなりたかったら、自分の長所を伸ばすことです / 風邪を防ぐには換気をすることです.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 与「～ことがある」（有时）和「～ことになった」（决定）区分；ことだ 只表劝告。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Not ～ことがある (sometimes) or ～ことになった (it was decided); ことだ gives advice only.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 工作也好别的也好，别一个人烦恼，找人商量商量。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Whatever it is, don't agonise alone — talk it over with someone.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 想变强，就得把自己的长处磨出来。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: If you want to get stronger, build on what you're already good at.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 要防霉，就得每天给房间通风。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: To keep mould away, air the room every day.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 想跟室友过得愉快，就得注意别给对方添麻烦。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: To live happily with a roommate, be careful not to inconvenience each other.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 所有的……、每一个……。同一个名词重复，强调无一例外。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Every last one — the noun is repeated to leave no exceptions.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: N ＋ という ＋ N（同一名词重复）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: N + という + N (the same noun twice)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 店という店が閉まっていた／木という木が燃えた，都是“全部、一个不剩”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: 店という店が閉まっていた / 木という木が燃えた — all of them, without exception.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 重复的名词必须完全相同；不能换成同类词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: The repeated noun must be identical; you can't swap in a related word.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 这次森林火灾，这一带的树一棵不剩全烧了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: In this forest fire, every single tree around here burned — not one was left.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 田中导演凭这部片子，把今年电影相关的奖项几乎全包了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: With this film, director Tanaka swept every film award going this year.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 圣诞节去伦敦，店家家都关门，什么都没买成。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: I went to London at Christmas and every shop was shut — I couldn't buy a thing.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 樱花季节每条路上都挤满游客，对当地人来说真是麻烦。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: In cherry-blossom season every street overflows with tourists — a nuisance for the locals.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 差点就变成那种状况，实际上没有发生。常与「危うく」连用。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: It nearly came to that, but didn't. Usually with 危うく.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: V-る ＋ ところだった（也接「～なければならない」「～ざるを得ない」等）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: V-る + ところだった (also after ～なければならない, ～ざるを得ない)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: もう少しでけがをするところだった／危うく遅刻するところだった，都是“好险”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: もう少しでけがをするところだった / 危うく遅刻するところだった — that was close.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 与「～はずだった」（本该……却没）不同：ところだった 是“险些发生”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Not ～はずだった (was supposed to): ところだった is a near miss.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 今早睡过头三十分钟，差点迟到。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: I overslept by half an hour this morning and nearly missed being late.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 看漫画看入迷了，要不是朋友提醒，就坐过站了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: I was absorbed in a manga — if my friend hadn't told me, I'd have missed my stop.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 爷爷的病要是再晚发现一点，就来不及了。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: If my grandfather's illness had been found a little later, it would have been too late.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: A 的话太不划算，那就宁可选 B——B 也未必好，但比 A 强。也可用于后悔。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: If it means A, I'd rather have B — B isn't great, but better than A. Also used for regret.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: V-る ＋ くらいなら
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: V-る + くらいなら

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 1時間待つくらいならほかの店に行こう／15,000円も払うくらいなら新しいのを買う。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: 1時間待つくらいならほかの店に行こう / 15,000円も払うくらいなら新しいのを買う.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 后项常带「～ほうがいい」「～たほうがましだ」；后悔时用「～ばよかったのに」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: B often ends in ～ほうがいい or ～たほうがましだ; for regret it's ～ばよかったのに.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 花钱坐电车，还不如骑自行车去，虽然费时间。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Rather than pay for the train, I'd sooner cycle even if it takes longer.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 跟别的情况比，虽说不上好，但至少不是最糟。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Compared with the alternative, not good but at least not the worst.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: V-た／N の ＋ ほうがましだ（常与 ～より・～だけ・まだ・ずっと 连用）
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: V-た / N + の + ほうがましだ (often with ～より, ～だけ, まだ, ずっと)

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 「まずい」って言われるよりましでしょ／仕事があるだけましだ，都是“总比……强”。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: 「まずい」って言われるよりましでしょ / 仕事があるだけましだ — still better than the alternative.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: まし 本身不是“好”，只是“相对不坏”；不能用于真正称赞。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: まし never means good — only comparatively less bad; it can't be praise.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 那家伙都进公司五年了还老是出错，还不如新人加藤。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: He's in his fifth year and still makes mistakes constantly — even Kato the newcomer is better.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 差一点就撞上，用「～ところだった」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: A near miss: ～ところだった.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 本来应该一小时结束，用「～はずだった」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: It was supposed to take an hour: ～はずだった.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 原定要去远足，用「～はずだった」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: The trip was scheduled: ～はずだった.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 与「危うく」呼应，表示险些，用「～ところだった」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: With 危うく, a narrow escape: ～ところだった.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 选出搭配最合适的一项。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Choose the best match.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 材料费太贵，那就宁可买现成的，用「～くらいなら」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: If materials cost that much, buying is better: ～くらいなら.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 选出搭配最合适的一项。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Choose the best match.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 累到要请假，那就别打工了，用「～くらいなら」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: If you're that worn out, quit the part-time job: ～くらいなら.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 选出搭配最合适的一项。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Choose the best match.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 跟上司喝酒还不如加班，用「～くらいなら」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Overtime beats drinks with the boss: ～くらいなら.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 选出搭配最合适的一项。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Choose the best match.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 要马上分手，那当初就别交往，用「～くらいなら」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Breaking up that soon? Better never to have dated: ～くらいなら.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 一个都没有更惨，所以是「ないよりまし」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Having none would be worse: ないよりまし.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 交通费最多只给到500日元（「500円までしか出ない」），但有总比没有强，用「出ないよりまし」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Travel costs are covered only up to 500 yen, but that still beats getting nothing: 出ないよりまし.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 与其闹僵，不如什么都不说，用「何も言わないほうがまし」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Better to say nothing: 何も言わないほうがまし.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 房子烧了但人没事，用「命が助かっただけまし」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: The house burned but lives were saved: 命が助かっただけまし.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: “摆架子”用「偉ぶる」，这里是过去式修饰名词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Putting on airs is 偉ぶる; here it modifies a noun.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 偏偏在没钱的日子，用「～に限って」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Of all days, the broke ones: ～に限って.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 给建议“应该……”，用「～ことだ」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Advice with ～ことだ.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 同一名词重复，表示“所有的”，用「～という～」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Repeating the noun for every last one: ～という～.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 差一点就被骗，用「～ところだった」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: I was nearly taken in: ～ところだった.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 填入合适的词。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Fill in the blank.

try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.zh: 跟那种人开的车比，走路还算好，用「～ほうがましだ」。
try-nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2.9-2.gramma.en: Walking beats riding with a driver like that: ～ほうがましだ.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「本来就……嘛」——讲的是世上的常理，不是眼前某一件具体的事。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “That's just how it is” — this states a general truth about the world, not one particular event.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 把一件事抬到「本来就是这样」的高度：人都会犯错、孩子总爱玩、时间过得快。句子里一般不点具体某个人，说的是一般情况，语气里带点感慨或说教。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: It lifts something to the level of 本来就是这样: people make mistakes, children play, time flies. The subject is usually general rather than one named person, and the tone carries a sigh or a mild lecture.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 动词辞书形／ない形＋ものだ；い形容词＋ものだ；な形容词＋な＋ものだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Dictionary form / ない-form + ものだ; i-adjective + ものだ; na-adjective + な + ものだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 中文的“应该”会误导人。这里不是推测，是在讲道理：根据线索推断才用「はずだ」，陈述“世道本来如此”才用「ものだ」。另外别和「たものだ」混——辞书形讲常理，た形讲回忆。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Chinese 应该 is misleading here. This is not inference: use はずだ when deducing from evidence, and ものだ when stating how the world generally works. Do not confuse it with たものだ either — dictionary form states a general truth, た-form recalls the past.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 人嘛，谁都会犯错。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Everyone fails at some point — that is just how people are.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 婴儿夜里就是要哭的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Babies cry at night; that is simply what babies do.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 上了年纪，就觉得时间过得特别快。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: As you get older, time really does fly.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「想当年啊……」——回忆过去反复做过的事，语气里带怀念。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “Back in those days…” — recalls something done over and over in the past, with nostalgia.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 说的是一段时期里常有的事，一开口就像“小时候啊”“那会儿啊”。和单纯叙述过去的「～ていた」比，它多了一层感慨，常出现在闲聊、随笔里。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: It describes what used to happen over a stretch of time, the way people start with when I was a kid. Compared with plain ～ていた, it adds a layer of feeling, which is why it shows up in conversation and personal essays.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 动词た形＋ものだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Verb た-form + ものだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 中文母语者容易只当成“过去时”。重点不在时间，在怀念。客观报告过去的状态用「～ていた」就够，加「たものだ」会像老人在感慨。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Learners often read it as a plain past tense. The point is not the time but the nostalgia. For a neutral report of a past state, ～ていた is enough; たものだ sounds like someone reminiscing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 小时候常在这条河里游泳。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: When I was a child I used to swim in this river all the time.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 学生时代，常和朋友聊到深夜。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: In my student days we would talk with friends until late at night.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 从前这一带也是很安静的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: This neighbourhood used to be so quiet, back in the day.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「因为……嘛」——给已经发生的事补一个理由，带解释或辩解的口气。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “Because…, you see” — supplies a reason for something that already happened, often as an excuse.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 事情已经出了，说话人在说明“我不是故意的，是因为……”。道歉、迟到、推掉邀约时最常听见，后半句常接「遅れました」「できませんでした」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Something has already gone wrong and the speaker is explaining that it was not on purpose. It is common in apologies, for lateness, and when turning down an invitation, with 遅れました or できませんでした in the main clause.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 普通形＋ものだから（な形容词・名词＋な＋ものだから）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Plain form + ものだから (na-adjective / noun + な + ものだから)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「から」只是中性交代原因；「ものだから」是在请求体谅，像“你也知道嘛，所以……”。对上级或写正式文书时少用，会显得太随便。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: から states a cause neutrally; ものだから asks the listener to be understanding, roughly you know how it is, so…. Avoid it with superiors or in formal writing, where it sounds too casual.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 因为早上睡过头了，所以没赶上电车。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: I overslept, so I missed the train.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 路上堵得厉害，所以来晚了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: The traffic was terrible, so I was late for our appointment.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 我日语还听不太懂，能请您说慢一点吗？
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: I still don't follow Japanese well, so could you speak a little more slowly?

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「虽说……可是……」——先认下前半句，后半句却不如人意。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “Granted…, but…” — concedes the first half, then reports a result that fell short.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 书面语，多见于文章、报告和新闻。A 是事实，但顺着 A 该出现的 B 没有出现，说话人只是平静地指出这个落差。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: A written register found in articles, reports and news. A is true, but the B that should follow from A did not happen, and the speaker simply notes the gap.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 动词・い形容词普通形／な形容词词干＋な・である／名词＋である＋ものの
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Verb / i-adjective plain form; na-adjective stem + な or である; noun + である + ものの

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 别和「ものを」混。「ものの」是平静的转折，不带责怪；「ものを」带“明明可以……你却……”的埋怨，是情绪化的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Do not confuse it with ものを. ものの turns calmly with no blame; ものを carries the complaint of you could have, and yet you didn't.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 驾照是拿到了，但几乎没开过车。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: I got my licence, but I hardly ever drive.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 试了新药，可是没有效果。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: They tried the new drug, but it had no effect.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 虽然回了公司，却没再被委以原来的工作。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: He returned to the company, but was never given his old work again.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 两种假设共用一个外壳：「要是真能……就好了」和「万一……可就糟了」，看前面的动词形式分。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Two kinds of hypothetical share one frame: if only I could…, and if anyone were to…, it would be a disaster. The verb form in front tells you which.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 可能形＋ものなら，是明知做不到还是忍不住想；意向形＋ものなら，是一旦真做了就会有严重后果。前者常接「～たい」，后者常接「大変だ」「終わりだ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Potential form + ものなら expresses a wish the speaker knows is out of reach and usually pairs with ～たい. Volitional form + ものなら warns of serious consequences and pairs with 大変だ or 終わりだ.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 可能形＋ものなら；意向形（～よう）＋ものなら
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Potential form + ものなら; volitional form (～よう) + ものなら

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 不能笼统记成“如果”。中文都用“要是……”，日文靠动词形式区分：看到「戻れる」是想回去，看到「戻ろう」是警告别回去。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Do not reduce it to if. Chinese uses 要是 for both, but Japanese splits them by verb form: 戻れる means wanting to go back, 戻ろう means warning against going back.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 要是能行，我真想再回到学生时代。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: If I could, I would go back to my student days once more.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 这事要是跟他提一句，准传得满家都知道。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: If you so much as tell him this secret, the whole family will know.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 在社长面前说那种话，马上就会被开除。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Say something like that in front of the president and you will be fired on the spot.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「明明……却偏偏……」——带埋怨或替对方可惜。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “You could have…, and yet…” — carries reproach, or regret on someone else's behalf.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 本来有更好的做法，或者本该出现另一个结果，现实偏不。常见于「～ばいいものを」「～たらいいものを」，说话人站在“我早就说过”的位置上。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: A better course was open, or another result was expected, and reality went the other way. It often appears as ～ばいいものを or ～たらいいものを, with the speaker in the position of having said so all along.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 普通形＋ものを（常见：～ばいいものを／～たらいいものを）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Plain form + ものを (often ～ばいいものを / ～たらいいものを)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 语气比「ものの」重得多，是情绪化的。写客观报告用「ものの」，说“你怎么不早说呢”用「ものを」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: It is far more emotional than ものの. For a neutral report use ものの; for why on earth didn't you say so, use ものを.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 你早说的话我就帮你了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: If you had told me earlier, I would have helped.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 本来闭嘴就没事，偏偏多嘴说了不该说的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: He could simply have kept quiet, but he had to go and say the wrong thing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 打个电话我就去接你了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: One phone call and I would have come to pick you up.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「可不能……啊」——从做人的道理出发劝人，不是硬性规定。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “One simply doesn't…” — advice grounded in decency rather than a rule.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 长辈、老师、社论的口吻：人不该这样。常见于「人の悪口を言うものではない」「約束を破るものではない」这类教训，也用于自省。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: The voice of an elder, a teacher or an editorial: people should not behave this way. It appears in admonitions like 人の悪口を言うものではない or 約束を破るものではない, and in self-reflection.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 动词辞书形＋ものではない
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Dictionary form + ものではない

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 三种“不许”要分清：「てはいけない」是规则禁止，「べきではない」是理性规范，「ものではない」是道德劝说。对平辈用会显得居高临下。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Three kinds of prohibition: てはいけない is a rule, べきではない a reasoned norm, ものではない moral advice. Used with a peer it sounds condescending.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 不该在背后说人坏话。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: One should not speak ill of others behind their backs.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 年轻的时候，不该净挑轻松的路走。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: When you are young you should not always take the easy road.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 对长辈不该用那种口气说话。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: You should not speak that way to someone senior to you.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「这才叫……」——给一件事下定义、作评价。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: “Now that is what you call…” — defines or evaluates something.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 说话人认为某件事才真正配得上某个说法，常带感慨或断言，句尾几乎固定为「～というものだ」。多用于议论、演讲和随笔。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: The speaker holds that something genuinely deserves a name, usually with a note of conviction. The ending is almost always ～というものだ, and it belongs to argument, speeches and essays.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 普通形／名词＋というものだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Plain form / noun + というものだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 普通「という」只是引用或命名，没有评价；加了「ものだ」才变成“这才算得上”。也别写成「ということだ」——那是传闻或总结。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Plain という only quotes or names. Adding ものだ turns it into an evaluation. Do not write ということだ either, which reports hearsay or sums up.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 默默帮助有困难的人，这才叫亲切。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Quietly helping someone in trouble — now that is what kindness means.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 决定的事做到最后，这才叫负责。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Seeing through what you have decided — that is what responsibility means.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 不表达自己的意见、只看别人脸色，那不叫配合，叫服从。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Never stating your own view and only watching others' faces is not cooperation — it is submission.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 想当年……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: I was thinking about it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「～たものだ」是在带着感慨回忆过去反复发生的事。这里不是单纯说“聊过”，而是“想当年，我们常常聊到天亮”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: ～たものだ recalls repeated past events with emotion: we used to talk until dawn, rather than simply having talked once.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 本来就……嘛
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: It was...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 这里说的是普遍规律：到了新环境，谁一开始都会不安。中文的“人嘛，本来就……”最贴近这种常理语气。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: And here's the general rule: when we get to a new environment, everyone starts to worry. The Chinese word "people," it's the most common tone.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 因为……嘛
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Because...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 说话人在解释没能及时回复的原因，带一点“是因为会议拖长了嘛”的说明、辩解语气。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: The speaker explained the reasons for the failure to respond in a timely manner, with an explanation and justification “because the meeting was prolonged”.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 虽说……可是……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: A neutral concession, without blame or regret.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 合格这件事成立，但会话仍没自信，结果与预期有落差。「ものの」是较客观的逆接。 补充：ものを也能表示“明明已经通过”，但带更强的不满或遗憾；ものの是较中性的转折。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Target expression: ものの. Intended meaning: A neutral concession, without blame or regret. Compared alternatives: ものを. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 要是真能……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: If it's true...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: “能休一周”在现实中不太容易实现，因此用「ものなら」表达“要是真能做到的话”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: "A week off" is not easy to achieve in reality, so it's called "ものなら" and "if you can do it."

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 明明……却偏偏……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: But it's just...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 本来只要商量一下就能帮忙，他却偏偏独自熬夜做完。这里有明显的遗憾和埋怨，所以用「ものを」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: He could have helped if he had just talked about it, but he did it alone. There were obvious regrets and grievances, so use "ものを. "

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 哪能…… / 可不能……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: How can... / Can't...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 这不是法律禁令，而是在讲做人做事的常理：哪能不听解释就单方面责备别人。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: This is not a legal prohibition; it is the common sense to do things: to blame others unilaterally if they do not listen to an explanation.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 这才叫……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: That's what I call...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 说话人在对“真正的友情”作评价、下定义。「というものだ」最自然地对应“这才叫真正的友情”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: The talker evaluates and defines "real friendship". "というものだ" most naturally corresponds to "that's what true friendship is."

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 想当年……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: I was thinking about it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 「昔」「祭りになると」共同提示过去反复出现的景象，句中还有回忆和感慨的味道。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: 昔 and 祭りになると together evoke a recurring past scene, with a sense of recollection and emotion.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 虽说……可是……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: A neutral concession, without blame or regret.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 练习了很多次，但正式场合仍说不出话，是客观的预期落差；没有责怪谁的情绪，因此选「ものの」。 补充：ものを可强调努力付诸东流的遗憾；ものの只是承认练习过但结果不理想。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Target expression: ものの. Intended meaning: A neutral concession, without blame or regret. Compared alternatives: ものを. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 因为……嘛
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Because...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 正在为“忘带资料”解释原因：因为早上慌慌张张出门了嘛。这个解释语气正是「ものだから」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: The explanation for "forgetting information" is because it's open in the morning. It's called "ものだから".

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 要是真能……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: If it's true...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.zh: 回到过去几乎无法实现，所以不是普通的“如果”，而是带强烈愿望的“要是真能回去的话”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.1-mono.g.en: Returning to the past is almost impossible, so it is not the ordinary “if” but the “if it is possible to go back” with a strong desire.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「原来如此，怪不得……」——听完原因，自己把结论接上。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: “Ah, so that's why…” — the listener puts the pieces together after hearing the reason.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 前半给事实或原因，后半是“这么说就说得通了”。常出现在对话里表示理解，也可以用来解释自己刚发现的事。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: The first half gives the fact or cause and the second half says that explains it. It appears in conversation to show understanding, and also when the speaker has just worked something out.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 普通形＋わけだ（な形容词・名词＋な＋わけだ）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Plain form + わけだ (na-adjective / noun + な + わけだ)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不是「から」的同义词。「から」是说话人主动给原因；「わけだ」是听完之后确认“难怪”。方向和视角都不同。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It is not a synonym of から. から has the speaker supplying a cause; わけだ has the speaker confirming that this explains it after hearing it. The direction and viewpoint differ.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 天天都在练啊，怪不得进步这么快。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: She practises every day, so of course she improves quickly.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 空调坏了啊，怪不得这么热。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: The air conditioner was broken — no wonder it was so hot.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 在日本住了十年，日语当然好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: After ten years in Japan, it is only natural that his Japanese is good.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「怎么可能……」——从常识或证据出发，断定绝不可能。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: “How could it possibly…” — a flat denial grounded in common sense or evidence.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 对某个说法直接否定，语气比单纯的否定重得多，常带“你在开玩笑吧”的味道。书面和口语都能用。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It rejects a claim outright, far more forcefully than a plain negative, with a note of you must be joking. It works both in speech and in writing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 普通形＋わけがない（な形容词词干＋な・である；名词＋の・である）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Plain form + わけがない (na-adjective stem + な or である; noun + の or である)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 和「はずがない」几乎同义，但「わけがない」更像反问“哪有这种道理”，情绪更外露；正式文书里「はずがない」更常见。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Nearly the same as はずがない, but わけがない sounds more like a retort, as if to say that makes no sense, and shows more feeling. Formal writing prefers はずがない.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 他怎么可能忘记那种约定。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: There is no way he would forget a promise like that.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 一晚上怎么可能读完整本书。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: There is no way anyone could read this whole book in one night.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 这么冷，怎么可能在外面等。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It is freezing out — of course nobody could wait outside.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「也不是说……」——承认一半，否掉对方可能顺势推出的结论。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: “It's not that…” — concedes part of it while blocking the conclusion the listener is about to draw.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 常见结构是“A 是 A，但也不是 B”。用来纠正误解，语气比直接否定缓和，后半句常接「ただ」「でも」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: The usual shape is A is A, but it is not as far as B. It corrects a misunderstanding more gently than a flat denial, and the second clause often starts with ただ or でも.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 普通形＋わけではない（な形容词・名词＋な＋わけではない）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Plain form + わけではない (na-adjective / noun + な + わけではない)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不是全盘否定。中文常译成“并不是”，很多人偷懒写成“不是”，语气一下就硬了，还会让读者以为整句都推翻了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It is not a wholesale denial. The usual Chinese rendering is 并不是; dropping the 并 makes the tone abrupt and suggests the whole statement is being overturned.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 也不是说我讨厌甜食。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It is not that I dislike sweets.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 虽说住在日本，日语也不是完美无缺。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Living in Japan does not mean my Japanese is perfect.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 贵的东西也不一定就好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Expensive things are not necessarily good.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「并不意味着……」——否定一整套说法或因果推论。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: “That does not mean…” — rejects a whole claim or the inference drawn from it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 把前面整句话引用过来，再说它推不出某个结论。适合议论、说明文，句子往往较长。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It quotes the whole preceding statement and then denies that it leads anywhere. It suits argument and expository writing, where the sentences tend to be long.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 普通形＋というわけではない（名词・な形容词也可接だ）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Plain form + というわけではない (nouns and na-adjectives may take だ)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 与「わけではない」意思接近，区别在对象：单个词或状态用「わけではない」，一整句话、一种说法用「というわけではない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Close in meaning to わけではない, but the object differs: a single word or state takes わけではない, a whole sentence or claim takes というわけではない.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 贵并不意味着质量就一定好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Being expensive does not mean the quality is good.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 名校毕业并不意味着工作能力强。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Graduating from a famous university does not mean someone works well.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 天天吃一样的东西，也不代表就吃腻了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Eating the same thing every day does not mean I am tired of it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「做得到，但不能做」——受身份、责任或情理约束。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: “I could, but I can't” — blocked by duty, position or what people would think.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 能力上没问题，可立场不允许。常见于“考试前不能玩”“受了恩不能不还”“明天要早起不能喝”。句尾固定为「～わけにはいかない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: There is no lack of ability; the position forbids it. Typical cases: not going out before an exam, not ignoring a favour, not drinking when you must be up early. The ending is always ～わけにはいかない.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 动词辞书形＋わけにはいかない
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Dictionary form + わけにはいかない

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 中文都译“不能”，但「できない」是客观上做不到，「わけにはいかない」是能做到却不该做。这是考试最常设的陷阱。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Chinese renders both as 不能, but できない means it is impossible while わけにはいかない means it is possible yet improper. This is the trap exams set most often.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 重要考试就在眼前，我可不能跑去玩。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: With an important exam coming, I cannot go out and have fun.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 受过人家照顾，这请求我没法拒绝。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: I cannot turn down a request from someone who has done so much for me.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 明天要早起，今天可不能喝酒。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: I have an early start tomorrow, so I cannot drink today.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「不得不……」——不做在情理上过不去。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: “I have no choice but to…” — not doing it would be indefensible.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 双重否定，最后落在“只能做”。常和「以上」「からには」呼应，强调是处境逼着自己，而不是规矩要求。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A double negative that lands on having to. It often follows 以上 or からには and stresses that circumstances leave no way out, rather than a rule demanding it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 动词ない形＋わけにはいかない
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: ない-form + わけにはいかない

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 比「なければならない」更强调具体处境。“规定要这样”用「なければならない」，“人家都开口了，我不能不去”用「ないわけにはいかない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It stresses a concrete situation more than なければならない does. Use なければならない for what the rules require, and ないわけにはいかない for having been asked and so being unable to refuse.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 既然人家邀请了，我也不能不去。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Since I have been invited, I cannot very well skip it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 借的钱不能不还。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: I cannot avoid paying back money I borrowed.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 学长开口了，我不能不帮。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: When a senior asks me, I cannot refuse to help.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 原来如此 / 怪不得……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: I see. No wonder...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 知道“每天练三小时”这个原因后，自然得出“怪不得进步这么快”的结论。「わけだ」表示根据前面的事实理解了结果。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Knowing the reason for the "three hours a day" comes to the conclusion that "no wonder it's progressing so fast." わけだ means that the results are understood on the basis of the facts.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 原来如此 / 怪不得……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: I see. No wonder...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 今天是节假日，所以银行关门也就说得通了。这里的「わけだ」相当于“原来如此，难怪……”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It's a holiday, so it makes sense that the bank is closed. "わけだ" here is like, "That's the way it is," no wonder.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 并不是说……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A clarification correcting a possible misunderstanding, without an emphatic impossibility claim.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 后句说明只是为了健康而少吃，并不是讨厌甜食，用部分否定、纠正误解的「わけではない」。わけにはいかない表示“不能那么做”；わけだ是顺理成章的结论；ばかりだ表示变化一路发展，都与后句矛盾或接不上。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: わけではない corrects a possible misunderstanding: I don't dislike sweets, I'm just cutting back. わけにはいかない means "can't afford to"; わけだ draws a natural conclusion; ばかりだ means "keeps getting more". None fits the next sentence.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 并不是说……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A clarification that the negative conclusion is not entirely true.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 忙是真的，但并非完全见不了面，用「わけではない」否定“完全不能见”的推断。わけだ是结论；ないわけにはいかない表示“不得不”；一方だ要接表示变化的动词，「会えない一方だ」不成立。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: わけではない denies the inference that we can't meet at all. わけだ draws a conclusion; ないわけにはいかない means "have to"; 一方だ needs a verb of change, so 会えない一方だ is ungrammatical.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 怎么可能……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A strong judgment that the event is impossible.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 根据“他责任感很强”这一判断，说话人强烈断定他不可能忘记重要约定。「わけがない」就是“怎么可能”。 补充：わけにはいかない可从责任角度说“不能忘”，わけがない则判断他不可能忘。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Target expression: わけがない. Intended meaning: A strong judgment that the event is impossible. Compared alternatives: わけにはいかない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 怎么可能……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A strong judgment that the event is impossible.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 工作量太大，一小时内全部做完在说话人看来不可能，因此用带强烈否定判断的「わけがない」。 补充：わけではない可以否定“能全部完成”；わけがない则强烈断定不可能。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Target expression: わけがない. Intended meaning: A strong judgment that the event is impossible. Compared alternatives: わけではない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不能那么做……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A constraint arising from responsibility, rather than inability or a prediction.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不是客观上出不了门，而是因为明天有重要考试，情理和立场上不能去玩。「わけにはいかない」强调这种约束。 补充：わけがない表示断定自己不会去；わけではない表示澄清并不是去玩。若强调考试带来的约束，优先わけにはいかない。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Target expression: わけにはいかない. Intended meaning: A constraint arising from responsibility, rather than inability or a prediction. Compared alternatives: わけがない / わけではない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不能那么做……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: A constraint arising from a promise.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 既然答应保密，情理上就不能告诉别人。这里不是能力上的“说不了”，而是立场上“不可以说”。 补充：わけがない可表示“我绝不会说出去”；わけにはいかない强调受托保密的责任。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Target expression: わけにはいかない. Intended meaning: A constraint arising from a promise. Compared alternatives: わけがない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不能不…… / 不得不……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: An obligation: one cannot reasonably refuse to participate.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 「ないわけにはいかない」是双重否定：受过老师照顾又被邀请，因此情理上不能不参加，也就是“必须参加”。 补充：参加しないわけがない表示“我不可能不参加”；参加しないわけにはいかない表示人情上不能缺席。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Target expression: わけにはいかない. Intended meaning: An obligation: one cannot reasonably refuse to participate. Compared alternatives: わけがない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 不能不…… / 不得不……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: An obligation: one cannot reasonably refuse to apologize.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 既然自己的失误给别人添了麻烦，就不能不道歉。「謝らないわけにはいかない」自然对应“不得不道歉”。 补充：謝らないわけがない强调不可能不道歉；謝らないわけにはいかない强调有道歉义务。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Target expression: わけにはいかない. Intended meaning: An obligation: one cannot reasonably refuse to apologize. Compared alternatives: わけがない. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 并不意味着……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It doesn't mean...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 长期住在日本并不等于所有汉字都能读。「というわけではない」否定从前项推出的整体结论，中文就是“并不意味着……”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: Long-term residence in Japan does not mean that all kanjis can read. "というわけではない" rejects the entire conclusion of the previous item, and Chinese means "does not mean...".

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 并不意味着……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: It doesn't mean...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.zh: 价格高不必然推出品质好。这里不是说好品质“绝对不可能”，而是否定两者之间的必然关系。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.2-wake.g.en: High prices do not necessarily lead to good quality. This is not to say that good quality is “absolutely impossible”, but rather to deny the inevitable relationship between the two.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「还是……最好」——拿经验给出一个“就选这个”的推荐。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: “You're best off…” — a recommendation based on experience, pointing at one option.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 问句里常听见“什么好？”“怎么办才好？”，这就是它的答法。说话人自己试过、吃过亏，所以语气笃定：要说这个情况，就这一条路。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: It answers questions like what is good or what should I do. The speaker has tried it and knows better, so the tone is firm: for this situation there is one sensible choice.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 名词／动词辞书形・ない形＋に限る
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Noun / dictionary form or ない-form + に限る

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「に限り」划范围，「に限る」给结论。中文都写“限”，但一个是“仅限本日”，一个是“还是睡觉最好”。看后面有没有名词性成分就能分。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: に限り draws a boundary while に限る delivers a verdict. Both look like 限 in Chinese, but one means only today and the other means sleeping is best. Whether a noun follows tells you which.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 累了的时候，还是早点睡最好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: When you are worn out, an early night is the best cure.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 夏天热的时候，还是冰啤酒最爽。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: On a hot summer day, a cold beer is the best thing there is.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 拿不定主意的时候，还是用最初的方案最稳。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: When in doubt, the first plan is the safest bet.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「仅限……」——在公告、规则里划一条明确的界线。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: “Limited to…” — draws a firm boundary in notices and rules.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 资格、日期、范围只到这条线为止。语体正式，广告、告示、条款里最常出现，后面接一句普通的说明，不带口语语气。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Eligibility, dates or scope stop at this line. It is formal and belongs to ads, notices and terms, followed by a plain statement with no conversational tone.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 名词＋に限り
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Noun + に限り

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「だけ」也能说“只有”，但「に限り」更像贴在墙上的告示，普通聊天里说会显得硬。中文别一律译“只有”，公告场合用“仅限”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: だけ can also mean only, but に限り reads like a notice on the wall and sounds stiff in conversation. In Chinese, reserve 仅限 for notices and use 只有 elsewhere.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 仅限今天，全部商品半价。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Today only, everything is half price.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 仅限会员使用本服务。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: This service is available to members only.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 仅限前一百名，赠送纪念品。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: A commemorative gift for the first hundred arrivals only.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「偏偏……」——麻烦专挑最不合适的时候来。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: “Of all the times…” — trouble arrives at the worst possible moment.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 平时不出事，偏偏赶在最不希望它发生的那个节骨眼上。带无奈和抱怨，后半句多是坏消息。也用于「うちの子に限って」这类“唯独他不可能”的辩解。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Nothing usually goes wrong, but it does on the very day it hurts most. The tone is helpless and complaining, and the second half is usually bad news. It also appears in defences like うちの子に限って, meaning not my child of all people.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 名词＋に限って
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Noun + に限って

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 两种用法别混：抱怨“偏偏这时候”最常考；「～に限って～ない」是“唯独某人绝不会”。前者后面接坏事，后者后面接否定，看到否定就知道是第二种。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Two uses: the complaint about timing is what exams test most, and ～に限って～ない means someone of all people would never. Bad news follows the first, a negative follows the second, so a negative tells you which one you have.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 偏偏赶时间的时候，电车就晚点。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: The train runs late on exactly the days I am in a hurry.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 偏偏没带伞的那天就下雨。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: It rains on precisely the days I leave my umbrella at home.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 我家孩子绝不会做那种事。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: My child of all people would never do such a thing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「不光……，连……也」——把范围从 A 扩出去。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: “Not only A but also…” — pushes the scope beyond A.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 先否掉“只到 A 为止”，再把 A 以外的也拉进来，后半句常跟「も」。用于说明某件事影响面比想象大。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: It first denies that A is the whole story, then pulls in what lies beyond A, usually with も in the second half. It shows that something reaches further than expected.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 名词＋に限らず
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Noun + に限らず

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「だけでなく」只是普通的“不仅”，范围感弱；「に限らず」强调的是“不受这个框框限制”。说“这家店不光年轻人来”时用に限らず更自然。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: だけでなく is an ordinary not only and carries little sense of scope; に限らず stresses that the frame does not hold. For this shop draws more than young people, に限らず is the natural choice.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 这家店不光受年轻人欢迎，也很受家庭顾客欢迎。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: This restaurant is popular not only with young people but with families too.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 不只是日语，学任何外语都要靠每天积累。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Not Japanese alone — any foreign language needs daily accumulation.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 这个问题不只在东京，全国都在发生。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: This problem is not limited to Tokyo; it is happening nationwide.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「只要……就……」——给后项设一个持续成立的前提。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: “As long as…” — sets a condition that has to keep holding for the rest to stand.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: A 这个状态一直持续，后面的判断、意志或结果就一直成立。常见于决心、承诺，句尾多接「～たい」「～つもりだ」「～はずだ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: While state A continues, the judgement, intention or result in the second half holds. It appears in resolutions and promises, often with ～たい, ～つもりだ or ～はずだ.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 动词辞书形・ている形／い形容词／な形容词＋な／名词＋である＋限り
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Dictionary or ている form / i-adjective / na-adjective + な / noun + である + 限り

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 不是“仅限某人”的范围限制，而是时间上的持续条件。中文都写“只要”，但日文这里看的是状态能不能延续：身体还行的期间、我活着的期间。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: This is not a scope limit on a person but a condition that persists over time. Chinese uses 只要 for both, but here the question is whether the state lasts: while the body holds up, while I live.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 只要身体还行，我就想继续工作。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: As long as I stay healthy, I want to keep working.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 只要我活着，就会守着这家店。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: As long as I am alive, I intend to keep this shop going.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 只要是学生，就得守规矩。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: As long as you are a student, you have to follow the rules.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「就……来看」——先把结论的边界划出来，给判断留余地。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: “As far as … goes” — fences off the evidence before judging, leaving room for doubt.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 结论只基于自己接触到的信息，超出这个范围不敢保证。常见于调查、汇报、说明，句尾多接「～ない」「～ようだ」这类留有余地的说法。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: The conclusion rests only on what the speaker has seen, and nothing beyond that is guaranteed. It appears in reports and explanations, usually with a hedged ending such as ～ない or ～ようだ.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 动词辞书形・た形・ている形＋限りでは
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: Dictionary, た- or ている form + 限りでは

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 「限り」设的是持续条件，「限りでは」划的是信息边界。前者说“只要还在”，后者说“在我看到的范围内，超出部分我不负责”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: 限り sets a condition that persists; 限りでは fences the evidence. The first says as long as it remains, the second says this is all I have seen and I speak for nothing beyond it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 就我调查到的情况来看，没有什么大问题。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.en: As far as my research goes, there is no major problem.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.3-kagiru.zh: 单看这份资料，计划似乎进展顺利。
