nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: The match tomorrow has been cancelled because of the typhoon.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 因为事故，这条路不能通行。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: This road is closed because of an accident.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 「因为……嘛」——当事人自己交代理由，带辩解味。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: “Because…, you see” — the person involved explains, with a note of excuse.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 放在原因这一组里，它的特点是“我也有苦衷”。口语里常说成「もんだから」，后半句多是道歉或推脱。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Within the cause group its speciality is that the speaker has a grievance of their own. In speech it often becomes もんだから, and the second half is usually an apology or an excuse.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 普通形＋ものだから（な形容词・名词＋な＋ものだから）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Plain form + ものだから (na-adjective / noun + な + ものだから)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 和「ために」正相反：ために像新闻稿，ものだから像当事人在解释。写报告用ために，跟朋友解释迟到用ものだから。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: It is the opposite of ために: ために reads like a news item, ものだから like the person explaining themselves. Use ために in a report and ものだから when explaining lateness to a friend.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 因为电车停运了嘛，所以才迟到。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: The trains had stopped, so I ended up late.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 因为太吃惊了，连声音都发不出来。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: I was so startled that I could not even make a sound.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 因为不认识路，绕了好大一圈。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: I did not know the way, so I took a long detour.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 「就因为……结果倒霉了」——单一原因捅出坏结果。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: “All because…” — one small cause brings a bad outcome.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: A 看似不起眼，却成了坏结果 B 的导火索。说话人常带后悔：早知道就不那样。后项原则上是负面结果。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: A looks trivial but sets off the bad result B. The speaker usually regrets it, wishing they had not done it. The second half is in principle negative.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 普通形＋ばかりに（な形容词＋な；名词＋である）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Plain form + ばかりに (na-adjective + な; noun + である)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 关键不是普通因果，而是“偏偏就因这一件事吃了亏”。用来说好结果会不自然。也别和「だけに」混——那个是“更……”，好坏都行。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: The point is not ordinary causation but that this one thing and no other caused the loss. With a good result it sounds wrong. Do not confuse it with だけに, which means all the more and works either way.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 就因为多嘴说了一句，结果把他惹火了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: One careless remark was all it took to make him angry.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 就因为没钱，只好放弃留学。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: It was only because of money that I had to give up studying abroad.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 就因为撒了个谎，把信誉全丢光了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: One lie cost him every bit of trust he had.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 「正因为……所以更……」——前项越重，后项越明显。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: “Precisely because…” — the heavier the cause, the sharper the effect.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: A 的程度、期待或特别性把 B 推得更高。它不只交代原因，更是在说“正因为如此，才格外……”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: A's degree, expectation or specialness pushes B higher. It does more than give a cause: it says that precisely for this reason the effect is all the greater.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 动词・い形容词普通形／な形容词词干＋な／名词＋だけに（な形容词・名词也可用である）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Verb or i-adjective plain form / na-adjective stem + な / noun + だけに (na-adjectives and nouns may also take である)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 这是 Day 4 的复习点。「ばかりに」是单一原因带来坏结果；「だけに」是前项让后项“更……”，好坏都能用。两个都带「に」，但方向完全不同。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: This revisits Day 4. ばかりに has one cause producing a bad result; だけに has the cause making the effect stronger, good or bad. Both end in に but they point in different directions.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 正因为一直很期待，取消时才格外失望。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: I had looked forward to it so much that the cancellation hurt all the more.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 正因为费尽辛苦才得到，喜悦也格外大。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Having worked so hard for it, the joy is all the greater.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 正因为有名，批评也格外严厉。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Being famous, it draws especially harsh criticism.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 「从……来看／因……而得名」——把线索或由来摆出来。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: “Judging from… / so named because…” — sets out the clue or the origin.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 两种用法都基于同一件事：A 是判断 B 的依据，或者 A 是某个称呼、习惯的由来。常见于说明文、词源介绍、观察报告。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Both uses rest on the same thing: A is either the basis for judging B or the origin of a name or custom. It appears in expository writing, word origins and observation reports.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 动词・い形容词普通形／な形容词词干＋な・である／名词＋である＋ことから
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Verb or i-adjective plain form / na-adjective stem + な or である / noun + である + ことから

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 它不是当事人辩解，所以别用在“我迟到了，因为……”这种场合。看到“有个特征→得出结论”或“有个特征→取了名字”，才是它。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: It is not a personal excuse, so do not use it for I was late because. It belongs where a feature leads to a conclusion, or a feature produces a name.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 因为建筑形状像船，所以被称为“船之家”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Because the building looks like a ship, it is called the Ship House.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 从聚集了这么多人可以看出它很受欢迎。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: The size of the crowd shows how popular it is.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 从一大早就有人排队，可知这是家有名的店。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: People queue from early morning, which tells you the place is famous.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 「因……，故……」——公告式的一句话交代。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: “Due to…” — a one-line notice-style statement.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 极简洁、公式化，用一句话说清原因和处理结果。只出现在告示、公告、标牌、商务通知里，不用于日常解释。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Extremely compact and formulaic, giving cause and consequence in one line. It belongs to notices, signs and business announcements, never to everyday explanations.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 名词＋につき
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Noun + につき

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 跟朋友解释个人理由不能用它，会像贴告示。看到「改装中」「工事中」「満席」这类公告语境，才读成“因……，故……”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: It cannot explain a personal reason to a friend — it would sound like a posted notice. Only in contexts such as under renovation, roadworks or fully booked does it mean due to.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 因店内正在装修，故今日暂停营业。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Closed today while the shop is being refitted.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 因施工中，此通道不能使用。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: This passage is out of use while works are under way.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 因已满座，目前无法安排入座。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: We are fully booked and cannot seat you at the moment.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 因为……导致……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Because of the...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 客观说明大雪导致高速公路封闭，「大雪のため」的接续和书面语气都合适。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: 大雪のため objectively explains that heavy snow caused the expressway closure. Its connection and written register fit the sentence.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 因为……导致……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: A neutral report of the cause, rather than a personal excuse.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 这是对比赛取消原因的客观说明，不是个人辩解。题干中逗号已给出，补「ため」。 补充：ことから可基于台风接近这一事实说明决定，だけに强调其影响，ものだから较口语地解释原因；ため更适合中性报告。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Target expression: ため. Intended meaning: A neutral report of the cause, rather than a personal excuse. Compared alternatives: ことから / だけに / ものだから. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 因为……嘛
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: A personal explanation or excuse.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 说话人正在交代自己没说好的理由，带有解释和辩解感，用「ものだから」。 补充：ことから较书面；ばかりに带“就因为这点而吃亏”的后悔。ものだから在解释失误时自然，但不是唯一可接的原因形式。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Target expression: ものだから. Intended meaning: A personal explanation or excuse. Compared alternatives: ことから / ばかりに. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 因为……嘛
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: A personal explanation or excuse.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 向对方解释自己迟到的理由，比客观报告式的「ため」更符合这个场景。 补充：ために是中性原因，だけに可强调拥堵带来的后果；ものだから更有解释／辩解口气。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Target expression: ものだから. Intended meaning: A personal explanation or excuse. Compared alternatives: ために / だけに. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 就因为……结果倒霉了
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Regret about an action that led to an unfavorable outcome.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 就因为贪便宜立即买下，结果反而付出昂贵修理费，是「ばかりに」典型的后悔与坏结果。 补充：这些形式均可说明因果；ばかりに最直接突出“一时贪便宜导致吃亏”的懊悔。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Target expression: ばかりに. Intended meaning: Regret about an action that led to an unfavorable outcome. Compared alternatives: ことから / ために / だけに. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 就因为……结果倒霉了
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Regret about an action that led to an unfavorable outcome.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 泄露秘密成了关系恶化的导火索，带有“早知道就不说”的遗憾。 补充：ものだから解释失言原因，ことから较书面说明因果；ばかりに更突出后悔。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Target expression: ばかりに. Intended meaning: Regret about an action that led to an unfavorable outcome. Compared alternatives: ものだから / ことから. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 正因为……所以更……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: A reason that makes the emotional result stronger.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 正因为准备了很久，失败的冲击才更大，前项加强后项用「だけに」。 补充：ばかりに可后悔投入过多，ことから可客观说明震动大的原因；だけに强调投入越多越失落。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Target expression: だけに. Intended meaning: A reason that makes the emotional result stronger. Compared alternatives: ばかりに / ことから. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 正因为……所以更……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: A reason that increases the expected level of attention.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 正因为是人气作家的新作，发售前就备受关注，用强调“正因为……所以更……”的「だけに」。ばかりに导出坏结果；ものだから多用于口语辩解；くせに带责备，接名词还要加「の」，都不合适。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: だけに: precisely because it is a popular author's new book, it draws attention. ばかりに leads to a bad result; ものだから is a casual excuse; くせに blames and would need の after a noun.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 因……而得名
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: A written explanation of the origin of a name.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 樱花树多是地名的由来，说明命名根据用「ことから」。ばかりに导出坏结果；くせに带责备；わりに表示与预期不符，都不适合说明名称由来。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: ことから gives the reason behind a name. ばかりに leads to a bad result; くせに blames; わりに signals a mismatch with expectations. None explains how a name came about.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 从……来看
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Evidence used as the basis for an inference.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 把窗户开着当成判断有人从此进入的线索，用「ことから」。 补充：ものだから也能以开窗这一事实解释自己的推断，较口语；ことから更清楚地把它当作证据。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: Target expression: ことから. Intended meaning: Evidence used as the basis for an inference. Compared alternatives: ものだから. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.
Because, therefore...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 这是工事现场的正式告示，「工事中につき」表示“因施工，故不可使用”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: This is a formal construction-site notice. 工事中につき means that the facility cannot be used because construction is in progress.
Because, therefore...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..zh: 店铺以公告口吻说明今日包场，名词后接「につき」最符合。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.9-cause..en: The shop will give an announcement indicating that today’s wrapping is the most suitable place for "につき" after noun.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 「随着……越来越……」——两边一起慢慢变。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: “As … , so too…” — both sides shift gradually together.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: A 一点点变化，B 也跟着程度性地变。两边通常都是渐变，不是一次性动作。中文最贴切的说法就是“越来越……”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: A changes little by little and B changes in degree alongside it. Both sides are gradual rather than one-off. The closest Chinese equivalent is 越来越.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 动词辞书形／表变化的名词＋につれて
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: Dictionary form / noun of change + につれて

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 后项不能是说话人的意志、命令或一次性决定。想说“随着长大我要当医生”，日文不能用它——那是有意志的决定，不是自然连带。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: The second half cannot be the speaker's intention, an order or a one-off decision. Saying as I grow up I will become a doctor does not work here, because that is a deliberate choice rather than a natural knock-on.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着日语越来越好，和日本人聊天也越来越有意思。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: As my Japanese improved, talking with Japanese people became more enjoyable.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着时间过去，疼痛渐渐消失了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: As time passed, the pain faded.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着城镇人口增加，垃圾问题也越来越严重。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: As the town's population grew, so did the rubbish problem.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 「随着……逐渐……」——沿一个方向往前推。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: “In step with…” — moving forward along one direction.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: A 按某个方向或阶段推进，B 依着这个趋势逐步改变。语气比「につれて」书面一些，常见于说明文、报告。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: A advances along a direction or through stages, and B changes in keeping with that trend. It is a shade more formal than につれて and appears in explanations and reports.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 动词辞书形／名词＋にしたがって
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: Dictionary form / noun + にしたがって

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 它还有另一个完全不同的用法：依照规则、指示、说明。看到「マニュアルにしたがって」就是“按手册”，不是“随着”。两种要分开记。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: It has a second, unrelated use: following rules, instructions or a manual. マニュアルにしたがって means according to the manual, not as time goes on. Keep the two apart.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着年龄增长，人们会逐渐更关心健康。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: As people age, they grow more concerned about their health.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着工程推进，噪音也越来越大。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: As the works progressed, the noise increased too.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 请按说明书组装。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: Please assemble it according to the instructions.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 「伴随着……」——一个大变动带来一串连带影响。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: “Along with…” — one big change drags a chain of side effects behind it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: A 多是规模较大的社会、组织或制度变化，B 是随之而来的配套调整、连带影响或副作用。新闻和商务文本里很常见。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: A is usually a large change in society, an organisation or a system, and B is the accompanying adjustment, knock-on effect or side effect. It is common in news and business writing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 动词辞书形／名词＋に伴って
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: Dictionary form / noun + に伴って

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 「につれて」关注渐变的程度，「に伴って」关注“这件事一来，相关的事也得跟着变”。人口增加带来交通问题，用に伴って；日语变好带来聊天变有趣，用につれて。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: につれて tracks the degree of gradual change, while に伴って tracks this change arriving and pulling related things with it. Population growth bringing traffic problems takes に伴って; improving Japanese making conversation fun takes につれて.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 伴随着人口增加，交通问题也连带着严重起来。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: With the population growth, traffic problems grew serious as well.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着公司扩大，也需要新的规章了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: As the company expanded, new rules became necessary.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 伴随地震，也出现了海啸的担忧。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: Along with the earthquake came the worry about a tsunami.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 「随着……同时……」——两件事并肩走。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: “Together with…” — two things move side by side.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: A 与 B 同时发生或并行推进，也可以表示两个主体一起行动。用来说变化时语气正式，常用于演讲、文章标题。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: A and B happen at the same time or advance in parallel, and it can also mean two parties acting together. In the sense of change it is formal and suits speeches and headlines.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 动词辞书形／い形容词／な形容词＋である／名词＋とともに
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: Dictionary form / i-adjective / na-adjective + である / noun + とともに

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 与前三项比，它的核心最宽：不一定是 A 导致 B，也可以只是两者同步。所以不能一律译“随着”，有时是“和……一起”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: Its core is the widest of the four: A need not cause B, and the two may simply be simultaneous. So it is not always 随着 — sometimes it is together with.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着时代变化，人们的工作方式也同时发生了变化。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: Along with the changing times, the way people work has changed too.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 和家人一起开始了新生活。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: I started a new life together with my family.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着经济发展，环境问题也受到关注。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: With economic growth, environmental issues drew attention as well.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着……越来越……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: And as it gets...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 适应日语的程度一点点变化，享受会话的程度也自然跟着变，用「につれて」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: To adapt to the Japanese language, the level of enjoyment naturally follows, using " につれて " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着……越来越……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: And as it gets...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着登山进程，气温逐渐下降，是典型的两种程度性变化。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: Temperatures are declining as a result of the mountain climb process, which is typical of two degrees of change.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着……越来越……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: And as it gets...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 孩子的成长与独立能力都是逐渐变化，「につれて」最直接。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: The child’s ability to grow and become independent is gradually changing, and the most direct is につれて.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着……逐渐……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: As... gradually...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 时代按方向推进，观念也依这一趋势逐步改变，书面语的「にしたがって」很自然。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: The times have moved in the direction and attitudes have gradually changed along these lines, and it is natural that the written words "にしたがって " should be written.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着……逐渐……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: As... gradually...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 计划从抽象到具体逐步推进，所需人数也随之明确，用「にしたがって」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: The number of people required for the planned step-by-step move, from abstract to concrete, is also specified by " にしたがって " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 随着……逐渐……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: As... gradually...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 按向北的路线向前推进，风逐渐变强；强调沿着进程变化用「にしたがって」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: Moving northwards, wind becomes stronger; emphasis is placed on " にしたがって " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 伴随着……，连带发生……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: And along with it, it happens.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 公司扩张是较大的组织变动，新制度是连带而来的配套需求。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: Corporate expansion is a major organizational change, and the new system is associated with demand.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 伴随着……，连带发生……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: And along with it, it happens.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 建新工厂带来周边道路的配套整备，是大变动及其连带影响。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: The construction of the new plant will bring with it a complement to the surrounding road, which will be a major change and its associated impact.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 伴随着……，连带发生……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: And along with it, it happens.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 在线教学普及带来相关服务，是一种社会变化所产生的连带结果。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: Access to online teaching brings with it services and is a cascading result of social change.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 和……一起
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: Together with … (と).

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: 这里不是变化因果，而是他和家人一起搬家，「とともに」还能表示共同行动。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: This is not a cause or effect of change, but rather a move with his family. "とともに" also represents joint action.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: ……的同时也……
她同时具有研究者和三个孩子的母亲两重身份，用「であるとともに」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: She also has a dual identity of researcher and mother of three children, using " であるとともに " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.zh: ……同时还……
这种药有两种并列功能：降热的同时还能缓解疼痛，用「とともに」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.10-chang.en: This drug has two parallel functions: it reduces pain while reducing heat, using "とともに " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 「要是真能……的话」——明知难成，还是忍不住想。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: “If only I could…” — a wish the speaker knows is a long shot.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 对实现难度高、希望渺茫或不由自己决定的事提出假设，后面多接愿望、选择或回应。条件组里的“美梦型”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: It hypothesises something hard to achieve, unlikely, or outside one's control, and the second half is usually a wish, a choice or a reply. Within the condition group this is the wishful one.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 动词可能形等＋ものなら（如戻れるものなら）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Potential form + ものなら (as in 戻れるものなら)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 和下一项只差动词形式：可能形是想，意向形是警告。「戻れるものなら」是“能回就想回”，「戻ろうものなら」是“敢回去就完了”。看前面有没有「よう」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Only the verb form separates it from the next entry: potential means wishing, volitional means warning. 戻れるものなら is I would go back if I could; 戻ろうものなら is go back and you are finished. Check for よう in front.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 要是真能去的话，我想试试环游世界。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If it were possible, I would love to travel around the world.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 要是能行，我真想回到那天重来一次。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If I could, I would go back to that day and start over.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 要是能被允许，我真想马上就辞职。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If I were allowed, I would quit the company this instant.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 「一旦……那可就……」——后果严重，别做。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: “If you so much as…” — the consequences are severe, so do not.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 假设某个危险、不得体或不希望发生的动作真的发生，后项就是严重后果。条件组里的“警告型”，句尾常接「大変だ」「終わりだ」「怒られる」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: It assumes a dangerous, improper or unwanted action actually happens and follows with a serious consequence. This is the warning member of the group, usually ending in 大変だ, 終わりだ or 怒られる.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 动词意向形＋ものなら
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Volitional form + ものなら

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 看到意向形加警告性后果，就是它，不是对美好愿望的假设。中文译“要是敢……”“万一……”，不要译成“如果能……”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: A volitional form followed by a warning is this one, not a wishful hypothesis. Chinese should read 要是敢 or 万一, never 如果能.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 你要敢说这种话，那可就会被大家反对。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Say something like that and everyone will turn against you.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 要是敢瞒着父母去留学，那可就麻烦了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If you dare go abroad without telling your parents, there will be trouble.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 这秘密要是敢泄露出去，可不会轻易了事。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Leak this secret and you will not get off lightly.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 「不先……就没法……」——A 是绕不过去的第一步。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: “Unless you first…” — A is the step you cannot skip.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: A 是判断或实现 B 之前不可缺少的前置步骤。不先做 A，B 根本无从谈起。后项几乎都是否定或无法判断的说法。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: A is the indispensable first step before judging or achieving B. Without A, B cannot even be discussed. The second half is nearly always negative or says a judgement is impossible.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 动词ない形＋ことには
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: ない-form + ことには

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 后项常是「分からない」「できない」「決められない」。如果后项是肯定结果，就换成别的说法；这一项天生带“先做再说”的否定收尾。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: The second half is typically 分からない, できない or 決められない. With an affirmative result you need a different pattern; this one is built to end in a negative that means try it first.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 不先实际用一下，根本不知道好不好用。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Until I actually try it, I cannot tell whether it is convenient.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 不先问问本人，什么都定不了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Nothing can be decided until we ask the person concerned.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 不先筹到钱，计划就没法开始。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: The plan cannot start until the money is raised.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 「除非……否则……」——A 不成立，B 一直不会变。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: “Unless…” — while A fails, B never changes.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: A 不成立的整个范围内，B 都不成立。中文常常要倒过来讲成“除非 A，否则 B”，正着译会别扭。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Across the whole range where A does not hold, B does not hold either. Chinese usually inverts it to unless A, otherwise B, since a literal rendering reads badly.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 动词ない形／い形容词くない／な形容词でない／名词でない＋限り
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: ない-form / i-adjective くない / na-adjective でない / noun でない + 限り

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 「ないことには」是必须先做的步骤，「ない限り」是持续成立的必要条件，适用范围更广，可以接“只要不……就一直……”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: ないことには is a step that must come first, while ない限り is a necessary condition that keeps holding and reaches wider, allowing as long as … does not happen, … continues.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 除非努力，否则就别指望进步。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Unless you make an effort, you cannot expect to improve.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 除非真的见一面，否则不会知道真相。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Unless we actually meet, we will never know the truth.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 除非发生事故，否则这条规则改不了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Unless an accident happens, this rule cannot be changed.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 「假如真是……的话」——先当真，再说自己的反应。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: “Suppose it really were…” — accept it for now, then give your own reaction.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 说话人暂时把某个情况当成真的，接着谈自己会怎么想、怎么选，或事情会怎么发展。后项常带个人判断和情绪。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: The speaker treats a situation as real for the moment and then says what they would think, choose, or how things would unfold. The second half usually carries personal judgement and feeling.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 普通形＋としたら（名词・な形容词现在肯定保留だ：学生だとしたら）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Plain form + としたら (nouns and na-adjectives keep だ in the present affirmative: 学生だとしたら)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 和「とすれば」的区别在落点：としたら接的是人的反应与选择，とすれば接的是推算出的数字、结论。问“你会选哪个国家”用前者，算“要花几天”用后者。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: The difference from とすれば is where it lands: としたら leads to a person's reaction or choice, とすれば to a calculated figure or conclusion. Asking which country you would pick takes the first; working out how many days it takes, the second.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 假如真要在海外工作一年，你会选哪个国家？
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If you were to work abroad for a year, which country would you choose?

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 如果我是他的立场，大概也会做同样的事。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If I were in his position, I would probably have done the same.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 要是中了彩票，你先做什么？
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If you won the lottery, what would you do first?

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 「如果按这个假设算……」——拿前提推结论。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: “If we assume that…” — push a premise through to a conclusion.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 把 A 当作逻辑前提或已知条件，推算由它得出的结论。后项多是可计算、可验证的判断，语气冷静。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: A is taken as a logical premise or a given, and the conclusion is worked out from it. The second half is usually something calculable or checkable, and the tone is cool.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 普通形＋とすれば（名词・な形容词现在肯定保留だ：必要だとすれば）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Plain form + とすれば (nouns and na-adjectives keep だ in the present affirmative: 必要だとすれば)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 两者很多时候都能通。要拉开语感：个人选择与感受偏「としたら」，算人数、算时间、推结论偏「とすれば」。考试常把两句放一起比。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: The two often interchange. To pull them apart: personal choice and feeling lean to としたら, while counting people, counting days and deriving conclusions lean to とすれば. Exams like to compare them side by side.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 如果按每天看十页这个假设算，看完需要二十天。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: At ten pages a day, it will take twenty days to finish.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 如果按一人五千日元算，十个人就是五万日元。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: At five thousand yen each, ten people come to fifty thousand.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 要是他不来，会议大概得延期。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If he does not come, the meeting will probably be postponed.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 要是真能……的话
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If you could just...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 重来人生几乎不可能，这里是对难以实现的愿望提出假设，用「ものなら」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: It's almost impossible to start a new life. This is an assumption of a hard-to-be wish, using "ものなら " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 要是真能……的话
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If you could just...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 表达“如果真有机会再见”的希望，接可能形「会える」后用「ものなら」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Attach ものなら to the potential 会える to express hope for an opportunity to meet again.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 要是敢……那可就……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: A strong warning of a bad consequence if someone dares to act.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 「弾こう」是意向形，后面又是邻居投诉的坏后果，整体用「弾こうものなら」。 补充：弾くとしたら也能假设弹琴将被投诉；弾こうものなら更强烈地警告后果。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Target expression: 弾こうものなら. Intended meaning: A strong warning of a bad consequence if someone dares to act. Compared alternatives: 弾くとしたら. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 要是敢……那可就……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: A strong warning of a bad consequence if someone dares to act.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 用意向形「話そう」假设对方真敢泄密，并给出严重后果，整体是「話そうものなら」。 补充：話すとすれば也能作假设；話そうものなら具有更强的威胁／警告意味。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Target expression: 話そうものなら. Intended meaning: A strong warning of a bad consequence if someone dares to act. Compared alternatives: 話すとすれば. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 如果不先……，根本没法……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If you don't first, there's no way...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 不先看实物，就根本无法决定是否购买，看实物是前置步骤。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: It is simply impossible to decide whether or not to purchase it without first looking at the material, which is a step forward.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 如果不先……，根本没法……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If you don't first, there's no way...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 直接询问是了解真正理由之前必须完成的步骤，后项也是「分からない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Asking directly is the step required before the true reason can be understood. The following clause uses 分からない.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 除非……否则……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Unless...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 除非本人道歉，否则“不打算原谅”这一判断一直成立，用「ない限り」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Unless the person apologizes, the refusal to forgive remains in force. Use ない限り.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 除非……否则……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Unless...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 在法律不改变的范围内，现行制度就会继续，表持续条件用「ない限り」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: The current system continues as long as the law does not change. Use ない限り for this continuing condition.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 假如真是……的话
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If it really is...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 对方在这个假设下会选择做什么，是个人反应型的「としたら」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: The other party chooses what to do under this scenario, the individual reaction type " としたら " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 假如真是……的话
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If it really is...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 接受“他说的是真的”这个假设后，询问对方会怎么做，偏个人选择。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: After accepting the assumption that “what he says is true”, ask each other what to do and prefer to choose.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 如果按这个假设算……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If that's the assumption...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 把每人五千日元作为计算前提，用「とすれば」。五千円×百人＝五十万円。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Five thousand yen per person is used as a basis for calculating it, using "とすれば. "

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 如果按这个假设算……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: If that's the assumption...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.zh: 以当前速度继续作为前提，逻辑推算剩余时间，用「とすれば」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.11-condi.en: Continues at the current rate, logically extrapolating the remaining time using " とすれば " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「别说……了，反而……」——先把预想打掉，再推到更远甚至相反的地方。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: “Far from …, in fact…” — knocks the expectation down and pushes to something further or opposite.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 先否定预想中的 A，再给出真实情况 B，B 往往离 A 更远、甚至方向相反。中文常用“别说……反而……”“不但没……还……”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: It denies the expected A and then gives the real B, which is further from A or even opposite to it. Chinese often uses 别说……反而 or 不但没……还.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 普通形／名词＋どころか
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Plain form / noun + どころか

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 后面必须接着说真实情况。如果只想说“顾不上 A”，用下一项的「どころではない」；两个长得像，任务不同：一个往下讲事实，一个停在那里说没余裕。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: A real situation has to follow. To say you have no attention to spare for A, use the next entry どころではない. They look alike but do different jobs: one carries on to the facts, the other stops to say there is no room for it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 别说日语变好了，反而比以前更不会说了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Far from getting better at Japanese, I speak it worse than before.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 吃了药，不但没好，反而更疼了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I took the medicine, and far from improving, the pain got worse.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 他不但没道歉，反而说是我不好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: He did not apologise — he started saying it was my fault.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「哪还有心思……」——现实压得人顾不上 A。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: “No room to think about…” — reality leaves no attention for A.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 因为有更紧急、更严重或更忙的现实，说话人根本没有余裕去做 A。口语常说成「どころじゃない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Something more urgent, serious or busy takes all the room, so there is none left for A. In speech it often becomes どころじゃない.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 动词辞书形／名词＋どころではない（口语：どころじゃない）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Dictionary form / noun + どころではない (in speech: どころじゃない)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 它不是普通的“不做”，而是“现在这个情况下根本顾不上”。中文用“哪还……”最容易抓住。译成“不旅游”就把语气全丢了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: It does not mean simply not doing it; it means there is no room for it in the present situation. Chinese 哪还 captures it best; rendering it as not travelling loses the whole tone.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 忙成这样，哪还有心思旅游。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I am so busy there is no question of a trip.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 受了伤，哪还顾得上工作。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I was injured and in no state to think about work.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 没钱，哪还有心思玩。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I have no money, so having fun is out of the question.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「与其……还不如……」——对 A 抵触强，宁可换一个。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: “Rather than…, I'd sooner…” — strong resistance to A, so a substitute is preferred.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 说话人对 A 很排斥，宁愿选另一个也许同样不理想、但至少能接受的 B。后项常接「ほうがいい」「ましだ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The speaker rejects A and prefers B, which may be no better but is at least tolerable. The second half usually ends in ほうがいい or ましだ.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 动词辞书形＋くらいなら
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Dictionary form + くらいなら

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 这不是冷静比较两个方案，而是有情绪的取舍：“都要 A 了，那我宁愿 B”。所以后项几乎都带主观评价，不会只是中性地陈述事实。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: This is not a cool comparison of two options but an emotional trade-off: if it comes to A, I would sooner B. The second half is therefore almost always evaluative rather than a neutral statement.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 与其继续做讨厌的工作，还不如辞掉。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Rather than carry on with a job I hate, I would sooner quit.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 与其每天加班，少拿点工资也行。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Rather than work overtime every day, I would take a lower salary.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 与其撒谎，还不如不说。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I would sooner say nothing than lie.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「到……这种程度」——拿一件事当尺子量程度。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: “To the point of…” — uses one thing as a measure of degree.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 用 A 当尺子，说明动作、状态或感受已经达到那么高的程度。常出现在夸张的表达里，如“痛到睡不着”“忙到没时间吃饭”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: A serves as the ruler for how far an action, state or feeling has gone. It thrives on exaggeration: hurting so much you cannot sleep, so busy you cannot eat.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 普通形／名词＋ほど
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Plain form / noun + ほど

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 单独的「ほど」表程度；「～ば～ほど」表两个程度联动，是“越……越……”。看到前后都是同一词的变化形式，就不是单纯的“到……程度”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Bare ほど marks degree; ～ば～ほど links two degrees and means the more the more. When both sides are forms of the same word, it is not a simple to the extent of.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 紧张到连声音都发不出来的程度。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I was so nervous I could not get a sound out.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 笑到流眼泪的程度。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I laughed until I cried.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 还没累到走不动的地步。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I am not so tired that I cannot walk.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「越……越……」——同一个词说两遍，两头一起涨。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: “The more …, the more…” — the same word twice, both ends rising.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: A 的程度上升，B 也跟着变。日语的习惯是把同一个动词或形容词重复两次，前半用ば形，后半用辞书形加ほど。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: As A rises, B changes with it. Japanese repeats the same verb or adjective, with the ば-form first and the dictionary form plus ほど second.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: Vば形＋V辞书形＋ほど；い形容词去い＋ければ＋原形＋ほど；な形容词词干＋なら＋词干＋な＋ほど
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: V ば-form + dictionary form + ほど; i-adjective stem + ければ + plain form + ほど; na-adjective stem + なら + stem + な + ほど

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: な形容词的接法最容易错：静かなら静かなほど，也可以说静かであればあるほど，但不能写成「静かならであるほど」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Na-adjectives trip people up: 静かなら静かなほど, or 静かであればあるほど, but never 静かならであるほど.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 日语越学越有意思。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The more you study Japanese, the more interesting it gets.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 越想越不明白。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The more I think about it, the less I understand.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 并不是越便宜越好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Cheaper is not always better.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「甚至不惜……」——为了目标，连这种事都肯做。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: “Even at the cost of…” — willing to go that far for the goal.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 为了后项的目标，甚至采取平常难以接受、代价很高或过度的 A。说话人往往对这种代价持保留态度。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: To reach the goal in the second half, the speaker takes action A, which is normally unacceptable, costly or excessive. The speaker usually has reservations about that cost.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 动词て形＋まで
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: て-form + まで

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「てまで」把极端行为放在目标前面（借金してまで買う）；「までして」把手段单独拎出来评价（借金までして買う）。一个偏动作，一个偏手段本身。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: てまで puts the extreme action in front of the goal (借金してまで買う), while までして lifts the means out for comment (借金までして買う). One leans on the action, the other on the means itself.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 我不想为了买那辆车，甚至不惜去借钱。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I do not want that car badly enough to borrow money for it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 我不想为了出人头地而牺牲家人。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I have no wish to get ahead at the cost of my family.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 没必要为了护着他而撒谎。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: There is no need to lie in order to protect him.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 「甚至做到这份上……」——把代价单独拎出来，表示惊讶或批评。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: “Going as far as…” — singles out the cost to express surprise or criticism.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 说话人把一个极端手段、牺牲或付出单独提出来，评价“竟然都做到这份上”。常带质疑：真有必要吗？
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The speaker picks out an extreme means, sacrifice or outlay and comments that it went that far, often with doubt as to whether it was necessary.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 名词＋までして
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Noun + までして

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 两者都表超常程度。「てまで」接动词，重点在动作；「までして」接名词，重点在手段，如「借金までして」。句尾常接疑问或否定评价。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Both mark an unusual degree. てまで takes a verb and stresses the action; までして takes a noun and stresses the means, as in 借金までして. The sentence often ends in a question or a negative judgement.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 真有必要甚至做到借钱这份上，去买那辆车吗？
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Is that car really worth going into debt for?

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 甚至熬了通宵来准备志愿活动。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: He even stayed up all night preparing for the volunteer event.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 为什么要做到那个份上去帮他？
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Why go that far to help him?

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 别说……了，反而……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Don't say it. It's just...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 先否定“旅行很开心”，再说实际上雨不停、连门都出不了，用「どころか」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: You can't even get out of the door without saying, "Travel is fun." どころか 」。

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 别说……了，甚至……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Don't even say it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 不只日语，还会英语和中文，「どころか」也能从 A 推进到程度更高的 B。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Not only Japanese, but also English and Chinese, so that "どころか" can move from A to a higher B.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 哪还有心思……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: There's nothing to think about.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 考试准备还没完成，根本没有余裕看电影，用「映画どころではない」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Exam preparation is unfinished, leaving no time for a movie. Use 映画どころではない.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 哪还有心思……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: There's nothing to think about.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 公司都快破产了，当然根本顾不上奖金，「ボーナスどころではない」很自然。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The company is close to bankruptcy, so bonuses are out of the question. ボーナスどころではない is natural.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 与其……还不如……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: It's better than...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 说话人对一边被抱怨一边工作很抵触，宁愿辞职，用「くらいなら」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The talker who complains about work on one side is in conflict with the other and prefers to resign, using the term "くらいなら " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 与其……还不如……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: It's better than...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 与其和不喜欢的人结婚，宁愿独处，是典型的「くらいなら～ほうがいい」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: Preferring to be alone rather than marry someone one dislikes is a typical use of くらいなら～ほうがいい.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 到……这种程度
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: To the extent that...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 疲惫程度高到无法站立，用「ほど」把前面的状态当作程度尺子。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The level of fatigue is so high that it cannot stand, using " ほど " as a scale rule.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 到……这种程度
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: To the extent that...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 热闹程度高到听不见说话声，用「ほど」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: High enough to be deaf to speak with "ほど".
The more... the more...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 整句是「考えれば考えるほど」，表示越想越不明白。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: 考えれば考えるほど means that the more one thinks, the less one understands.
The more... the more...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 整句是「少なければ少ないほど」，表示行李越少，移动越轻松。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: 少なければ少ないほど means that the less luggage there is, the easier it is to move around.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 甚至不惜……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: I don't even care.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 为了赚钱甚至不惜损害健康，说话人认为这种代价没有必要，用「てまで」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: In order to earn money and even to hurt health, the talker did not think it was necessary to use " てまで " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 甚至做到这份上……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: And even on this...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.zh: 把“借钱”这个极端手段单独拎出，说明说话人无法理解为买豪车做到这份上。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.12-degre.en: The extreme means of “lending money” alone means that a person who speaks cannot be understood as buying a luxury car to do so.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「老是容易……」——不好的事反复发生。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: “Tends to keep…” — something undesirable keeps happening.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 某种不太理想的行为或状态反复出现，像容易掉进去的坑。通常偏负面：抜きがち、遅れがち、忘れがち。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: An undesirable behaviour or state recurs, like a pit one keeps falling into. It is usually negative: 抜きがち, 遅れがち, 忘れがち.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 动词ます形去ます／名词＋がち
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Masu-stem / noun + がち

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「がち」看的是反复出现的倾向，「気味」看的是当下略微有点。经常容易累用がち，最近有点累用気味。中文都用“容易/有点”，但时间跨度不同。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: がち looks at a recurring tendency while 気味 looks at a slight present state. Often getting tired takes がち; feeling a bit tired lately takes 気味. Chinese uses 容易 or 有点 for both, but the time span differs.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 一忙起来，就老是容易不吃早饭。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: When I am busy I tend to skip breakfast.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 冬天容易运动不足。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: In winter people tend to get too little exercise.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 他总是不好意思，不怎么表达自己的意见。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: He tends to hold back and not say what he thinks.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「最近有点……」——状态略微偏向某一边，还没到严重。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: “A bit … lately” — the state has begun to lean one way, not seriously.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 说话人感觉身体、情绪或情况开始略微偏向某个方向，程度轻，常和「少し」「最近」搭配。多用于身体状态。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The speaker feels the body, mood or situation starting to lean slightly, with 少し or 最近 nearby. It is mostly used of physical condition.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 动词ます形去ます／名词＋気味
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Masu-stem / noun + 気味

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「疲れ気味」是最近有点累，「疲れがち」是经常容易累。前者是当下的程度，后者是反复的倾向。这一对最常考。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: 疲れ気味 means a bit tired lately, while 疲れがち means often getting tired. The first is a present degree, the second a recurring tendency, and this pair comes up most.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 最近感觉有点累。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I have been feeling a bit tired lately.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 有点感冒的样子，今天早点回去。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I feel a cold coming on, so I will head home early today.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 最近有点发胖，挺发愁。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I have been putting on a little weight lately, which bothers me.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「动不动就……」／「很有……那味」——口语化的倾向与观感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: “Prone to…” / “-ish” — a colloquial tendency or impression.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 两种用法：一是某种行为很容易发生（忘れっぽい），二是人或物显得有某种特质、颜色或印象（子供っぽい、水っぽい）。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Two uses: a behaviour that happens easily (忘れっぽい), and a person or thing that gives an impression of some quality, colour or flavour (子供っぽい, 水っぽい).

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 部分动词ます形去ます／名词／部分形容词词干＋っぽい（搭配需单独记）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Some masu-stems / nouns / some adjective stems + っぽい (collocations must be learned one by one)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 不能把任意动词机械加っぽい——忘れっぽい、子供っぽい、水っぽい是固定搭配，安っぽい也是。自己造词很容易出错。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: You cannot bolt っぽい onto any verb: 忘れっぽい, 子供っぽい, 水っぽい and 安っぽい are fixed. Coinages go wrong easily.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 他特别爱忘事，所以什么都会记下来。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: He is so forgetful that he writes everything down.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 那种说法太孩子气了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: That way of putting it is childish.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 这汤有点寡淡。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: This soup tastes a bit watery.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「一路越来越……」——朝一个方向走，没有回头迹象。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: “Steadily more…” — moving one way with no sign of turning back.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 变化沿一个方向不断推进，看不出停止或反转。好坏都能用，但负面更常见：人口减少、物价上涨。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The change keeps pushing in one direction with no stop or reversal in sight. It works both ways but is more often negative: shrinking population, rising prices.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 表变化的动词辞书形＋一方だ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Dictionary form of a change verb + 一方だ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「一方だ」相对中性，只说单向趋势；「ばかりだ」带“只会继续这样”的无奈。写报道用一方だ，抱怨用ばかりだ。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: 一方だ is fairly neutral and only reports the one-way trend, while ばかりだ carries the resignation of it will only keep going. Reports use 一方だ, complaints use ばかりだ.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 这座城市的人口越来越少，一路都在减少。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The town's population keeps shrinking.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 日元贬值，进口商品价格一路上涨。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: With the weak yen, imported goods keep getting more expensive.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 技术进步让工作方式不断变化。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: As technology advances, the way we work keeps changing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「只会越来越……」——趋势不回头，说话人有点认命。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: “Only getting…” — the trend will not turn, and the speaker has given up hoping.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 事情只沿着某个、往往不理想的方向继续走，带无奈或忧虑。常出现在抱怨物价、病情、局面的时候。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Things keep going one way, usually the unwanted way, with resignation or worry. It appears in complaints about prices, illness and difficult situations.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 表变化的动词辞书形＋ばかりだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Dictionary form of a change verb + ばかりだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 别和た形加ばかりだ的“刚刚……”混。这里接辞书形，讲趋势；接た形，讲刚做完。形式一变，意思完全换了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Do not confuse it with the た-form plus ばかりだ meaning just did. Here the dictionary form gives a trend and the た-form gives something just finished; change the form and the meaning changes entirely.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 物价只会越来越高，生活一点也没轻松。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Prices only keep rising and life gets no easier.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 病情只会越来越糟。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: His condition only gets worse.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 等了又等，情况只会越来越糟。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: However long we waited, the situation only deteriorated.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「一直……着也不管」——动作做完就不管了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: “Left …” — the action ends and nobody deals with the aftermath.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 两种意思：动作之后的状态一直放着没人处理（電気をつけっぱなし），或某动作一直持续（立ちっぱなし）。前者负面意味强，后者不一定。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Two senses: a state left unattended after the action (電気をつけっぱなし), or an action continuing without a break (立ちっぱなし). The first is clearly negative, the second need not be.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 动词ます形去ます＋っぱなし
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Masu-stem + っぱなし

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 别一律理解成“忘了关”。立ちっぱなし只是说一直站着、很累，不一定有人疏忽。判断标准是有没有“该处理却没处理”的对象。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Do not read it as forgetting to switch something off every time. 立ちっぱなし only says someone stood the whole time and got tired, with no neglect implied. The test is whether something should have been dealt with and was not.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 灯一直开着没关，我就睡着了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I fell asleep with the lights left on.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 站了一整天，腿疼。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I stood all day and my legs ache.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 请不要让水一直流着。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Please do not leave the tap running.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 老是容易……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: A repeatedly occurring, usually undesirable tendency.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 最近反复出现不出门、闷在家里的倾向，「家にこもりがち」表示经常容易这样。 补充：こもり気味描述最近略有闭门不出的状态；こもりっぱなし指持续不出门；こもりがち强调经常如此。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Target expression: がち. Intended meaning: A repeatedly occurring, usually undesirable tendency. Compared alternatives: 気味 / っぱなし. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 老是容易……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: A repeatedly occurring, usually undesirable tendency.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「なりがち」表示容易变得不规律，是反复出现的倾向。一方だ接辞书形（なる一方だ），不接ます形；にすぎない、ばかり接在「なり」后面都不成立。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: なりがち: meals easily become irregular. 一方だ takes the dictionary form (なる一方だ), not the masu-stem; にすぎない and ばかり cannot follow なり either.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 最近有点……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: A slight current condition, rather than repeated occurrences.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 说的是当下身体有一点疲惫，程度较轻，用「疲れ気味」。 补充：疲れがち也能说最近经常容易疲劳；疲れ気味则着重当下略有疲惫。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Target expression: 気味. Intended meaning: A slight current condition, rather than repeated occurrences. Compared alternatives: がち. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 最近有点……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: It's been a little...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 風邪気味是“有点感冒”的常用搭配，気味读ぎみ，表示略有某状态。不能只凭中文“有点发烧”生造「熱気味」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: 風邪気味 is an established expression meaning a slight cold. 気味 is read ぎみ and describes a slight condition. Do not invent 熱気味 simply from the idea of having a slight fever.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 动不动就……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: If you don't move...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 「忘れっぽい」是很爱忘事的口语表达，接动词ます形词干。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: 忘れっぽい is a conversational expression for tending to forget. Attach っぽい to the verb's masu-stem.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 很有……那味
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: It's... it smells like...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 说成年人的说话方式很孩子气，名词「子供」后接「っぽい」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Attach っぽい to the noun 子供 to describe an adult's childish way of speaking.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 越来越……，一路往这个方向走
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: It's getting... it's going this way.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 失业率沿上升方向持续变化，中性描述单向趋势用「一方だ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The unemployment rate continues to rise. Use 一方だ for a neutral description of a one-way trend.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 越来越……，一路往这个方向走
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: It's getting... it's going this way.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 持续练习让演奏水平不断提高，说好变化也可用相对中性的「一方だ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: Continued practice steadily improves performance. The relatively neutral 一方だ can also describe positive change.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 只会越来越……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: It's only getting...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 如果不采取对策，情况只会继续恶化，带有无奈和担忧的「ばかりだ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: If no response is taken, the situation will only continue to deteriorate and the " ばかりだ " , which has a sense of hopelessness and concern.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 只会越来越……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: It's only getting...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 不修缮的话建筑只会越来越旧，说话人对这个不良趋势带有忧虑。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The building will only grow old without renovation, and the speaker is concerned about this negative trend.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 一直……着也不管
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I don't care.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 门打开后本该关上，却一直开着就出门了，用「開けっぱなし」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The door should have been closed, but was left open when the person went out. Use 開けっぱなし.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 一直……着也不管
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: I don't care.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.zh: 申请文件放在桌上后一直没处理，「置きっぱなし」带有放着不管的语气。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.13-tende.en: The application papers were left on the desk without being dealt with. 置きっぱなし implies leaving them unattended.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「按理说应该……」——拿已知信息推，不是凭感觉。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “By rights it should…” — reasoned from known facts, not felt.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 根据既有信息、常识、计划或时间表推出结论，说话人认为这个结论在道理上站得住。中文的“应该”多半对应它。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: A conclusion follows from known facts, common sense, a plan or a timetable, and the speaker holds that it stands to reason. Most Chinese 应该 maps here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 普通形＋はずだ（な形容词＋な；名词＋の）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Plain form + はずだ (na-adjective + な; noun + の)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 三个“应该”要分清：「はずだ」是按信息推理，「べきだ」是讲责任与规范，「に違いない」是几乎不怀疑的断定。中文都写“应该”，日文的依据完全不同。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Three kinds of should: はずだ reasons from information, べきだ speaks of duty and norms, に違いない asserts with almost no doubt. Chinese writes 应该 for all three, but the grounds differ completely.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 他十点就出发了，按理说现在应该已经到了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: He left at ten, so he should be there by now.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 按地图看，车站应该就在前面。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: According to the map, the station should be just ahead.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 昨天寄的，今天应该到。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: I sent it yesterday, so it should arrive today.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「照理就该……」——从责任和规矩出发的“应该”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “Ought to…” — the should of duty and rules.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 说话人从责任、道德、规则或正确做法的角度，判断某人该不该做某事。语气带规范意味，不是推测。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: The speaker judges what someone should or should not do on grounds of duty, morality, rules or correct practice. The tone is normative rather than predictive.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 动词辞书形＋べきだ（する→すべきだ／するべきだ）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Dictionary form + べきだ (する → すべきだ or するべきだ)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 比「ことだ」强得多：ことだ是“你最好这样”，べきだ是“照理就该这样”。对上级或陌生人直接说，容易像在教训人。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It is much stronger than ことだ: ことだ says you would do best to, while べきだ says you are duty bound to. Said to a superior or a stranger it sounds like lecturing.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 答应别人的事照理就该做到。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Promises ought to be kept.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 自己的意见应该自己说出来。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: You should speak up for your own views.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 不该说别人坏话。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: You should not speak ill of others.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「最好……」——针对眼前的问题给一条实用建议。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “You'd do best to…” — one practical piece of advice for a concrete problem.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 这是 Day 5 的复习点。面对具体困扰，给出一个可操作的做法，语气像过来人，不带规范压力。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: This revisits Day 5. Faced with a concrete problem, it offers one workable move in the voice of someone who has been there, with no moral pressure.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 动词辞书形／ない形＋ことだ
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Dictionary form / ない-form + ことだ

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 和「べきだ」的差别在立场：ことだ是“我给你出个主意”，べきだ是“你照规矩该这样”。劝朋友用前者，写社论用后者。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: The difference from べきだ is stance: ことだ offers an idea, べきだ holds you to a standard. Use the first with a friend and the second in an editorial.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 想尽快恢复的话，最好好好休息。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: If you want to get well quickly, rest properly.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 拿不定主意时，最好先自己查一查。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: When in doubt, look it up yourself first.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 不想求人的话，平时就要做好准备。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: If you do not want to depend on others, prepare in advance.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「准是……」——线索摆在那儿，几乎不怀疑。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “Must be…” — the evidence is there and there is hardly any doubt.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 根据眼前的迹象或说话人的确信，强烈断定某事就是如此。中文常译“一定”“准是”。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: From visible signs or the speaker's conviction, it asserts strongly that this is so. Chinese usually renders it 一定 or 准是.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 普通形／名词＋に違いない（な形容词・名词通常不加だ）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Plain form / noun + に違いない (na-adjectives and nouns usually drop だ)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 和「はずだ」比，它更主观；和「に決まっている」比，它稍微讲点依据。はずだ重推理，に違いない重确信，に決まっている重态度。三者有交叉，别把某一条线索当成唯一答案。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It is more subjective than はずだ and offers slightly more evidence than に決まっている. はずだ leans on reasoning, に違いない on conviction, に決まっている on attitude. They overlap, so no single clue settles the choice.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 灯亮着，里面准是有人。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: The light is on — someone must be inside.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 这笔迹准是他的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: This handwriting must be his.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 练得那么苦，准能拿冠军。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: With all that practice, they must win.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「肯定就是……，这还用说」——不摆推理，直接下结论。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “Obviously…” — no reasoning shown, just the verdict.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 凭信念、经验或常识斩钉截铁地断定，常带情绪，甚至有点不耐烦。句尾语气很硬。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: The speaker settles it flatly on belief, experience or common sense, often with feeling and a hint of impatience. The ending is blunt.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 普通形／名词＋に決まっている（な形容词・名词通常不加だ）
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Plain form / noun + に決まっている (na-adjectives and nouns usually drop だ)

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 它不展示推理链，直接说“肯定是这样”，所以语气比「はずだ」强得多，不适合需要谨慎、留余地的场合，比如向上级汇报调查结果。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It shows no chain of reasoning and simply declares that it must be so, which makes it far stronger than はずだ and unfit for settings that need caution, such as reporting findings to a superior.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 那种天上掉馅饼的好事肯定是假的，这还用说。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: A deal that good is obviously a lie.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 每天练，肯定会变好。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Practise every day and of course you will improve.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 他要是不来，肯定就没意思了。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: If he does not come, it will obviously be dull.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「恐怕有……的风险」——官方口吻的风险提示。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “There is a risk that…” — the official way to flag danger.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 客观、正式地提示某个不良事件可能发生，用于天气、医疗、产品警示、新闻和官方说明。句中不出现说话人的情绪。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It flags objectively and formally that something bad may happen, in weather reports, medical notes, product warnings, news and official statements. The speaker's feelings stay out of it.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 动词辞书形／名词＋の＋おそれがある
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Dictionary form / noun + の + おそれがある

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「おそれがある」是公式提示，「かねない」是说话人按当前趋势发出警告。天气预报用前者，劝人别硬来用后者。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: おそれがある is an official warning while かねない is the speaker warning from a present trend. Weather forecasts use the first; telling someone to stop before it is too late uses the second.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 今晚恐怕有降下大雪的风险。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: There is a risk of heavy snow tonight.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 这种药有产生副作用的风险。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: This medicine carries a risk of side effects.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 大雨可能导致河流泛滥。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: The heavy rain may cause the river to flood.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 「搞不好会……」——照这样下去，坏结果真有可能。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: “Could well…” — carry on like this and the bad outcome is real.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 从现在的做法或趋势看，一个不好的结果完全有可能发生。说话人用它警告对方或表达担忧，后项基本是坏结果。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Given the current course, an unwanted outcome is entirely possible. It warns or worries, and the second half is almost always bad.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 动词ます形去ます＋かねない
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Masu-stem + かねない

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 形式上有「ない」，意思却是“有可能”，这是最大的陷阱。而且不能用来预测好事——说「合格しかねない」是错的。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It looks negative but means possibly will, which is the biggest trap. It also cannot predict good news: 合格しかねない is wrong.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 这样下去，搞不好会酿成大事故。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Carry on like this and it could turn into a serious accident.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 那么硬撑，搞不好会把身体搞坏。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Push yourself that hard and you could ruin your health.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 疏于确认的话，搞不好会出大错。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Skip the checks and you could make a serious mistake.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 按理说应该……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: It's supposed to be...

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 根据在日本工作五年这条信息，推理他按理会说日语，用「はずだ」。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: On the basis of the information that he worked in Japan for five years, it was reasoned that he spoke Japanese and used " はずだ " .

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 按理说应该……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: A reasonable inference based on the stated evidence.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 根据地图上的时间做出合理推测，不是说对方有义务到达。 补充：に決まっている可表达更强的主观确信；はずだ更贴合根据地图计算路程的推理。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Target expression: はずだ. Intended meaning: A reasonable inference based on the stated evidence. Compared alternatives: に決まっている. Some alternatives can form grammatical sentences, but change the focus, strength or register.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 请选最符合提示意思和语气的一项。其他选项换个语境也可能成立，但这里要的是提示所指的语感。
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: Choose the option that best matches the indicated meaning and tone. This tests the intended nuance; an alternative may be grammatical in another context without expressing that nuance here.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 照理就该……
nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.en: A duty or norm, rather than personal advice.

nihongo-noryoku-shiken-n2-bunpo.14-judgm.zh: 按照责任和规则，借来的东西就应该如期归还，用「べきだ」。 补充：返すことだ也能直接给建议；返すべきだ更强调归还借物的规范与责任。
