nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.0.line.4.t.en: Um, a medium draft beer and a lemon sour.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.0.line.6.t.zh: 那个，这个“天妇罗拼盘”里有什么呢？
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.0.line.6.t.en: Um, what's in this tempura assortment?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.0.line.7.t.zh: 嗯，天妇罗拼盘里有虾、章鱼、鱿鱼，还有茄子和香菇。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.0.line.7.t.en: The tempura assortment has shrimp, octopus, squid, and then eggplant and shiitake mushrooms.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.0.line.13..zh: 啊，是随心沙拉吧。嗯，里面有生菜、萝卜、金枪鱼、番茄之类的，酱汁是日式酱汁。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.0.line.13..en: Ah, the chef's-whim salad. It has lettuce, daikon radish, tuna, tomato and such, with a Japanese-style dressing.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.0.line.15..en: Yes. Have you decided on your order?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.0.line.16..zh: 那个，能再让我们等一下吗？
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.0.line.16..en: Um, could you give us a bit more time?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.0.line.17..zh: 好的，明白了。那么您决定好后，请叫我们。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.0.line.17..en: Certainly. Once you've decided, please call us.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.0.t.zh: 我今天是第一次吃巴西菜。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.0.t.en: Today's my first time eating Brazilian food.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.3.t.zh: 最近这一带开了不少巴西餐厅呢。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.3.t.en: Lately quite a few Brazilian restaurants have opened around here.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.4.t.zh: 嗯，我一直挺在意的，但一个人不太好进去呢。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.4.t.en: Yeah, I've been curious, but it's kind of awkward to go in alone.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.5.t.zh: 啊，这样啊。那太好了，今天和我一起。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.5.t.en: Oh, I see. Well, good thing you're with me today.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.6.t.zh: 嗯。我说，这个，这个“feijoada”……是什么？
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.6.t.en: Yeah. Hey, this, this feijoada... what is it?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.7.t.zh: 是feijoada。是豆子做的菜。里面有棕色的豆子和猪肉之类的，是炖煮的。是巴西的代表菜。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.7.t.en: It's feijoada. A bean dish. It has brown beans and pork and such, stewed. It's a representative Brazilian dish.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.8.t.en: Hmm, what does it taste like?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.9.t.zh: 被问什么味道我也难说——很好吃啦。嗯，啊，日本的豆子料理一般偏甜，但巴西的是咸味的。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.9.t.en: Hard to say, but it's delicious. Hmm, oh, Japanese bean dishes are usually sweet, but Brazil's is salty.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.11..zh: 所以，我第一次在日本吃豆子料理时，因为是甜的，非常惊讶。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.11..en: So when I first ate bean dishes in Japan and they were sweet, I was really surprised.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.12..zh: 我懂我懂。和想象中完全不一样的时候，真的会吓一跳呢。啊，那，我说，这个角落呢，照片里是收藏品，是什么食物？
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.1.line.12..en: I know, I know. When it's totally different from what you imagined, it's really surprising. Oh, so, hey, this corner here—in the photo it's a collection, but what kind of food is it?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.2.line.3.t.zh: 那我喝可乐。对了，能帮我去掉冰吗？
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.2.line.3.t.en: Then I'll have a cola. And could you make it without ice?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.2.line.4.t.zh: 冰咖啡和可乐，去冰，对吧。明白了。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.2.line.4.t.en: Iced coffee and a cola, no ice. Certainly.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.2.line.6.t.zh: 啊，这个，有冰呢。我明明说了不要放冰的。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.2.line.6.t.en: Ah, this has ice in it. I said no ice.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.2.line.7.t.en: Oh, I'm sorry. I'll replace it right away.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.2.line.9.t.zh: 川村先生，为什么冰不行呢？
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.2.line.9.t.en: Kawamura, why is ice no good?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.2.line.10..zh: 你看，放了冰的话，会越来越淡吧。我就是讨厌那个。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.2.line.10..en: See, if there's ice it keeps getting watered down. I hate that.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.2.line.12..en: Sorry. Sorry to keep you waiting.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.3.line.0.t.zh: 您好，让您久等了。肉酱的那位客人在吗？
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.3.line.0.t.en: Here you are, sorry for the wait. Who ordered the meat sauce?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.3.line.2.t.en: Here, this is the mushroom pasta.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.3.line.3.t.zh: 呃，那个，我不是点的番茄酱，是奶油酱。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.3.line.3.t.en: Um, excuse me, I think I ordered cream sauce, not tomato sauce.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.3.line.4.t.zh: 啊，是奶油酱吗。非常抱歉。我马上给您换。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.3.line.4.t.en: Oh, cream sauce? I'm very sorry. I'll replace it right away.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.3.line.5.t.en: Oh, it's fine. This is okay.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.3.line.6.t.zh: 这样真的可以吗。非常抱歉。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.3.line.6.t.en: Are you sure? I'm very sorry.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.4.line.0.t.zh: 客人，那个，如果您不介意的话，我们想免费赠送您两份甜点。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.4.line.0.t.en: Sir/Madam, if you don't mind, we'd like to offer you two desserts on the house.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.4.line.1.t.zh: 哎，免费？可以吗。不好意思。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.4.line.1.t.en: Huh, free? Is that okay? Sorry.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.4.line.2.t.en: Yes. Here is the dessert menu.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.5.line.0.t.zh: 让您久等了。点鸡肉汉堡的客人。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.5.line.0.t.en: Sorry for the wait. The chicken burger for the customer?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.5.line.1.t.zh: 呃，我点的可是芝士汉堡啊。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.5.line.1.t.en: Um, I ordered a cheeseburger, though.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.5.line.2.t.zh: 啊，非常抱歉。我马上给您换。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.5.line.2.t.en: Oh, I'm terribly sorry. I'll replace it right away.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.6.line.2.t.zh: 啊，不是瓶装的，我本来以为是点了生啤的。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.6.line.2.t.en: Oh, not a bottle—I thought I'd ordered draft beer.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.7.line.0.t.en: Then, a cafe au lait and an iced coffee.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.7.line.1.t.zh: 好的。是拿铁和冰咖啡，对吧。明白了。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.7.line.1.t.en: Yes. A cafe au lait and an iced coffee, correct. Certainly.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.7.line.2.t.zh: 让您久等了。点热咖啡的客人。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.7.line.2.t.en: Sorry for the wait. The hot coffee for the customer?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.7.line.3.t.zh: 不是热的，我应该是点的冰咖啡才对。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.7.line.3.t.en: Not hot—I should have ordered iced coffee.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.7.line.4.t.zh: 非常抱歉。我马上给您换。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.7.line.4.t.en: I'm very sorry. I'll replace it right away.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.7.line.5.t.en: Eh, it's fine. This is okay.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.8.line.3.t.en: Oh, sorry. I made a mistake.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.9.line.1.t.en: Yes, what can I do for you?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.9.line.2.t.zh: 那个，这个迷你甜点是什么？
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.9.line.2.t.en: Um, what is this mini dessert?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.9.line.3.t.zh: 嗯，今天的甜点是焦糖布丁。
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.9.line.3.t.en: Today's dessert is a custard pudding.

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.10.line.0..zh: 那个，这个“老人日”是什么时候？
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.10.line.0..en: Um, when is this senior day?

nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.10.line.2..zh: 上面写说仅限60岁以上的团体，但即使有一个年轻人也不行吗？
nihongo-namachukei.3.dialogue.10.line.2..en: It says it's limited to groups of people aged 60 and over, but does it not count if there's even one younger person?

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.2.t.zh: 给，这个，是伴手礼。希望你能喜欢。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.2.t.en: Here, this is a souvenir. I hope you like it.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.3.t.zh: 哇——好可爱，谢谢，由里。那么，怎么样？第一次去韩国？
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.3.t.en: Wow, so cute! Thanks, Yuri. So, how was it? Your first time in Korea?

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.4.t.zh: 很好哦——。吃的东西也不错，不过特别是购物。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.4.t.en: It was great. The food was good too, but especially shopping.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.5.t.en: Nice. So, what did you buy?

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.6.t.zh: 各种各样。夹克啦、西装啦。还有啊，日语挺通用的。所以旅行中，没因为语言吃过苦。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.6.t.en: All sorts of things. Jackets, suits, and such. And you know, Japanese was quite understood. So during the trip, there was no trouble with language.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.7.t.zh: 这样啊——。因为学日语的人很多嘛。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.7.t.en: I see. Because lots of people study Japanese.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.8.t.zh: 然后呢，在像居酒屋那样的地方吃饭的时候，年轻人用日语来跟我搭话，于是还成了朋友……。然后昨天，那个人给我发邮件了。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.8.t.en: And then, when I was eating at a place like an izakaya, a young person spoke to me in Japanese, and we even became friends... And yesterday, that person emailed me.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.10..zh: 不过，我的韩语完全不行就是了。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.10..en: But my Korean was totally hopeless.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.11..zh: 那，从今以后要好好上课了呢。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.11..en: Then from now on you have to take classes seriously.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.13..zh: 韩国的朋友啊。我也想要呢。下次休假去韩国吧。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.13..en: A Korean friend, huh. I want one too. Maybe I'll go to Korea next break.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.14..zh: 嗯，我也在想要不要再去一次。不一起去吗？
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.0.line.14..en: Yeah, I'm thinking of going again. Want to go together?

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.1.line.0.t.zh: 哎呀，高木，你晒黑了一点？
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.1.line.0.t.en: Hey, Takagi, did you get a bit tanned?

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.1.line.1.t.zh: 啊，看得出来吗？哎呀，周末和朋友去露营了。然后，把帽子给忘了……
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.1.line.1.t.en: Ah, you can tell? Geez, I went camping with friends over the weekend. And I forgot my hat...

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.1.line.2.t.zh: 啊，是这样啊。那，露营怎么样？开心吗？
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.1.line.2.t.en: Oh, I see. So, how was the camping? Was it fun?

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.1.line.3.t.zh: 那个啊，糟透了。现在不是暑假嘛。堵车很严重，去营地竟然花了5个小时。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.1.line.3.t.en: Well, it was awful. It's summer vacation now, right? The traffic jam was terrible, and it took 5 whole hours to get to the campsite.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.1.line.5.t.zh: 是啊。而且，营地人也超多，在接待处还要等。再加上，晚上吵死了吵死了。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.1.line.5.t.en: Yeah. And the campsite was super crowded, and we had to wait at the reception too. On top of that, it was so noisy at night.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.1.line.7.t.zh: 孩子们在帐篷和帐篷之间跑来跑去，年轻人们大声放着音乐，根本不是能安静眺望夜空的气氛。我可是期待着那个才去的呢。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.1.line.7.t.en: Kids were running around between tents, young people were playing loud music, so it wasn't the kind of atmosphere where you quietly gaze at the night sky. I went there looking forward to that.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.2.line.0.t.zh: 唉，选了离市中心近的热门营地，本身就是个错误呢。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.2.line.0.t.en: Well, choosing a popular campsite close to the city center was the mistake.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.2.line.1.t.zh: 也是呢……。不过，暑假不管去哪儿人都多嘛。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.2.line.1.t.en: Well, yes... But during summer vacation, no matter where you go, there are a lot of people.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.1.t.zh: 啊，青木先生。请稍等一下。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.1.t.en: Oh, Mr. Aoki. Please wait a moment.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.2.t.zh: 这个，不知道合不合您的口味，请尝尝看。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.2.t.en: I'm not sure if this suits your taste, but please have some.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.3.t.zh: 总是，总是，谢谢您。您去哪儿了？
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.3.t.en: Always, always, thank you. Where did you go?

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.6.t.zh: 那么漂亮的海，还是第一次见到。吃的东西也好吃，非常好哦。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.6.t.en: Such a beautiful sea was a first for me. The food was delicious too, it was really great.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.8.t.en: Yes. It was a nice rest.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.9.t.zh: 不过，真好啊，出国旅行什么的。真让人羡慕呢。我们新婚旅行是第一次也是最后一次了。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.9.t.en: But, nice, going abroad and all. I'm envious. For us, the honeymoon was the first and last.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.10..zh: 等孩子长大了，机会多的是哦。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.10..en: Once your child grows up, there'll be plenty of chances.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.11..en: I see. I hope there are.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.13..zh: 哎呀，总觉得，总是收到稀奇的东西，谢谢您。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.13..en: Well, you always give us rare things, thank you.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.14..zh: 哪里哪里，是不值钱的东西啦。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.14..en: Not at all, it's a trivial thing.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.15..zh: 哪有的事……。总是谢谢您。那我就不客气了。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.15..en: No such thing... Always thank you. Then I won't hold back.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.16..zh: 嗯。我不在的时候，承蒙照顾了。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.3.line.16..en: Yes. Thank you for looking after things while I was away.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.0.t.zh: 打扰了。营业组是8个人对吧？
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.0.t.en: Sorry to interrupt. Sales was 8 people, right?

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.2.t.en: This, this, everyone please have some.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.3.t.zh: 啊——，谢谢您。那我们大家就不客气了。课长，您去哪儿了？
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.3.t.en: Ah, thank you. Then we'll all partake. Section chief, where did you go?

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.5.t.zh: 诶，日光啊，挺远的吧。是全家一起吗？
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.5.t.en: Huh, Nikko is pretty far, right? With your family?

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.6.t.zh: 嗯。趁着这个连休。日光，棒极了。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.6.t.en: Yeah. Taking advantage of this long weekend. Nikko was the best.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.8.t.zh: 感受到了1200年的历史呢。而且，建筑也很壮观，不过果然红叶很漂亮，真好啊。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.8.t.en: I felt the 1,200 years of history. And the buildings were amazing, but as always the autumn leaves were beautiful—really nice.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.10..zh: 没事哦。其实，想着连休车会很多，早上4点就从家出门了。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.10..en: It was fine. Actually, thinking there'd be lots of cars during the long weekend, I left home at 4 AM.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.11..zh: 所以，没被（渡濑的）检查拦下来呢。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.11..en: So I didn't get caught up in the (Watase) check.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.12..zh: 这样啊。不过，早上4点可真够受的。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.4.line.12..en: I see. But 4 AM was tough, huh.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.5.line.1.t.zh: 吃的东西什么都好吃啦。不过，冷死了冷死了。而且，连手套都弄丢了。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.5.line.1.t.en: The food was all delicious, but man, it was so cold. On top of that, I even lost my gloves.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.6.line.1.t.zh: 海很漂亮，还看到了海龟呢。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.6.line.1.t.en: The sea was beautiful, and I even saw sea turtles.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.6.line.2.t.zh: 诶，海龟啊，真好啊。我也想去看一次呢。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.6.line.2.t.en: Oh, sea turtles, how nice. I'd like to see them once too.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.7.line.0.t.zh: 天神祭的烟花，好厉害哦。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.7.line.0.t.en: The Tenjin Festival fireworks were amazing.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.7.line.1.t.zh: 诶——，好羡慕啊。我也该一起去的。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.7.line.1.t.en: Whoa, I'm so jealous. I should've gone with you.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.8.line.1.t.zh: 我去了米兰。是第一次出国旅行呢。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.8.line.1.t.en: I went to Milan. It was my first trip abroad.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.8.line.2.t.zh: 哇——，米兰什么的，好羡慕啊。我也希望什么时候能去成。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.8.line.2.t.en: Wow, Milan and all, I'm so envious. I hope I can go someday too.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.9.line.0.t.zh: 在印度开国际会议的时候啊，导游还带我去了泰姬陵呢。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.9.line.0.t.en: At an international conference in India, the guide took me to the Taj Mahal too.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.9.line.1.t.zh: 哇——，泰姬陵啊，真好呢。真是想去一次的地方呢。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.9.line.1.t.en: Wow, the Taj Mahal, nice. It's a place I'd like to visit once.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.10.line.1..zh: 天气也很好，人也少，挺好的哦。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.10.line.1..en: The weather was good and there were few people, so it was nice.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.11.line.1..zh: 那个啊，游客很多呢。而且物价也比想象的高。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.11.line.1..en: Well, there were a lot of tourists. And prices were higher than I expected.

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.12.line.0..en: You went to Kyoto, right? How was it?

nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.12.line.1..zh: 简直最棒了。不愧是京都啊。那么有历史底蕴的城市，只有京都呢。果然最有日本味。
nihongo-namachukei.4.dialogue.12.line.1..en: It was just the best. As expected, it's Kyoto. A town with that much history is only Kyoto. It's really the most Japanese.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.0.t.zh: 不好意思。/ 打扰一下。

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.2.t.zh: 那个，我在找一种像和服一样的东西。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.2.t.en: Um, I'm looking for something like a kimono.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.4.t.zh: 啊，不，那个，我觉得那不是和服。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.4.t.en: Ah, no, um, I don't think that's a kimono.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.6.t.zh: 那个，去温泉的时候穿的……
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.6.t.en: Um, something you wear when you go to a hot spring…

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.9.t.zh: 如果是浴衣的话，在这边。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.9.t.en: If it's a yukata, they're over here.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.13..en: Is this all you have here?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.14..zh: 这个嘛，三楼那边还有更多。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.14..en: Well, we have a lot more on the third floor.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.15..zh: 啊，这样啊。那我去那边看看。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.0.line.15..en: Ah, I see. Then I'll go take a look over there.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.0.t.en: Hey, Yuko, what do you think of this?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.3.t.zh: 嗯。颜色我觉得不错，不过高岛先生好像不太喜欢这种花朵图案。钱包啊、名片夹之类的，工作上也能用，不是更好吗？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.3.t.en: Hmm. The color's nice, but I feel Mr. Takashima doesn't really like this kind of floral design. Wouldn't a wallet or a card holder be better—they're useful for work too?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.4.t.zh: 是吗？可是高岛先生有过穿花柄衬衫的时候呀。你看，前几天的发表会上不是穿了花柄衬衫吗。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.4.t.en: Really? But Mr. Takashima has worn a floral-patterned blouse before. See, didn't he wear a floral blouse on the day of the presentation the other day?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.5.t.zh: 啊，这么说来确实呢。那，那个多少钱？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.5.t.en: Ah, now that you mention it, that's true. So, how much is it?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.6.t.zh: 呃，上面写着 65 欧元。现在欧元汇率高，换成日元大概一万日元左右吧。不过在日本买会更贵。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.6.t.en: Um, it's marked 65 euros. Since the euro is high right now, that's about 10,000 yen. But it'd be more expensive if you bought it in Japan.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.7.t.zh: 嗯，也是。而且高岛先生平时也帮了我们不少忙。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.7.t.en: Yeah, that's right. And Mr. Takashima has done a lot for us.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.8.t.zh: 而且这是免税的，不用交税呢。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.8.t.en: Besides, it's duty-free, so there's no tax.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.1.line.9.t.en: You're right. Then let's go with this.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.0.t.zh: 喂，哪个习题集好呢。太多了，好纠结。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.0.t.en: Hey, which workbook is good? There are so many, I can't decide.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.1.t.zh: 说得也是。嗯，啊，这个怎么样？这本书好像挺有名的。上面写着『文法・读解』，全部都能学，不是挺好的吗？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.1.t.en: Yeah. Hmm, oh, how about this one? This book seems pretty well-known. It says 'Grammar & Reading' on it, and you can study everything, so isn't it good?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.2.t.zh: 可是，这不是面向高级者的吗？要是有太难的，水平对不上就没意义了呀。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.2.t.en: But, isn't this for advanced learners? If it's too hard, the level won't match and it'd be pointless.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.3.t.zh: 嗯，确实。那什么水平的好呢？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.3.t.en: Yeah, true. So what level would be good?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.5.t.zh: 中级是吧。啊，对面架子上好像写着『法语考试对策』。去那边看看？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.5.t.en: Intermediate, huh. Oh, over on that shelf it says 'French Exam Prep'. Want to go look over there?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.7.t.zh: 啊，这个之类的怎么样？这本《初级学完之人的法语》。语法、读解、听力都有，而且好像还能下载音频。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.7.t.en: Oh, how about this one? This book, 'French for Those Who've Finished Beginner Level.' It has grammar, reading, and listening, and it seems you can download audio too.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.8.t.zh: 说得对。有音频很好呢。水平也……好像正适合我。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.2.line.8.t.en: Right. Having audio is nice. And the level… seems just right for me.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.0.t.zh: 不好意思。/ 打扰一下。

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.2.t.zh: 我想打听一下，这个矮一点的柜子和这个颜色稍深一点的，除了颜色之外还有什么不同？设计看起来是一样的。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.2.t.en: I'd like to ask, what's different between this low chest and this slightly darker one besides the color? The design looks the same.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.3.t.zh: 啊，是低矮柜（low chest）对吧。其实，腿部的设计有点不一样。抽屉的数量和大小是一样的。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.3.t.en: Ah, it's a low chest. Actually, the design of the legs is a little different. The number and size of the drawers are the same though.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.5.t.zh: 这边这款是圆腿，而颜色深的那边是方腿的造型。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.5.t.en: This one has round legs, while the darker one has square-shaped legs.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.6.t.zh: 啊……是这样啊。我没注意到。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.6.t.en: Oh… I see. I didn't notice.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.7.t.zh: 是的。价格虽然一样，但颜色不能选，圆腿的和方腿的都只有这一种颜色。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.7.t.en: Yes. The price is the same, but you can't choose the color; both the round-legged and square-legged ones only come in this color.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.8.t.zh: 我明白了。那我就选这边圆腿的吧。而且感觉也挺配房间的氛围。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.8.t.en: I see. Then I think I'll go with this round-legged one. It seems to match the room's atmosphere too.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.9.t.zh: 谢谢您。那么，请往这边走。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.3.line.9.t.en: Thank you. Then, please come this way.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.4.line.0.t.zh: 这件毛衣，你觉得黑色和红色哪个好？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.4.line.0.t.en: This sweater—which do you think is better, the black one or the red one?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.4.line.1.t.zh: 嗯。黑色的不好吗？而且容易搭配各种颜色的衣服。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.4.line.1.t.en: Well. Isn't the black one better? It goes easily with clothes of various colors.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.4.line.2.t.en: Then I guess I'll go with that.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.5.line.0.t.zh: 你觉得送什么礼物好？我已经完全没头绪了。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.5.line.0.t.en: What kind of present do you think would be good? I've totally run out of ideas.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.5.line.1.t.zh: 那……送领带怎么样？领带的话，有多少条都不嫌多。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.5.line.1.t.en: Well then, how about a necktie? With ties, you can never have too many.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.6.line.0.t.zh: 我正想着差不多该换笔记本电脑了，但完全不知道选什么好。有什么推荐的吗？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.6.line.0.t.en: I'm thinking it's about time to replace my laptop, but I have no clue what's good. Got any recommendations?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.6.line.1.t.zh: 我嘛，笔记本电脑总之就是喜欢轻的。要说轻的话，我现在的这款怎么样？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.6.line.1.t.en: For me, with laptops I simply prefer light ones. If it's about weight, how about the one I have now?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.6.line.2.t.zh: 嗯，轻固然重要，但对我来说，屏幕大小可能更重要。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.6.line.2.t.en: Hmm, lightness matters too, but for me the screen size is probably more important.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.8.line.0.t.zh: 这个怎么样？现在是非常有人气的商品。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.8.line.0.t.en: How about this one? It's currently a very popular product.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.8.line.1.t.en: Then I think I'll give that one a try.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.9.line.0.t.zh: 这支笔真的很好用哦。我是记者。要试一下吗？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.9.line.0.t.en: This pen is really easy to use. I'm a reporter. Would you like to try it?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.9.line.1.t.zh: 啊，真不错呢。下次买的时候，就买这个吧。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.9.line.1.t.en: Oh, it's really nice. Next time I buy one, I think I'll get this.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.10.line.0..zh: 父亲节的礼物，送 Polo 衫不好吗？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.10.line.0..en: For a Father's Day present, wouldn't a polo shirt be good?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.10.line.1..zh: 嗯……但那个是不是太普通了？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.10.line.1..en: Hmm. But isn't that a bit too ordinary?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.11.line.0..zh: 给老师的礼物，不送个能在房间里用的花瓶之类的吗？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.11.line.0..en: For a gift to the teacher, why not something like a vase that can be used in the room?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.11.line.1..zh: 说的是呢。但是，花瓶……不是更好吗？老师房间里可从来没摆过花哦。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.11.line.1..en: That's true. But… wouldn't [a vase] be better? There's never been flowers in the teacher's room, you know.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.12.line.0..zh: 给小春的礼物，送首饰之类的怎么样？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.12.line.0..en: For a present for Koharu, how about accessories?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.12.line.1..zh: 怎么样呢。首饰这种东西因人而异，我倒觉得送别的更好。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.12.line.1..en: Hmm. Accessories are a matter of taste, so I feel something else might be better.

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.13.line.0..zh: 木村先生的欢送会，要准备个马克杯或者相框之类的礼物吗？
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.13.line.0..en: For Kimura's farewell party, are we getting a present like a mug or a photo frame?

nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.13.line.1..zh: 说的是呢。不过我倒觉得能留下来纪念的东西，或者鲜花之类的更好。
nihongo-namachukei.5.dialogue.13.line.1..en: Right. But I feel something that lasts, or flowers or the like, would be better.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.0.t.zh: 那，就这样吧。今天的练习就到这儿。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.0.t.en: Well, that's settled then. Today's practice ends here.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.1.t.en: Thank you for your hard work.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.3.t.zh: 去吃点什么东西吧？去吃烤肉什么的怎么样？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.3.t.en: Shall we go eat something? How about yakiniku or something?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.4.t.zh: 好啊，前辈。啊，不过我现在正缺钱呢。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.4.t.en: Sounds good, senpai. Ah, but I'm broke right now.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.5.t.zh: 说起来，我好像听说你在找兼职什么的？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.5.t.en: Come to think of it, I heard you were looking for a part-time job or something.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.6.t.zh: 是的，没错。之前做的搬家兼职，上个月结束了。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.6.t.en: Yes, that's right. The moving job I used to do ended last month.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.7.t.zh: 这样啊——。我在做清洁的兼职，时薪挺不错的哦。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.7.t.en: I see—. I do a cleaning part-time job, and the hourly wage is good.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.10..zh: 那个真的很好呢。我也想做啊。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.10..en: That's really good. I'd like to do it too.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.11..zh: 说起来，好像有一个人这个月就要不干了，我去帮你问问看吧。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.11..en: Come to think of it, one person seems to be quitting this month, so I'll ask about it.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.0.line.12..en: Please do, I count on you.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.0.t.zh: 一共850日元。……好的，谢谢惠顾。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.0.t.en: That will be 850 yen. ...Yes, thank you very much.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.3.t.zh: 之前我看到了门口贴的告示才来的。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.3.t.en: I came after seeing the notice that was at the entrance before.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.5.t.en: Are you still recruiting part-time workers?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.7.t.zh: 啊，是这样吗。太好了——。那个，我想请您让我做兼职。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.7.t.en: Oh, is that so? Great—. Um, I'd like to do a part-time job here.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.9.t.zh: 不是，我是自由职业者（打工族）。

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.10..zh: 啊，是这样啊。嗯——，先请你把简历带来，然后再面试吧。明天能带来吗？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.10..en: Oh, I see. Well, first please bring a résumé, and then we'll have an interview. Can you bring it tomorrow?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.11..zh: 可以，因为这家咖啡店离得很近，我之前就想在这样的地方工作呢。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.11..en: Yes, this café is right nearby, and I'd been thinking I'd like to work in a place like this.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.12..zh: 听你这么说我很高兴。那总之先请你把简历带来吧。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.1.line.12..en: I'm glad to hear you say that. So anyway, first please bring a résumé.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.2.t.zh: 那个，我听说8月的国际研讨会在招接待处的兼职，呃，报名是在这里吗？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.2.t.en: Um, I heard the International Symposium in August is recruiting part-time receptionists, and, um, can I apply here?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.4.t.zh: 那个，我真的很想做这份工作。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.4.t.en: Um, I really would like to do it, if possible.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.10..zh: 我叫梅野直树。呃，那个，要怎么报名好呢？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.10..en: I'm Umeno Naoki. Um, how should I apply?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.11..zh: 啊，那个是在这里。不过在那之前，呃，8月4日和5日这两天你都能来吗？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.11..en: Ah, that's here. But before that, um, can you come on both August 4th and 5th?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.13..zh: 另外，会外语的话就帮大忙了，英语或中文之类的，你会哪种吗？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.13..en: Also, it would help if you can speak a foreign language—English, Chinese, something like that. Can you speak any?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.14..en: Yes, English, I can manage somehow…

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.15..zh: 啊，那我就放心了。那请在这张纸上写下学号、姓名和手机号好吗？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.15..en: Oh, that's reassuring. Then, could you write your student ID number, name, and cell phone number on this paper?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.17..zh: 另外，7月20日下午2点会进行工作说明，务必出席哦。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.17..en: Also, we'll explain the work from 2 p.m. on July 20th, so please be sure to attend.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.19..zh: 地点是这栋楼三楼的会议室。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.19..en: The place is the conference room on the 3rd floor of this building.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.20..zh: 好的，我明白了。请多多关照。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.2.line.20..en: Yes, I understand. Please take care of me.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.0.t.zh: 啊，我跟你说，我现在打工地那家店……
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.0.t.en: Ah, you know, the shop where I currently work part-time…

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.2.t.zh: 从下个月起，服装卖场要扩大了。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.2.t.en: From next month the clothing section is going to be expanded.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.4.t.zh: 所以店长跟我说，问有没有合适的人。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.4.t.en: So the manager asked me if I know any good people.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.7.t.zh: 诶，我？嗯，也不是说没兴趣啦。不过接下来找工作会很忙。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.7.t.en: Eh, me? Well, it's not that I'm not interested. But job hunting is going to get busy from now on.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.10..zh: 时薪的话，平时1600日元、周末2000日元，我觉得不差哦。交通费也照常给。而且打工的女生买衣服还能半价呢。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.10..en: The hourly wage is 1600 yen on weekdays and 2000 on weekends, so I think it's not bad. They also properly pay transportation fees. Besides, part-timers can buy clothes at half price too.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.11..zh: 诶，能便宜买衣服，不错呢。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.11..en: Wow, being able to buy clothes cheaply is nice.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.12..zh: 而且，他们说想要能一周工作4天以上的人。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.12..en: And they want someone who can work four or more days a week, I heard.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.13..zh: 哎——，那我做不到。不过一周3天左右的话还行。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.13..en: Eh, then that's impossible for me. But three days a week would be fine.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.15..zh: 啊，去问问真菜怎么样？她最近还说挺闲的。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.15..en: Ah, why don't you ask Mana-chan? She said she's been pretty free lately.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.16..zh: 啊，是这样啊。嗯，那我去问问她。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.3.line.16..en: Ah, I see. Yeah, then I'll ask her.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.4.line.0.t.zh: 之前我们聊过的那份兼职……
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.4.line.0.t.en: About that part-time job we talked about the other day.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.4.line.1.t.en: Yeah, did you ask the manager?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.4.line.2.t.zh: 没，其实，不好意思，好像已经定下来了。抱歉。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.4.line.2.t.en: No, actually, sorry, but it seems it's already been decided. Sorry.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.4.line.3.t.en: Ah, I see—. What a pity.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.5.line.2.t.zh: 那个，我听说这里在招收银的兼职。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.5.line.2.t.en: Um, I heard you're recruiting for a cashier part-time job here.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.5.line.3.t.zh: 啊，是的。请稍等一下。我去把店长叫来。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.5.line.3.t.en: Ah, yes. Please wait a moment. I'll go call the manager.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.6.line.0.t.zh: 呐，我听小陈说，好像在找什么活动的志愿者？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.6.line.0.t.en: Hey, I heard from Chan that you're looking for volunteers for some event?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.6.line.2.t.en: Yeah, well… What would I do?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.6.line.3.t.zh: 那个，我们在筹划和新来的留学生们的交流会，需要有人帮忙准备食物之类的。你来帮忙吗？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.6.line.3.t.en: You see, we're planning a mixer with the new international students, and we want someone to help prepare food and such. Can you do it?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.7.line.0.t.zh: 那个，老师。是关于您今天早上说的，去日本商社实习的事情。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.7.line.0.t.en: Um, teacher. It's about the internship at a Japanese trading company you mentioned this morning.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.7.line.2.t.zh: 我这学期有必须修的课，没法报名，请问明年还招人吗？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.7.line.2.t.en: I have a required class this semester so I can't apply, but will you recruit again next year?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.7.line.3.t.zh: 唔，明年的事还不清楚呢。这个是今年第一次招募哦。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.7.line.3.t.en: Hmm, I don't know about next year. This is the first time we're recruiting this year.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.8.line.0.t.zh: 你知不知道什么好的兼职？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.8.line.0.t.en: Do you know any good part-time jobs?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.8.line.1.t.en: What kind of job do you want?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.8.line.2.t.zh: 工作什么都行，我就是想一周大概干3天左右。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.8.line.2.t.en: The work can be anything, but I'd like to work about three days a week.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.8.line.3.t.zh: 一周3天啊。啊，说起来，车站前那家书店贴出了招兼职的告示哦。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.8.line.3.t.en: Three days a week, huh. Ah, come to think of it, the bookstore in front of the station had a help-wanted notice up.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.8.line.4.t.zh: 真的？！那我今天回去顺路去看看吧。
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.8.line.4.t.en: For real?! Then I'll stop by on my way home today.

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.9.line.0.t.zh: 我说啊，我现在在做配送的工作，不过人手不够。怎么样？你没兴趣吗？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.9.line.0.t.en: Hey, I'm doing delivery work now, but we're short on people. What do you think? Not interested?

nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.9.line.1.t.zh: 也不是没兴趣啦。诶，时薪不错吗？
nihongo-namachukei.6.dialogue.9.line.1.t.en: It's not that I'm not interested. Eh, is the hourly wage good?

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.0.line.0.t.en: Hey sis, did you change your hairstyle?

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.0.line.2.t.zh: 不奇怪啊。我觉得还挺适合的。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.0.line.2.t.en: No, it's not. I think it really suits you.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.0.line.3.t.zh: 太好了。我之前一直担心呢。因为换了美容院，怕会不会不适合。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.0.line.3.t.en: Great. I was kind of worried. Since I changed hair salons, I was afraid it might not suit me.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.0.line.4.t.zh: 没什么好担心的，很适合你。而且看起来比以前瘦了不少。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.0.line.4.t.en: No need to worry, it suits you. And you look a lot slimmer than before.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.0.line.5.t.zh: 那是什么意思？说看起来瘦了？
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.0.line.5.t.en: What do you mean by that? 'You look slimmer'?

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.0.line.7.t.en: Geez, you always say too much.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.0.t.zh: 啊，真野，你买包了啊。真好看。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.0.t.en: Oh, Mano, did you buy a bag? It's lovely.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.1.t.zh: 谢谢。一眼就喜欢上这个红色了。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.1.t.en: Thank you. I fell for this red color at first sight.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.2.t.zh: 嗯，就是。而且形状也很好看。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.2.t.en: Yes, indeed. And the shape is nice too.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.3.t.zh: 嗯，是啊。能放得下A4尺寸，而且底部宽，便当也能直接放进去，很方便。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.3.t.en: Yes, exactly. It fits A4 size, and since the base is wide, a lunch box fits right in—very handy.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.4.t.zh: 能放便当啊。真不错。我也在找这样的呢。那是网上买的吗？
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.4.t.en: It fits a lunch box? Nice. I've been looking for one like that. Did you buy it online?

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.5.t.zh: 不是，是车站前的一家包店。你看，就是店门口摆了很多包的那家，有吧？
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.5.t.en: No, it's a bag shop in front of the station. You know, the one with lots of bags displayed outside—that one, right?

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.6.t.zh: 啊，对。是有呢。那家店我没进去过，里面有好东西吗？
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.6.t.en: Oh, yes. There is. I've never been inside, but do they have good stuff?

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.7.t.zh: 嗯，摆放着各种各样的包，很有意思哦。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.7.t.en: Yes, they have all kinds of bags on display, it's interesting.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.8.t.zh: 这样啊。那我下次进去看看。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.1.line.8.t.en: I see. Then I'll go in and take a look sometime.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.0.t.zh: 哦，高木。我听说了。听说昨天的发表会特别棒？
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.0.t.en: Oh, Takagi. I heard about it. Your presentation yesterday was really great, I heard?

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.2.t.zh: 山岸。他说幻灯片简直完美。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.2.t.en: Yamagishi. He said the slides were perfect.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.3.t.zh: 没那么夸张啦。不过没被问到奇怪的问题，算是走运吧。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.3.t.en: Not that much. Well, I was lucky no weird questions came up.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.4.t.zh: 你做幻灯片之类的还挺拿手的嘛。我可最不擅长那个了。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.4.t.en: You're good at making slides and stuff, huh. I'm terrible at that kind of thing.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.5.t.zh: 啊，是吗。我幻灯片倒没问题，就是讲话嘛……所以前一天一直在练习。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.5.t.en: Ah, I guess. Slides are no problem for me, but the speaking part... so I practiced all day the day before.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.8.t.zh: 我说，今晚有空吗？我下周要发表，能帮我做一下幻灯片吗？
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.8.t.en: Hey, are you free tonight? I have a presentation next week—could you help me make the slides?

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.9.t.zh: 今晚？哦，行啊。我也没有兼职。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.9.t.en: Tonight? Oh, sure. I don't have my part-time job either.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.10..zh: 哦，帮大忙了。那6点的课一结束我就联系你。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.2.line.10..en: Oh, you're a lifesaver. I'll contact you after class ends at 6.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.2.t.zh: 最近，你的网球水平是不是提高了？
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.2.t.en: Lately, hasn't your tennis skill improved?

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.4.t.en: Yes. I think you've improved a lot.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.5.t.zh: 这一个月左右，我一直在做老师教我的影像训练。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.5.t.en: For about the last month, I've been doing the imagery training the coach taught me.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.6.t.zh: 嘿，影像训练，那个挺不错的吧。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.6.t.en: Oh, imagery training—that's good, isn't it.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.8.t.zh: 大家一开始都不信，但试过之后就会发现很有效果呢。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.8.t.en: Everyone doesn't believe it at first, but once they try it, it really works.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.9.t.zh: 对对对，就是那样。真多亏了教练。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.9.t.en: Exactly, exactly. It's really thanks to you, coach.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.10..zh: 哪里哪里，什么多亏。是木村你自己努力的结果。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.10..en: No no, not at all. It's your own effort, Kimura.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.11..zh: 没那回事。不过您这么说，我很受鼓舞。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.11..en: Not at all. But it encourages me to hear you say so.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.12..zh: 照这样下去，下届大会夺冠也不是梦了吧。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.12..en: At this rate, winning the next tournament might not be a dream either.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.13..zh: 哎呀，还没到那一步。不过我会以夺冠为目标努力的。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.3.line.13..en: Aw, not that far yet. But I'll aim for the championship and do my best.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.4.line.0.t.zh: 哇，太好了。田中君，你唱歌真的好厉害呢。声音也很好听。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.4.line.0.t.en: Wow, nice. Tanaka, you really sing well. And your voice is good too.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.5.line.0.t.zh: 最近，你做饭的水平是不是提高了？

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.5.line.2.t.zh: 嗯，以前也好吃，但感觉变得更好吃了。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.5.line.2.t.en: Yeah, it was good before too, but I feel it's gotten even tastier.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.5.line.3.t.zh: 好！以前啊，分量啦顺序啦都随便弄，最近我都会好好看食谱做了。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.5.line.3.t.en: Great! Before, I was careless with amounts and order, but lately I've been properly following recipes.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.5.line.4.t.zh: 嗯，光是那样就变了不少呢。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.5.line.4.t.en: Hmm, just that makes quite a difference, huh.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.6.line.0.t.en: Hmm? Did you change your hairstyle?

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.6.line.2.t.zh: 那个发型，跟木村先生特别配呢。感觉不错。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.6.line.2.t.en: That hairstyle really suits you, Kimura. Looks good.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.7.line.1.t.zh: 山田，你的那条领带真时髦。跟西装也很搭。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.7.line.1.t.en: Yamada, that necktie is stylish. It goes well with your suit too.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.7.line.2.t.zh: 是吗？我老婆说它太朴素了，是她买回来的，不过是不是有点花哨啊。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.7.line.2.t.en: You think? My wife said it was plain and bought it for me, but maybe it's a bit flashy.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.7.line.3.t.zh: 没那回事。您夫人品味真好呢。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.7.line.3.t.en: Not at all. Your wife has good taste.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.8.line.0.t.zh: 那条牛仔裤不错。很适合你呢。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.8.line.0.t.en: Those jeans are nice. They really suit you.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.8.line.1.t.zh: 是吗？谢谢。我周日买的。很喜欢那个颜色。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.8.line.1.t.en: Really? Thanks. I bought them on Sunday. I love the color.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.9.line.0.t.zh: 美纪，你英语真的好厉害。发音像母语者一样。能说到那种程度，都能当口译了吧。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.9.line.0.t.en: Miki, your English is really good. Your pronunciation is like a native's. If you can speak that well, you could be an interpreter.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.9.line.1.t.zh: 哪有，口译不可能啦。不更努力学的话，单词完全不够用。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.9.line.1.t.en: No way, interpreting is impossible. If I don't study more, I'm totally lacking in vocabulary.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.10.line.0..zh: 山田的家，总是收拾得干干净净呢。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.10.line.0..en: Yamada's house is always so neat and tidy.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.10.line.2..zh: 嗯，而且家具的品位也很好。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.10.line.2..en: Yes, and your taste in furniture is good too.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.10.line.3..zh: 啊，家具嘛，是我丈夫喜欢的……。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.10.line.3..en: Ah, the furniture, my husband likes it...

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.10.line.4..zh: 啊，是这样啊。我家完全没那种兴趣。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.10.line.4..en: Oh, I see. My house has absolutely no interest in that sort of thing.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.11.line.0..zh: 今天的发表会，很容易懂呢。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.11.line.0..en: Today's presentation was easy to understand.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.11.line.1..en: Is that so? Thank you very much.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.11.line.2..zh: 说话的速度也刚好，图表也很好看，真是完美呢。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.11.line.2..en: Your speaking pace was just right, and the graphs were easy to read—it was perfect.

nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.11.line.3..zh: 谢谢您。您这么说，我很受鼓舞。
nihongo-namachukei.7.dialogue.11.line.3..en: Thank you. It encourages me to hear you say so.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.0.line.2.t.zh: 那个，两周后的大阪出差，飞机还是新干线，选哪个？我在想飞机的票是不是差不多该先预订了。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.0.line.2.t.en: Um, about the Osaka business trip in two weeks—should we go by plane or Shinkansen? I was thinking we should probably book the flight soon.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.0.line.3.t.zh: 也是。嗯——，我哪个都行，但要说更偏向哪个，大概是新干线吧。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.0.line.3.t.en: Right. Hmm, either is fine with me, but if I had to pick, probably the Shinkansen.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.0.line.4.t.zh: 到了那边之后还得换乘普通线（在来线）吧？
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.0.line.4.t.en: You have to transfer to a local line after arriving there, right?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.0.line.6.t.zh: 那样的话，新干线不是更轻松吗？而且还有行李。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.0.line.6.t.en: Then isn't the Shinkansen easier? We've also got luggage.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.0.line.7.t.zh: 也是。这边的出发时间会变早一点，不过到了那边方便些比较好。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.0.line.7.t.en: True. Our departure time from here will be a bit earlier, but it's better to be convenient once we arrive.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.0.line.9.t.en: Then I'll go ahead and book the Shinkansen.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.2.t.zh: 飞往博多的飞机，还飞吗？
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.2.t.en: Does the flight to Hakata still operate?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.3.t.zh: 不，非常抱歉。受台风影响，上午的全部航班都取消了。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.3.t.en: No, I'm very sorry. Due to the typhoon, all morning flights have been canceled.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.5.t.zh: 是的。下午的航班应该没问题……按安排，最早的一班是13点出发。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.5.t.en: Yes. I think the afternoon flights are fine... According to the schedule, the earliest one departs at 1:00 PM.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.6.t.zh: 啊，如果是1点的话，现在才开始的话，坐新干线反而更快吧。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.6.t.en: Oh, if it's 1 o'clock, then from now it'd be faster to take the Shinkansen, right?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.7.t.zh: 如果您赶时间，我想那样确实更可靠。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.7.t.en: If you're in a hurry, I think that would be more certain.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.8.t.zh: 嗯——，抱歉啊，一开始就坐新干线就好了。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.8.t.en: Hmm, sorry, I should have just taken the Shinkansen from the start.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.11..zh: 好的，明白了。我现在为您办理手续。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.1.line.11..en: Yes, certainly. I'll process it right away.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.0.t.zh: 柳田小姐，现在方便说几句吗？
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.0.t.en: Yanada, do you have a moment now?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.2.t.zh: 那个，今天下午有个会谈，要去町中书店，不过我是第一次去。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.2.t.en: Um, I have a meeting this afternoon and I'm supposed to go to Machinaka Shoten, but it's my first time.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.4.t.zh: 我看了下怎么去，是坐JR比较好呢，还是银座线比较好？时间好像差不太多。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.4.t.en: So I looked into how to get there—is it better to go by JR, or would the Ginza Line be better? The time doesn't seem to differ much.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.5.t.zh: 嗯——，町中书店是在本乡三丁目吧？
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.5.t.en: Umm, Machinaka Shoten is at Hongo-sanchome, right?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.7.t.zh: 那样的话，不坐JR，坐银座线会不会更好？坐银座线的话，在赤坂见附下车换乘，下了车同一个站台就有丸之内线过来哦。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.7.t.en: Then wouldn't the Ginza Line be better instead of JR? With the Ginza Line, you get off at Akasaka-mitsuke to transfer, and the Marunouchi Line comes to the same platform you arrive at.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.9.t.zh: 然后坐那趟线在本乡三丁目下车就行，所以那边换乘更方便呢。也比坐JR便宜哦。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.9.t.en: Then you just take that and get off at Hongo-sanchome, so that way the connection is more convenient. It's cheaper than using JR too.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.10..zh: 啊，是这样啊。谢谢您。帮大忙了。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.10..en: Oh, I see. Thank you very much. That's a big help.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.12..zh: 东京啊，真的有好多去法，好难啊。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.12..en: Tokyo really has so many ways to get around, it's complicated.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.13..zh: 是吗。我刚来东京的时候，也不知道该坐哪趟电车，经常问别人。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.13..en: Is that so? When I first came to Tokyo, I didn't know which train to take and often asked people.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.14..zh: 诶——，连日本人都是这样啊。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.2.line.14..en: Huh, even Japanese people are like that.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.3.line.2.t.zh: 那个，我这趟高速巴士是第一次坐。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.3.line.2.t.en: Um, this is my first time on this highway bus.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.3.line.4.t.zh: 从这里到终点鹿岛大概要多久？
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.3.line.4.t.en: From here, about how long does it take to Kashima, the last stop?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.3.line.5.t.zh: 这个嘛。现在的话大概1小时5分钟左右吧。这个时段没有堵车。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.3.line.5.t.en: Let's see. Right now it'd probably be about 1 hour 5 minutes. At this time of day there's no traffic.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.3.line.6.t.zh: 诶，一个多小时就到了吗。那比电车快多了呢。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.3.line.6.t.en: Wow, it arrives in just over an hour? Then it's much faster than the train.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.3.line.7.t.zh: 嗯，不过也看时段。晚上的话大概就是那个时间。我晚上也总是坐巴士哦。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.3.line.7.t.en: Yes, though it depends on the time. At night it's about that long. I always take the bus at night too.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.3.line.8.t.zh: 其实我还在犹豫是坐电车还是坐巴士，不过坐巴士真是选对了。太感谢您了。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.3.line.8.t.en: Actually, I was wavering between the train and the bus, but I'm glad I chose the bus. Thank you so much.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.4.line.0.t.zh: 呐，从车站到大学，走路还是坐公交，选哪个？
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.4.line.0.t.en: Hey, from the station to the university, walk or take the bus—which will it be?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.4.line.1.t.en: It's raining, so let's take the bus.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.5.line.0.t.zh: 是关于北海道旅行的事。

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.5.line.2.t.zh: 是从这边开车去？还是到了那边再租车？宫田你觉得哪个好？
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.5.line.2.t.en: Should we drive from here? Or rent a car after we arrive? Miyata, which do you prefer?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.5.line.3.t.zh: 诶——，从这边一直开很累，到了那边再租租车比较好吧。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.5.line.3.t.en: Well, driving all the way from here is tiring, so maybe renting a car after we arrive would be better.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.6.line.0.t.zh: 不好意思，我想去市政府，公交和电车哪个更快？
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.6.line.0.t.en: Excuse me, I want to go to the city hall—which is faster, the bus or the train?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.6.line.1.t.zh: 我觉得公交更快，不过公交车站挺远的。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.6.line.1.t.en: I think the bus is faster, but the bus stop is far.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.7.line.0.t.zh: 那个，不好意思。我想去中央医院，走路能到吗？还是坐公交比较好呢？
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.7.line.0.t.en: Um, excuse me. I want to go to Chuo Hospital—can I walk there? Or would the bus be better?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.7.line.1.t.zh: 中央医院啊。走路也能到哦。就是要花15分钟左右。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.7.line.1.t.en: Chuo Hospital, huh. You can walk there. It takes about 15 minutes though.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.8.line.0.t.zh: 这条路早上会堵吗？我在想不开电车，开车去算了。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.8.line.0.t.en: Is this road crowded in the morning? I'm thinking of going by car instead of train.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.8.line.1.t.en: It's pretty crowded in the morning.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.8.line.3.t.zh: 嗯，我觉得坐电车去比较好哦。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.8.line.3.t.en: Yeah, I think it's better to go by train.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.9.line.0.t.en: What'll you do? Go by subway? By JR?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.9.line.1.t.zh: 也是——。而且不用换乘，坐JR怎么样？虽然贵一点。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.9.line.1.t.en: Right. There's no transfer, so why not JR? It's a bit pricey though.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.10.line.0..zh: 这次出差，新干线还是飞机，选哪个？
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.10.line.0..en: For this upcoming business trip, Shinkansen or plane—which will it be?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.10.line.1..zh: 这个嘛。飞机到机场很远，挺不方便的。果然还是新干线比较方便吧。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.10.line.1..en: Let's see. The airport is far, so the plane is pretty inconvenient. Isn't the Shinkansen more convenient after all?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.11.line.0..zh: 那个，我想去市政府，从这儿的话，坐电车去比较好吗？
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.11.line.0..en: Um, I want to go to the city hall—from here, is it better to go by train?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.11.line.1..zh: 嗯——，这个嘛。坐电车的话，走到车站挺远的哦。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.11.line.1..en: Let's see, hard to say. With the train, the walk to the station is far.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.11.line.3..zh: 相对而言，公交班次也多，我觉得比较好哦。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.11.line.3..en: Relatively speaking, the bus has more frequent service, so I think it's better.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.12.line.0..en: For Kobe, how will we get there?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.12.line.1..zh: 嗯——，看价格吧。便宜的话，什么都行。我没钱嘛。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.12.line.1..en: Hmm, depends on the price. If it's cheap, anything's fine. I'm low on money.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.12.line.2..zh: 嗯，那我们找找最便宜的方式吧。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.12.line.2..en: Yeah, then let's look for the cheapest way.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.13.line.0..en: What line should we take to Shinjuku?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.13.line.1..zh: 什么都行，只要换乘少，哪条都可以。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.13.line.1..en: Anything's fine, as long as there are few transfers—any of them.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.13.line.2..en: OK. Then wait a sec, I'll look it up.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.14.line.0..zh: 那个，从这里坐公交到上浦站大概要多久？
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.14.line.0..en: Um, about how long does the bus take from here to Kamiuma Station?

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.14.line.1..zh: 啊——，公交吗。坐公交的话挺花时间的。要30分钟以上吧。开车的话10分钟，不过。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.14.line.1..en: Ah, the bus? By bus it takes time—over 30 minutes, maybe. By car it's 10 minutes though.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.14.line.2..en: I see, thank you very much.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.15.line.0..zh: 不好意思。去中央邮局怎么走最方便？我刚搬来，不太清楚。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.15.line.0..en: Excuse me. What's the most convenient way to get to the Chuo Post Office? I just moved here and don't know.

nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.15.line.1..zh: 看时段呢。早上和傍晚公交班次挺多的，坐公交方便，不过白天公交几乎不跑哦。
nihongo-namachukei.8.dialogue.15.line.1..en: It depends on the time. In the morning and evening there are quite a few bus runs, so the bus is convenient, but during the day buses hardly run.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.0.t.zh: 那个，我昨天买了台新打印机。然后，我在想之前那台打印机该怎么处理呢，河野先生，您有打印机吧？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.0.t.en: Um, I bought a new printer yesterday. So I was wondering what to do with my old one, and Kono-san, you have a printer, right?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.1.t.zh: 嗯，是有，不过其实又旧，我又不怎么喜欢。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.1.t.en: Yes, I have one, but actually it's old and I don't really like it.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.2.t.zh: 这样啊。我的不是彩色的，是黑白激光打印机，您要是想要的话，怎么样？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.2.t.en: Oh, I see. Mine isn't color, it's a black-and-white laser printer, but if you'd like, how about it?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.3.t.zh: 啊，激光的话不错呢。我现在用的这台是喷墨的，彩色是挺好，但打印不清晰。我正想要激光的呢。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.3.t.en: Oh, if it's laser, that's good. The one I have now is inkjet; the color is fine, but the print isn't clear. I've been wanting a laser one.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.4.t.zh: 虽然不是彩色的，可以吗？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.4.t.en: It's not color, but is that okay?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.5.t.zh: 可以。那样的话体积也不大，也不占地方，我很高兴。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.5.t.en: Yes. That way it's not big and doesn't take up space, so I'm happy.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.6.t.zh: 啊，太好了。扔掉也太可惜了，我还在想有没有谁能收下呢。对了，大小正好是这样，一个人能拿得动的尺寸。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.6.t.en: Oh, great. It'd be a waste to throw away, and I was wondering if there was anyone who'd take it. Oh, the size is about this much—something one person can carry.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.8.t.en: Then shall I send it to your home?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.9.t.zh: 可以吗。那就用货到付款吧，麻烦您了。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.9.t.en: Is that okay? Then please send it cash-on-delivery.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.0.line.11..en: Thank you very much. That helps me out.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.0.t.zh: 啊，美咲。你妹妹家快生孩子了吧，你之前说过。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.0.t.en: Oh, Maki. Your sister's family is about to have a baby soon, you said, right?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.2.t.en: So about three more months then.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.3.t.en: Yeah, but why do you ask?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.4.t.zh: 我在想我家的婴儿床，你妹妹要不要呢。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.4.t.en: I was thinking maybe your sister could use our baby bed.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.5.t.zh: 诶，我想她会高兴的。我觉得她还没买呢。我去问问看吧。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.5.t.en: Wow, I think she'd be happy. I don't think she's bought one yet. Shall I ask her?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.6.t.en: Yeah. So could you ask her for me?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.7.t.zh: 嗯，好啊。那是什么颜色的？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.7.t.en: Sure, okay. So what color is it?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.8.t.zh: 嗯，是白色的，但不是纯白，大概是偏白的奶油色吧。不过不好说明白，我拍张照片发给你。尺寸我也量一下。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.8.t.en: Well, it's white, but not pure white—more of an off-white creamy color, I guess. But it's hard to explain, so I'll take a photo and send it. I'll measure the size too.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.9.t.zh: 嗯，谢谢。那如果我妹妹说想要，钱该怎么给？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.9.t.en: Okay, thanks. So if my sister says she wants it, how should we handle the money?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.10..zh: 啊，钱就不用了。我只是觉得扔掉太可惜、又不愿意扔，能有人收下我就谢天谢地了。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.10..en: Oh, money's fine, don't worry about it. I just didn't want to throw it away since that'd be a waste, so I'm just grateful if someone takes it.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.11..zh: 好吧……，那我先去问问看。钱的事之后再商量吧。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.1.line.11..en: Okay..., then I'll ask her first. Let's discuss the money later.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.0.t.zh: 松井先生，您搬家的话，要搬很远吗？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.0.t.en: Matsui-san, when you move, are you moving quite far?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.1.t.zh: 嗯，什么都还没整理，大概会在毕业典礼后那一周吧。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.1.t.en: Yeah, I haven't packed anything yet, so probably the week after the graduation ceremony.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.2.t.zh: 有什么要帮忙的，尽管跟我说哦。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.2.t.en: If there's anything I can help with, just let me know, okay?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.3.t.zh: 嗯，谢谢。啊，对了。大野先生，你要洗衣机吗？公司宿舍有投币式洗衣店，所以我已经不需要了。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.3.t.en: Yeah, thanks. Oh, that's right. Ono-san, do you need a washing machine? The company dorm has a coin laundry, so I don't need mine anymore.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.4.t.zh: 洗衣机吗。我大概半年前才刚买了台新的。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.4.t.en: A washing machine? I just bought a new one about half a year ago.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.5.t.en: Oh, I see. Then you don't need it.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.6.t.zh: 是的，难得您的好意，不过……
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.6.t.en: Right, though I appreciate the offer.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.7.t.zh: 嗯，知道了。那我去问问别人。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.2.line.7.t.en: Yeah, okay. Then I'll ask someone else.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.0.t.zh: 莉子，这条围巾你觉得怎么样？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.0.t.en: Riko, what do you think of this muffler?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.1.t.zh: 不是挺好的吗？我觉得颜色沉稳，挺不错的。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.1.t.en: Isn't it nice? I think the color is calm and nice.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.2.t.zh: 美咲，这个当时半价，我就忍不住买了，但我觉得可能不太适合我。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.2.t.en: Miki, it was half price so I bought it on impulse, but I think it might not really suit me.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.3.t.zh: 确实。对阳菜来说可能有点朴素吧。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.3.t.en: True. It might be a bit plain for Hina.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.4.t.zh: 就是吧？这个是你喜欢的颜色吧。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.4.t.en: Right? This is your favorite color, isn't it?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.6.t.zh: 莉子，你用的话，我送你吧？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.6.t.en: Riko, if you'd use it, shall I give it to you?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.8.t.en: Yeah, I'll give it to you.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.9.t.zh: 但是，你几乎都没用过的吧？我觉得收下不太好，所以我出点钱。多少钱来着？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.9.t.en: But you've hardly used it, right? I'd feel bad taking it for free, so I'll pay something. How much was it?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.10..zh: 3500日元。……那，反正也用了一点，1000日元就行。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.10..en: 3500 yen. ... Well, I've used it a bit, so 1000 yen is fine.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.11..zh: 那也太便宜了。出2000日元行吗？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.11..en: That's way too cheap. Is 2000 yen okay?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.12..zh: 当然，那我就恭敬不如从命，收2000日元。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.3.line.12..en: Of course, then I'll take you up on that—2000 yen.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.4.line.0.t.zh: 喂喂，美雪？那个，我买了张新的餐桌。所以现在这张就用不着了。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.4.line.0.t.en: Hello, Miyuki? Hey, I bought a new dining table. So the current one's become unnecessary.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.4.line.2.t.zh: 你看，美雪，你不是说过想要餐桌吗？我的这张，你要吗？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.4.line.2.t.en: See, Miyuki, didn't you say you wanted a dining table? Do you want mine?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.4.line.3.t.en: Oh, great. About how big is it?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.4.line.4.t.zh: 大概能坐四个人的大小。比柜子大一些吧。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.4.line.4.t.en: Big enough for four people to sit. Bigger than a shelf, I guess.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.4.line.5.t.zh: 这样啊。其实我想要的是两人用那种小一点的。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.4.line.5.t.en: I see. Actually, I want something smaller, like for two people.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.4.line.6.t.zh: 这样啊。那我去问问别人。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.4.line.6.t.en: I see. Then I'll ask someone else.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.4.line.7.t.zh: 嗯，那就麻烦你了。虽然难得，但还是谢谢你。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.4.line.7.t.en: Yeah, could you do that? Thanks anyway, even though it's a shame.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.5.line.0.t.zh: 武田先生，我今年想选电子工程的课，难吗？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.5.line.0.t.en: Takeda-san, I'm thinking of taking the electronic engineering class this year; is it difficult?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.5.line.1.t.zh: 我没觉得有那么难。啊，我有笔记，你要吗？想要的话就……
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.5.line.1.t.en: I didn't think it was that hard. Oh, I have notes, do you want them? If you like, [take them].

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.5.line.2.t.en: Huh, is that okay? That helps me a lot.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.6.line.0.t.zh: 齐藤家的小孩，几岁了来着？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.6.line.0.t.en: How old was Saito-san's child again?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.6.line.2.t.zh: 啊，这样啊。其实，我家孩子不用的三轮车还在，您不介意的话，给孩子用吧？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.6.line.2.t.en: Ah, I see. Actually, we have a tricycle our child no longer uses; if you'd like, would you use it?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.6.line.3.t.zh: 诶，可以吗。帮大忙了。那我就恭敬不如从命了。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.6.line.3.t.en: Huh, really? That helps a lot. Then I'll take you up on that.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.7.line.0.t.zh: 山下先生，您之前不是说想要台电脑显示器吗？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.7.line.0.t.en: Yamashita-san, you mentioned before that you wanted a PC monitor, didn't you?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.7.line.2.t.zh: 我买了新的，所以这台旧的显示器，您要是不介意，拿去用？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.7.line.2.t.en: I bought a new one, so if you don't mind, would you like to use my current monitor?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.7.line.4.t.zh: 嗯，虽然是21英寸，但我是前年买的，所以还没那么旧。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.7.line.4.t.en: Yes, it's 21 inches, but since I bought it the year before last, I don't think it's that old.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.7.line.5.t.en: Really, is that okay? Thank you very much.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.7.line.6.t.zh: 哪里，这也帮了我。我明天带过来哦。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.7.line.6.t.en: Not at all, this helps me too. I'll bring it tomorrow.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.8.line.0.t.zh: 我买了新音箱，所以旧的那个，你不要的话就拿去用？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.8.line.0.t.en: I bought a new speaker, so if you want the old one, do you want to use it?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.8.line.1.t.zh: 诶，真的吗？大概多大？要是太占地方我就不想要了。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.8.line.1.t.en: Huh, really? About how big? If it doesn't take much space, I'd want it.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.8.line.2.t.zh: 一点都不大。差不多能放在手上的尺寸。我发照片给你。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.8.line.2.t.en: It's not big at all. About the size that fits in your hand. I'll send a photo.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.9.line.0.t.zh: 我有好几个完全没在戴的戒指，姐姐，你要吗？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.9.line.0.t.en: I have a few rings I never wear anymore, sis, do you want them?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.9.line.2.t.zh: 比如镶着方形边框石的，还有银色、稍微宽一点的之类的。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.9.line.2.t.en: Like ones with a square-framed stone, or silver ones that are a bit wide, and so on.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.9.line.3.t.zh: 嗯，不看到实物不知道，下次给我看看吧。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.9.line.3.t.en: Yeah, I won't know till I see the real thing, so show me next time.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.10.line.0..zh: 那个，您说要送我的桌子，能告诉我是什么颜色的吗？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.10.line.0..en: Um, about the table you said you'd give me, may I ask what color it is?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.10.line.1..zh: 好的，当然可以。嗯……算是自然的木色吧，有点偏浅褐色。照片不太看得出来颜色，您方便的话，不如来我家看一次？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.10.line.1..en: Sure, of course. Well... it's like a natural wood color, sort of a light brownish color. Since the color is hard to tell from a photo, if you like, why don't you come over and take a look?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.10.line.2..zh: 诶，可以吗。要是您能让我这样做，那就太感谢了。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.10.line.2..en: Huh, is that okay? I'd be very grateful if you'd let me do that.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.11.line.0..zh: 哥哥说要给我的笔记本电脑，颜色是普通的黑色吗？
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.11.line.0..en: The laptop my brother said he'd give me, is the color just plain black?

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.11.line.1..zh: 不是，不一样哦。该说是明亮的灰色，有点像不锈钢、偏浅的灰色。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.11.line.1..en: No, it's different. I'd say a bright gray, like a stainless-steel-ish, lighter gray.

nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.11.line.2..zh: 啊，那跟我以前用的颜色一样呢。
nihongo-namachukei.9.dialogue.11.line.2..en: Ah, then it's the same color as the one I used before.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.0..zh: 啊，难道说，你是昨天刚开始新搬来的？
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.0..en: Hey, wait, are you the person who just moved in yesterday?

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.1..zh: 啊，是的。我是康纳。请多关照。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.1..en: Oh, yes. I'm Conor. Nice to meet you.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.2..en: Oh, nice to meet you, I'm Ricky.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.3..zh: 那个，合租房子，我还是第一次……
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.3..en: Um, this is my first time in a share house...

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.5..zh: 房东跟我说，规则什么的去问住在里面的人。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.5..en: The landlord told me to ask the people who live here about the rules and such.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.8..zh: 嗯——挺自由的哦。基本上互不干涉。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.8..en: Well, it's pretty free. Basically, we don't interfere with each other.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.10.zh: 只是，厨房啦洗衣机啦，用完要马上收拾好，这点要留意。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.10.en: But, the kitchen and washing machine and such, you're supposed to clean up right after using them, so keep that in mind.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.12.zh: 碗什么的，洗完一直放着也不行。啊，还有，洗衣机很旧，声音特别大，所以早上很早或半夜用也不行。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.12.en: Leaving dishes unwashed is also no good. Oh, and the washing machine is old and super loud, so using it early in the morning or late at night is also NG.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.14.zh: 嗯，可能还有其他各种各样的规矩，不过你慢慢习惯就好。有不懂的事，随时来问。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.14.en: Well, there might be various other things, but just get used to it gradually. If there's anything you don't understand, ask me anytime.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.15.en: Yes, thank you. I'm counting on you.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.16.zh: 啊，对了。最里面的房间现在应该有勇氣在，去打声招呼吧？
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.16.en: Oh, that's right. I think Yuki is in the room at the very back now, so why don't you go say hello?

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.0.line.17.en: Yes, I'll do that. Thank you.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.0..zh: 来啦——。啊，桥本先生，早上好。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.0..en: Heeey. Oh, Mr. Hashimoto, good morning.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.1..zh: 早上好。那个，今天地区的垃圾清扫……
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.1..en: Good morning. Um, about today's neighborhood garbage cleanup...

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.2..zh: 啊，对，是从八点半开始对吧？还有大概三十分钟……
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.2..en: Oh, yes, it was from 8:30, right? About 30 minutes from now...

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.3..zh: 嗯，是没错，不过我想说，要是您已经能出门的话，就顺便来叫您。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.3..en: Yes, that's right, but I came to invite you, thinking that if you were already able to head out, we could go together.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.5..zh: 嗯。这地区的人特别热心。本来是八点半开始，但每次八点左右就开干，到八点半差不多都快结束了。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.5..en: Yes. The people in this area are very enthusiastic. It's supposed to start at 8:30, but every time they start around 8:00, and by 8:30 it's almost all finished.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.6..zh: 哎，是这样啊。您告诉我真是太好了。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.6..en: Wow, is that so. I'm glad you told me.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.7..zh: 小谷先生，地区清扫是您搬来后第一次，我想您肯定会准时来的。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.7..en: Mr. Ogaya, this is your first cleanup since moving here, so I figured you'd surely come right on time.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.8..zh: 是的，我也打算这样。我正想再过一会儿就出门，所以马上准备出发。真的，谢谢您来叫我。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.8..en: Yes, that was my plan. I was thinking of heading out a bit later, so I'll get ready and go right away. Really, thank you for coming to get me.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.1.line.9..en: Not at all. Well, I'll head over first.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.0..zh: 喂，你们，都这种时间了还在这里干什么？
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.0..en: Hey, you guys, what are you doing here at this hour?

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.1..zh: 啊，我们听说这里十点之前可以用。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.1..en: Oh, we were told we could use this place until 10.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.2..zh: 十点？你以为现在几点？都已经十一点了。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.2..en: 10? What time do you think it is? It's already 11.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.3..zh: 哇，真的诶。对不起。没注意到。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.3..en: Whoa, it really is. Sorry. I didn't notice.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.4..zh: 而且，用这里是可以，但规定是不能大声喧哗对吧。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.4..en: Besides, using this place is fine, but the rule is not to make loud noises, right?

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.5..zh: 是，对不起。我们在办生日派对，太嗨了。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.5..en: Yes, I'm sorry. We were having a birthday party and got carried away.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.6..zh: 哼。其他学生投诉说太吵了。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.6..en: Hmph. We got complaints from other students saying it was noisy.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.8..en: You have to follow the rules properly.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.9..zh: 是，真的非常抱歉。我现在马上收拾。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.9..en: Yes, I'm really sorry. I'll clean up right now.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.10.zh: 嗯，这次就只给严重警告，以后请绝对不要再发生这种事。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.10.en: Well, this time I'll just give you a stern warning, so please never let this happen again.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.11.zh: 是，我明白了。真的非常抱歉。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.2.line.11.en: Yes, I understand. I'm really sorry.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.3.line.4..zh: 那个，您在这条通道这里放了很多纸箱啦杂志啦，这些，是仓田先生的吗？
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.3.line.4..en: Um, you've left a lot of cardboard boxes and magazines and such in this hallway, but are these yours, Mr. Kurata?

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.3.line.5..zh: 啊，是的。我正想拿去回收。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.3.line.5..en: Oh, yes. I was planning to put them out for recycling.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.3.line.6..zh: 啊——原来如此。那个，从防灾角度来说，这样不太好。规定通道里不能放大型物品。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.3.line.6..en: Ah, I see. You see, from a disaster-prevention standpoint, this isn't good. There's a rule that you must not leave large objects in the hallway.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.3.line.7..zh: 是，说得对。对不起。我虽然知道，但还是觉得只要放一小会儿应该没关系。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.3.line.7..en: Yes, you're right. I'm sorry. I knew, but I thought it might be okay if it was just for a little while.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.3.line.8..zh: 嗯。看吧，要是地震什么的，通道不就被堵住了吗。所以必须随时保持通畅。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.3.line.8..en: Well. See, if there's an earthquake or something, the hallway would get blocked, right? So it has to always be kept passable.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.3.line.9..zh: 啊，是，我明白了。我马上挪到房间里。真的非常抱歉。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.3.line.9..en: Oh, yes, I understand. I'll move them into the room right away. I'm really sorry.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.4.line.1..zh: 嗯。好像不能放在通道，所以只能放自己房间，或者去租个自行车位。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.4.line.1..en: Well. It seems you can't leave it in the hallway, so you'll have to put it in your own room or rent a bike parking spot somewhere.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.4.line.2..en: Aw, is that so. What a pain.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.5.line.0..zh: 那个，这里可以养宠物吗？
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.5.line.0..en: Um, is it okay to keep pets here?

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.5.line.1..zh: 哎呀，鸟之类的可以，但狗啊猫那种大型的就不行。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.5.line.1..en: Well, birds and such are fine, but big ones like dogs and cats are not allowed.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.5.line.2..zh: 啊，这样啊。其实我是想养一只小狗。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.5.line.2..en: Ah, I see. Actually, I was thinking of keeping a small dog.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.6.line.0..zh: 不好意思，停在前面路上的车，是铃木先生的吗？
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.6.line.0..en: Excuse me, is the car parked on the road out front yours, Mr. Suzuki?

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.6.line.1..zh: 啊，是的。我想搬一下行李。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.6.line.1..en: Oh, yes. I was thinking of moving some luggage.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.6.line.2..zh: 不好意思，我现在要出门，能请您挪一下车吗？我的车出不来。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.6.line.2..en: Sorry, I'm heading out now, so could you move it a bit? My car can't get out.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.6.line.3..en: Oh, sorry. I'll move it right away.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.7.line.0..zh: 森川先生，放在玄关门口的自行车，是森川先生的吗？
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.7.line.0..en: Mr. Morikawa, is the bicycle by the entrance door yours?

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.7.line.2..zh: 那个，自行车能放在停车场旁边吗？因为小孩撞到会很危险。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.7.line.2..en: Um, could you put the bicycle by the side of the parking area? It's dangerous because the kids might bump into it.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.7.line.3..en: Oh, sorry. I'll move it right away.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.8.line.0..zh: 喂，今天早上谁用了厨房？锅什么的原封不动放着……
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.8.line.0..en: Hey, who used the kitchen this morning? The pot and stuff are just left as they are...

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.8.line.1..zh: 啊，我。抱歉。我本来打算马上收拾，但来电话了就忘了。我现在弄。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.8.line.1..en: Oh, me. Sorry. I was going to clean up right away, but I got a phone call and forgot. I'll do it now.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.9.line.0..zh: 我想后天用二楼的公共房间。如果不提前一周预约的话我会很困扰。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.9.line.0..en: I want to use the second-floor common room the day after tomorrow. It's a problem if you don't make the reservation at least a week in advance.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.9.line.1..zh: 对不起，我本来想着要快点预约，但不小心就……
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.9.line.1..en: I'm sorry, I was thinking I should reserve early, but I just...

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.9.line.2..zh: 这次就算了，但下次请提前一周。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.9.line.2..en: It's fine this time, but from next time please do it a week ahead.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.9.line.3..en: Yes, I'll be careful from now on.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.10.line.0.en: Um, I'd like to ask you something.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.10.line.2.zh: 这个公寓，扔垃圾的日子是怎么规定的？
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.10.line.2.en: How are the garbage days set up in this apartment?

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.10.line.3.zh: 啊，那个，可燃垃圾是周一和周四，瓶子和罐子是第二个星期二。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.10.line.3.en: Oh, well, burnable garbage is on Mondays and Thursdays, and bottles and cans are on the second Tuesday of the month.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.10.line.4.en: I see. Thank you very much.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.11.line.0.zh: 这个房间的打扫是怎么安排的？
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.11.line.0.en: How does cleaning this room work?

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.11.line.2.zh: 但是，那样的话，打扫的人不就总是同一个人了吗？
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.11.line.2.en: But then, doesn't it always end up being the same person cleaning?

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.11.line.3.zh: 虽说如此，但就是这样规定的。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.11.line.3.en: That may be so, but that's how it is.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.12.line.0.en: Um, I'd like to ask something.

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.12.line.2.zh: 这里，自行车停放处在哪里？
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.12.line.2.en: Where is the bicycle parking around here?

nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.12.line.3.zh: 啊，这里没有自行车停放处。
nihongo-namachukei.10.dialogue.12.line.3.en: Oh, there is no bicycle parking here.

jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.2.zh: 終止形就是辞书形，用来结句：「行く。」「食べる。」现代日语里它和連体形同形，所以很多教材干脆只叫「辞書形」。
jlpt-n5-doshi-no-katsuyo.verbs.grammar.2.en: The 終止形 is the dictionary form and ends a sentence: 行く。食べる。 In modern Japanese it has the same shape as the 連体形, which is why many textbooks simply call it the dictionary form.
